Woman: Then come with me.
She picked up the bag, took two steps, then turned back.
Woman: He's fine. Don't worry.

title: 3. 楼上的房间
english_summary: The cat is upstairs in a small flat above a shop, in a box, being looked after properly. What surprises them is not the cat. It is how much this cost, and who paid it.
content:
星期六下午，他们跟着阿姨走了二十分钟。
她住的地方在一个小店的楼上。
楼梯很窄，也很暗。
阿姨：小心点，这里的灯坏了。
房间很小，可是收拾得很好。
窗户下面放着一个箱子。
箱子里面有一块布。
大毛就在上面躺着。
他抬起头看了看他们。
他后面的一只脚上有白色的东西。
李明坐在箱子旁边。
李明：大毛。
大毛叫了一声。
小红：他认识你。
李明：他谁都认识。
阿姨在旁边站着，笑了。
阿姨：他这几天吃得比我还好。
小明：他这只脚怎么了？
阿姨：车压的。
阿姨：那天晚上我带他去了医院。
小红：晚上还有医院开门？
阿姨：找了三家才找到。
李明：那……钱呢？
阿姨没有马上回答。
她走过去，把窗户关小了一点。
阿姨：这个不重要。
李明：多少钱？
阿姨：真的不重要。
小红：阿姨。
阿姨看着她们，最后说了一个数。
那个数不小。
李明：这是您几天的工资？
阿姨：差不多一个星期。
屋子里安静了。
阿姨：我一个人住，钱够用。
阿姨：他在门口那么多年，我天天看见他。
阿姨：那天他看着我，我总不能走。
李明想说什么，可是说不出来。
最后是小红先开口的。
小红：阿姨，这个钱我们大家一起出。
阿姨：不用。
小红：不是不用。
小红：是这条街上很多人都在喂他。
小红：他们只是还不知道。
english_content:
On Saturday afternoon they followed the woman for twenty minutes.
She lives above a small shop.
The stairs were narrow and dark.
Woman: Careful, the light up here is broken.
The room was small but very neatly kept.
Under the window was a box.
Inside the box was a cloth.
Da Mao was lying on top of it.
He lifted his head and looked at them.
There was something white on one of his back legs.
Li Ming sat down beside the box.
Li Ming: Da Mao.
Da Mao made a sound.
Xiao Hong: He knows you.
Li Ming: He knows everyone.
The woman stood to one side, smiling.
Woman: He's eaten better than I have these last few days.
Xiao Ming: What happened to his leg?
Woman: A car.
Woman: I took him to a clinic that night.
Xiao Hong: There are clinics open at night?
Woman: I tried three before I found one.
Li Ming: And… the money?
She didn't answer straight away.
She went over and closed the window a little.
Woman: That doesn't matter.
Li Ming: How much?
Woman: It really doesn't matter.
Xiao Hong: Please.
She looked at them, and finally said a number.
It wasn't a small number.
Li Ming: That's several days' pay for you?
Woman: About a week.
The room went quiet.
Woman: I live alone; I have enough.
Woman: He's been outside that door for years. I saw him every day.
Woman: That night he looked at me. I could hardly walk off.
Li Ming wanted to say something and couldn't.
In the end it was Xiao Hong who spoke first.
Xiao Hong: We'll all put in for this together.
Woman: There's no need.
Xiao Hong: It isn't that there's no need.
Xiao Hong: It's that a lot of people on that street feed him.
Xiao Hong: They just don't know yet.

title: 4. 一张纸和一个盒子
english_summary: Xiao Hong's method again: a sheet of paper and a box on a counter. What it collects in four days is more than money, and it comes with a problem nobody thought about.
content:
星期日，他们在面店门口放了一个盒子。
旁边贴了一张纸。
纸上写着大毛的事。
最后一行写的是，钱是给医院的，不是给我们的。
姑娘：你们觉得会有人放钱吗？
小红：会。
姑娘：为什么这么肯定？
小红：因为大家都以为只有自己在喂他。
第一天，盒子里有一百多。
第二天，三百多。
第三天，姑娘打电话给李明。
姑娘：你过来一下。
李明跑过去的时候，盒子已经满了。
里面不只有钱。
有人放了猫吃的东西。
有人放了一块新的布。
有一个小孩子放了一张画。
画上是一只很大的白猫。
姑娘：这个画是三楼那家的小孩画的。
李明：他也认识大毛？
姑娘：这条街上没有不认识他的。
第四天，钱够了，还多了很多。
晚上他们三个人坐在面店里数钱。
小明：多了两倍。
小红：那多的怎么办？
李明：还给大家？
小明：怎么还？我们不知道谁放的。
姑娘：我有一个想法。
三个人看着她。
姑娘：那个阿姨说她楼梯上的灯坏了。
小红：您想修灯？
姑娘：不只是灯。
姑娘：她一个人住，晚上十一点才回家。
姑娘：那条楼梯又窄又黑。
李明：可是她会同意吗？
姑娘：她刚才说钱不重要。
姑娘：所以我们也不问。
小红笑了。
小红：您比我还坏。
姑娘：我跟我爷爷学的。
english_content:
On Sunday they put a box outside the noodle shop.
Beside it they stuck up a sheet of paper.
The paper explained what had happened to Da Mao.
The last line said the money was for the clinic, not for them.
Young woman: Do you think anyone will put money in?
Xiao Hong: Yes.
Young woman: How are you so sure?
Xiao Hong: Because everyone thinks they're the only one feeding him.
On the first day there was a hundred-odd in the box.
On the second, three hundred-odd.
On the third day the young woman phoned Li Ming.
Young woman: Come over a minute.
By the time Li Ming ran over, the box was full.
There wasn't only money in it.
Someone had put in cat food.
Someone had put in a new cloth.
A small child had put in a drawing.
The drawing was of a very large white cat.
Young woman: That's from the child on the third floor.
Li Ming: He knows Da Mao too?
Young woman: There's nobody on this street who doesn't.
By the fourth day there was enough, and a lot more besides.
That evening the three of them sat in the shop counting it.
Xiao Ming: It's three times over.
Xiao Hong: So what do we do with the rest?
Li Ming: Give it back?
Xiao Ming: How? We don't know who put it in.
Young woman: I have an idea.
The three of them looked at her.
Young woman: That woman said the light on her stairs is broken.
Xiao Hong: You want to fix the light?
Young woman: Not just the light.
Young woman: She lives alone and doesn't get home until eleven at night.
Young woman: Those stairs are narrow and pitch dark.
Li Ming: But will she agree to it?
Young woman: She just told us the money doesn't matter.
Young woman: So we don't ask her either.
Xiao Hong laughed.
Xiao Hong: You're worse than I am.
Young woman: I learned it from my grandfather.

title: 5. 六点半的石头
english_summary: Two weeks later the cat is back on his stone at half past six, and there is a light on a staircase across the neighbourhood. The woman who cleans the offices comes for noodles on a Sunday, and stays.
content:
两个星期以后，大毛回来了。
那天早上六点半，他就坐在那块石头上。
他走路还是有一点不一样。
可是他坐的地方，一点也没有变。
姑娘开门的时候看见了他。
她站在门口，看了很久，然后进去拿了一点东西出来。
那天早上，很多人从那里过。
卖水果的看见了，笑了。
小超市的人出来看了两次。
三楼的小孩子从窗户里叫了他一声。
李明来的时候，大毛正在吃东西。
李明：你知道这条街上有多少人在找你吗？
大毛没有理他。
那个楼梯上的灯，是上个星期装的。
装灯的人是小明的叔叔，他没有要钱。
阿姨那天晚上回家，站在楼梯下面停了一下。
她抬头看了看那个灯。
然后她一个人上了楼。
第二天她来面店问是谁做的。
姑娘：不知道。
阿姨：这条街上没有你不知道的事。
姑娘：这件事我真的不知道。
阿姨看着她，最后什么也没说。
可是从那个星期开始，她每个星期日中午都来吃面。
她总是坐在最里面那张桌子。
有时候大毛也进来，在她旁边躺着。
姑娘说，那是店里最好的一张桌子。
因为从那里能看见门口的石头。
有一天李明问她。
李明：您为什么每次都坐那里？
阿姨想了一下。
阿姨：因为我以前每天晚上从这里过。
阿姨：那时候这条街上什么都关着。
阿姨：我以为这个地方跟我没关系。
李明：现在呢？
阿姨笑了。
阿姨：现在我知道有一张桌子是我的。
english_content:
Two weeks later, Da Mao came back.
At half past six that morning he was sitting on the stone.
He still walks a little differently.
But where he sits hasn't changed at all.
The young woman saw him as she opened up.
She stood in the doorway a long time, then went in and brought something out.
A lot of people went past that morning.
The fruit seller saw him and laughed.
The man from the supermarket came out to look twice.
The child on the third floor called down to him from the window.
When Li Ming arrived, Da Mao was eating.
Li Ming: Do you know how many people on this street were looking for you?
Da Mao ignored him.
The light on those stairs went in last week.
Xiao Ming's uncle fitted it and wouldn't take any money.
When the woman got home that night she stopped at the bottom of the stairs.
She looked up at the light.
Then she went up on her own.
The next day she came to the noodle shop and asked who'd done it.
Young woman: No idea.
Woman: There is nothing on this street you don't know about.
Young woman: This one I genuinely don't.
The woman looked at her, and in the end said nothing.
But from that week on, she came for noodles every Sunday lunchtime.
She always sits at the table right at the back.
Sometimes Da Mao comes in and lies down beside her.
The young woman says it's the best table in the place.
Because from there you can see the stone by the door.
One day Li Ming asked her.
Li Ming: Why do you always sit there?
She thought about it.
Woman: Because I used to walk past here every night.
Woman: Back then everything on this street was shut.
Woman: I thought this place had nothing to do with me.
Li Ming: And now?
She laughed.
Woman: Now I know one of the tables is mine.

title: 1. 写错地址的信
english_summary: A letter arrives with their address and someone else's name — handwritten, stamped this year, and addressed to a woman who has not lived in the flat for a very long time.
content:
那封信是星期二到的。
信箱里只有它一封。
上面写着他们家的地址。
可是名字不是他们家的人。
那个名字是周淑兰。
李明把信拿上楼。
李明：妈，您认识周淑兰吗？
妈妈：不认识。
李明：可是地址是我们家的。
妈妈把信接过去看。
信是手写的，字很小，很整齐。
上面贴着今年的邮票。
妈妈：这个字写得真好看。
李明：我们要不要打开？
妈妈：不能打开。
李明：那怎么办？
妈妈：写上退回，放回信箱。
她这么说了，可是她没有动。
她把信放在桌子上，看了很久。
妈妈：这个名字我好像听过。
李明：在哪里听过？
妈妈：想不起来了。
那天晚上，那封信一直放在桌子上。
谁走过去都会看它一眼。
english_content:
The letter came on Tuesday.
It was the only thing in the letterbox.
Their address was written on it.
But the name wasn't anyone in their family.
The name was Zhou Shulan.
Li Ming carried the letter upstairs.
Li Ming: Mum, do you know a Zhou Shulan?
Mum: No.
Li Ming: But the address is ours.
Mum took the letter to look at it.
It was handwritten, in small, very neat characters.
There was a stamp from this year on it.
Mum: That's beautiful handwriting.
Li Ming: Should we open it?
Mum: We can't open it.
Li Ming: Then what do we do?
Mum: Write 'return to sender' on it and put it back in the box.
That's what she said, but she didn't move.
She put the letter on the table and looked at it for a long time.
Mum: I feel like I've heard that name.
Li Ming: Where?
Mum: I can't bring it to mind.
The letter sat on the table all evening.
Everyone who walked past it glanced at it.

title: 2. 住在这里的人
english_summary: The building has had a lot of tenants and no records. Then Li Ming realises the person who has watched every one of them arrive and leave is sitting downstairs in the same chair she has always used.
content:
第二天，李明去问了楼下的管理员。
管理员：周淑兰？没听过。
李明：她以前住过我们家。
管理员：这个楼换了多少人，我记不住。
李明：你们没有本子吗？
管理员：以前有，后来搬家的时候丢了。
李明回来的时候，路过楼下的门口。
奶奶正坐在那里，跟别人说话。
她每天下午都坐在那把椅子上。
李明忽然停下来了。
李明：奶奶。
奶奶：怎么了？
李明：您在这个楼住了多少年？
奶奶：六十年。
李明：那您认识周淑兰吗？
奶奶脸上的样子变了。
她没有马上回答。
奶奶：你从哪里听到这个名字的？
李明把信拿出来。
奶奶看了那封信，手放在上面很久。
奶奶：她住在四楼。
奶奶：就是你们家。
李明：什么时候？
奶奶：三十多年以前。
李明：她后来去哪里了？
奶奶：她走了以后，谁也没有再见过她。
english_content:
The next day Li Ming went and asked the building's caretaker.
Caretaker: Zhou Shulan? Never heard of her.
Li Ming: She used to live in our flat.
Caretaker: I can't keep track of how many people have been through this building.
Li Ming: Don't you have records?
Caretaker: We used to. They got lost when the office moved.
On his way back, Li Ming passed the doorway downstairs.
Grandma was sitting there talking to someone.
She sits in that chair every afternoon.
Li Ming stopped suddenly.
Li Ming: Grandma.
Grandma: What is it?
Li Ming: How many years have you lived in this building?
Grandma: Sixty.
Li Ming: Then do you know a Zhou Shulan?
Something in Grandma's face changed.
She didn't answer straight away.
Grandma: Where did you hear that name?
Li Ming took out the letter.
Grandma looked at it and kept her hand on it for a long time.
Grandma: She lived on the fourth floor.
Grandma: In your flat.
Li Ming: When?
Grandma: More than thirty years ago.
Li Ming: Where did she go afterwards?
Grandma: After she left, nobody ever saw her again.

title: 3. 奶奶不想说的事
english_summary: Grandma answers every question except the one that matters, and Li Ming works out that she is not protecting a stranger. She is deciding whether a thirty-year-old promise still holds.
content:
李明问了很多问题。
奶奶回答了一些，别的没有回答。
李明：她是做什么的？
奶奶：教书的。
李明：她多大？
奶奶：那时候三十几岁。
李明：她一个人住吗？
奶奶：一个人。
李明：她为什么走？
奶奶没有说话。
李明：奶奶。
奶奶：这个我不能说。
李明：为什么？
奶奶：因为我答应过她。
李明看着她。
奶奶：那时候我们两个是朋友。
奶奶：她走的那天，只跟我一个人说了。
奶奶：她让我别告诉别人她去了哪里。
李明：三十年了。
奶奶：答应了就是答应了。
李明：可是有人在给她写信。
奶奶：我知道。
李明：写信的人不知道她已经搬走了。
奶奶：我也想到了这个。
她把手放在椅子上，慢慢站了起来。
奶奶：你让我想两天。
english_content:
Li Ming asked a lot of questions.
Grandma answered some of them and not others.
Li Ming: What did she do?
Grandma: She taught.
Li Ming: How old was she?
Grandma: In her thirties then.
Li Ming: Did she live alone?
Grandma: Alone.
Li Ming: Why did she leave?
Grandma didn't say anything.
Li Ming: Grandma.
Grandma: That I can't tell you.
Li Ming: Why not?
Grandma: Because I promised her.
Li Ming looked at her.
Grandma: The two of us were friends back then.
Grandma: The day she left, I was the only one she told.
Grandma: She asked me not to tell anyone where she'd gone.
Li Ming: That was thirty years ago.
Grandma: A promise is a promise.
Li Ming: But someone is writing to her.
Grandma: I know.
Li Ming: Whoever it is doesn't know she moved away.
Grandma: That had occurred to me as well.
She put a hand on the chair and got slowly to her feet.
Grandma: Give me two days to think.

title: 4. 两天以后
english_summary: Two days later Grandma has a plan that keeps her promise and answers the letter at the same time — and it requires Li Ming to write something himself, without knowing who will read it.
content:
两天以后，奶奶来敲门。
她手里拿着一个旧本子。
奶奶：我想清楚了。
妈妈：您坐。
奶奶：我不能告诉你们她在哪里。
奶奶：可是我可以把信送过去。
李明：您知道她的地址？
奶奶：三十年前的。
奶奶：她走的时候留给我的。
李明：她后来一直没有换过吗？
奶奶：不知道。
李明：那寄过去也可能收不到。
奶奶：可能。
她把本子打开，里面有一行很旧的字。
奶奶：可是不寄，就一定收不到。
妈妈：那这封信怎么办？
奶奶：这封信我们不动。
奶奶：我们在外面加一个信封，寄到那个地址。
李明：里面就放这封信？
奶奶：还要放一张纸。
李明：写什么？
奶奶：写清楚这封信是怎么到你们家的。
奶奶：不然她会以为有人打开过。
妈妈：您来写？
奶奶：我不写。
她看着李明。
奶奶：你写。信是你收到的。
english_content:
Two days later Grandma knocked on the door.
She was holding an old notebook.
Grandma: I've made up my mind.
Mum: Sit down.
Grandma: I can't tell you where she is.
Grandma: But I can send the letter on.
Li Ming: You have her address?
Grandma: One from thirty years ago.
Grandma: She left it with me when she went.
Li Ming: And she never moved again?
Grandma: I don't know.
Li Ming: Then posting it might not reach her.
Grandma: It might not.
She opened the notebook; inside was a line of very old writing.
Grandma: But if we don't post it, it certainly won't.
Mum: So what do we do with this letter?
Grandma: We don't touch this letter.
Grandma: We put an envelope around it and send it to that address.
Li Ming: With the letter inside?
Grandma: And a sheet of paper.
Li Ming: Saying what?
Grandma: Explaining exactly how this letter reached your flat.
Grandma: Otherwise she'll think somebody opened it.
Mum: Will you write it?
Grandma: I won't.
She looked at Li Ming.
Grandma: You write it. You're the one who received it.

title: 5. 一个月以后
english_summary: Li Ming writes four lines, posts it, and hears nothing for a month. What comes back is not from Zhou Shulan, and it settles a question Grandma has been carrying since before he was born.
content:
李明写了很多次。
写长了不行，写短了也不行。
最后他只写了四行。
他写的是，这封信到了他家，他没有打开，他把它寄过来，希望她能收到。
最后他写了自己的名字。
信是星期四寄的。
然后就没有消息了。
一个星期，两个星期。
第三个星期，李明已经不想它了。
第四个星期的星期六，妈妈叫他。
妈妈：楼下有你的东西。
信箱里有一个信封。
上面的字不是那种很小很整齐的字。
这个字大一些，也没有那么整齐。
李明打开的时候，手有点儿快。
里面只有一张纸。
上面写着几行字。
写信的人说，她是周淑兰的女儿。
她说她妈妈三年前走了。
她说那封信是她爸爸写的，她爸爸不知道。
她说她爸爸每年都往这个地址寄一封。
三十年，一年一封。
李明拿着那张纸，坐在楼梯上，很久没有上楼。
后来他去了奶奶家。
他把纸给了她。
奶奶把纸拿近，一行一行地看。
看完以后，她把纸放在腿上。
她说了一句很小声的话。
奶奶：这样啊。
李明：奶奶。
奶奶：她没有一个人。
她说完，抬头看着窗户外面。
那天下午的太阳很好。
奶奶：那我这三十年，也没有做错。
english_content:
Li Ming wrote it many times over.
Too long was wrong; too short was wrong too.
In the end he wrote just four lines.
He wrote that this letter had arrived at his home, that he hadn't opened it, that he was sending it on and hoped it would reach her.
At the end he wrote his own name.
The letter went on Thursday.
And then there was nothing.
One week, two weeks.
By the third week Li Ming had stopped thinking about it.
On the Saturday of the fourth week, his mother called him.
Mum: There's something downstairs for you.
There was an envelope in the letterbox.
The writing on it wasn't the small, neat kind.
This writing was larger, and not as neat.
Li Ming's hands were a little quick as he opened it.
Inside there was only one sheet of paper.
A few lines were written on it.
The writer said she was Zhou Shulan's daughter.
She said her mother had died three years ago.
She said the letter had been written by her father, who didn't know.
She said her father posts one to that address every year.
Thirty years, one letter a year.
Li Ming sat on the stairs holding the page and didn't go up for a long time.
Later he went to his grandmother's.
He gave her the page.
Grandma held the page closer and read it line by line.
When she'd finished, she rested it on her lap.
She said one thing, very quietly.
Grandma: So that's how it was.
Li Ming: Grandma.
Grandma: She wasn't on her own.
Then she looked up and out of the window.
The sun was good that afternoon.
Grandma: Then these thirty years, I didn't get it wrong either.

title: 1. 一个箱子
english_summary: Grandma decides to move to a smaller flat and asks Li Ming to help her sort through sixty years of things. She is ruthless about all of it, until they reach one box she will not open in front of him.
content:
奶奶要搬家了。
新的地方在同一条街上，可是小很多。
奶奶：我一个人，不需要这么大。
妈妈：您真的想好了？
奶奶：想了两年了。
星期六早上，李明去帮忙。
屋子里的东西比他想的多得多。
奶奶做事情很快。
她坐在椅子上，一样一样地说。
奶奶：这个不要。
奶奶：这个也不要。
奶奶：这个给楼下。
李明：这个呢？
奶奶：不要。
李明：这是您的照片。
奶奶：我知道。不要。
李明拿着那张照片，没有放下。
李明：为什么不要？
奶奶：因为我记得。
奶奶：东西是给忘了的人用的。
一个上午，他们收拾了三个房间。
中午吃完饭，他们开始收拾最里面那间。
那间屋子里有一个很旧的木箱子。
李明去搬的时候，奶奶忽然说话了。
奶奶：这个放着。
李明：里面是什么？
奶奶：一些旧东西。
李明：也不要吗？
奶奶：这个要。
她说得很快，比刚才所有的话都快。
李明看了她一眼，没有再问。
可是他注意到一件事情。
那个箱子上有锁。
屋子里所有的东西都没有锁，只有这一个。
english_content:
Grandma is moving.
The new place is on the same street, but much smaller.
Grandma: I'm one person. I don't need all this.
Mum: Have you really thought it through?
Grandma: I've been thinking about it for two years.
On Saturday morning Li Ming went to help.
There was far more in the flat than he'd expected.
Grandma works fast.
She sat in a chair and went through it item by item.
Grandma: Don't want that.
Grandma: Don't want that either.
Grandma: That goes downstairs.
Li Ming: What about this?
Grandma: Don't want it.
Li Ming: It's a photograph of you.
Grandma: I know. Don't want it.
Li Ming held the photograph and didn't put it down.
Li Ming: Why not?
Grandma: Because I remember.
Grandma: Things are for people who've forgotten.
In one morning they cleared three rooms.
After lunch they started on the room at the back.
In that room was a very old wooden box.
As Li Ming went to move it, Grandma spoke suddenly.
Grandma: Leave that.
Li Ming: What's in it?
Grandma: Some old things.
Li Ming: You don't want it either?
Grandma: That one I want.
She said it quickly — faster than anything else she'd said.
Li Ming glanced at her and didn't ask again.
But he noticed one thing.
There was a lock on that box.
Nothing else in the flat was locked. Only that.

title: 2. 不问的规矩
english_summary: Li Ming tells Xiao Hong about the box, expecting her to be curious. Instead she asks him a question about his grandmother that he has never once thought to ask.
content:
星期一，李明跟小红说了那个箱子。
李明：上面有锁。
小红：那又怎么样？
李明：您不觉得奇怪吗？
小红：不觉得。
李明：一屋子的东西她都不要。
李明：就这一个箱子她要。
小红：所以呢？
李明：所以里面一定有什么。
小红把书放下了。
小红：李明，我问你一件事。
李明：你说。
小红：你奶奶多大了？
李明：八十六。
小红：她这八十六年，你知道多少？
李明想回答，可是没有话。
小红：你知道她住这个楼六十年。
小红：别的呢？
李明：……我不知道。
小红：那她欠你一个答案吗？
李明：不欠。
小红：那就是了。
李明：可是我想知道。
小红：想知道和有权利知道，不一样。
李明没有说话。
小红：你去年也没有想过这个箱子。
小红：你现在想，是因为你看见了那个锁。
李明：那我就不管了？
小红：我没有说不管。
小红：我是说，你可以直接问她。
李明：她不会说。
小红：那她也可以不说。
她说完就去上课了。
李明一个人在那里坐了很久。
english_content:
On Monday Li Ming told Xiao Hong about the box.
Li Ming: There's a lock on it.
Xiao Hong: So?
Li Ming: Don't you think that's odd?
Xiao Hong: No.
Li Ming: She doesn't want anything in that whole flat.
Li Ming: Just this one box.
Xiao Hong: And?
Li Ming: So there must be something in it.
Xiao Hong put her book down.
Xiao Hong: Li Ming, let me ask you something.
Li Ming: Go on.
Xiao Hong: How old is your grandmother?
Li Ming: Eighty-six.
Xiao Hong: How much of those eighty-six years do you know about?
Li Ming started to answer and had nothing to say.
Xiao Hong: You know she's lived in that building sixty years.
Xiao Hong: What else?
Li Ming: …I don't know.
Xiao Hong: Does she owe you an answer?
Li Ming: No.
Xiao Hong: Well then.
Li Ming: But I want to know.
Xiao Hong: Wanting to know and having a right to know aren't the same.
Li Ming said nothing.
Xiao Hong: You never thought about that box last year.
Xiao Hong: You're thinking about it now because you saw the lock.
Li Ming: So I just drop it?
Xiao Hong: I didn't say drop it.
Xiao Hong: I said you could simply ask her.
Li Ming: She won't say.
Xiao Hong: Then she's allowed not to.
With that she went off to class.
Li Ming sat there on his own for a long time.

title: 3. 他直接问了
english_summary: He asks. She says no. And then, because he accepts the no without arguing, she tells him something else instead — which turns out to be the harder thing.
content:
星期三下午，李明去了奶奶的新家。
新的地方很小，可是收拾得很好。
那个木箱子放在床下面。
李明坐下来，喝了一口水。
李明：奶奶，我想问您那个箱子。
奶奶把杯子放下了。
奶奶：你想问什么？
李明：里面是什么。
奶奶：我不想说。
李明：好。
奶奶看着他。
奶奶：好？
李明：您不想说就不说。
李明：我只是想问一次。
屋子里安静了一会儿。
奶奶：你妈妈像你这么大的时候，不是这样。
李明：她怎么样？
奶奶：她会一直问，问到我生气。
李明笑了。
奶奶也笑了。
然后她的脸慢慢地变了。
奶奶：李明。
李明：嗯？
奶奶：箱子里没有什么了不起的东西。
奶奶：都是信。
李明：谁的信？
奶奶：周淑兰的。
李明手里的杯子停在那里。
奶奶：三十年，她给我写了三十封。
奶奶：我一封也没有回。
李明：为什么？
奶奶：因为我答应过她，不告诉别人她在哪里。
奶奶：我怕我一写，就写出去了。
李明：可是您可以回给她自己啊。
奶奶：现在我也知道。
她的手放在腿上，很安静。
奶奶：那时候我太笨了。
english_content:
On Wednesday afternoon Li Ming went to Grandma's new place.
It's small, but very neatly kept.
The wooden box was under the bed.
Li Ming sat down and drank some water.
Li Ming: Grandma, I want to ask you about that box.
She put her cup down.
Grandma: What do you want to ask?
Li Ming: What's in it.
Grandma: I don't want to say.
Li Ming: All right.
She looked at him.
Grandma: All right?
Li Ming: If you don't want to say, don't.
Li Ming: I only wanted to ask once.
The room was quiet for a moment.
Grandma: Your mother wasn't like this at your age.
Li Ming: What was she like?
Grandma: She'd keep asking until I lost my temper.
Li Ming laughed.
Grandma laughed too.
Then her face slowly changed.
Grandma: Li Ming.
Li Ming: Mm?
Grandma: There's nothing remarkable in that box.
Grandma: It's letters.
Li Ming: Whose letters?
Grandma: Zhou Shulan's.
The cup stopped in Li Ming's hand.
Grandma: Thirty years. She wrote me thirty of them.
Grandma: I never answered one.
Li Ming: Why not?
Grandma: Because I promised her I wouldn't tell anyone where she was.
Grandma: I was afraid that once I started writing, it would get out.
Li Ming: But you could have written back to her.
Grandma: I know that now as well.
Her hands lay still in her lap.
Grandma: I was too stupid back then.

title: 4. 三十封信
english_summary: They read them in order, across one long afternoon. The letters are not dramatic. That is exactly what makes the last few hard to get through.
content:
那天下午，奶奶打开了箱子。
里面的信按时间放好，一年一封。
最上面的是最早的。
奶奶：你念吧，我眼睛不行了。
李明拿起第一封。
第一封很短。
上面说她到了，那边的学校不错，让奶奶别担心。
第二封说她开始教书了。
第三封说她认识了一个人。
第四封说她结婚了。
第五封里有一张照片。
照片上是一个很小的孩子。
奶奶：这个我看过很多次。
李明一封一封地念。
中间那些年的信都差不多。
孩子上学了。
她换了一个学校。
她父亲走了。
她说那年冬天很长。
每一封的最后，她都写同一句话。
她写的是，如果你不想回信，也没有关系。
李明念到第二十封的时候，停了一下。
李明：奶奶。
奶奶：念。
李明念完了第二十五封。
第二十六封只有三行。
上面说她身体不太好，可是不用担心。
第二十七封的字变小了。
第二十八封的字有点儿不整齐。
第二十九封只有一行。
上面写的是，今年也一样，我很好。
第三十封是三年前的。
那封信不是她写的。
那是她女儿写的。
上面说，我妈妈让我告诉您，她一直很好。
念完以后，屋子里很久没有声音。
最后奶奶说话了。
奶奶：她比我聪明。
李明：为什么？
奶奶：她知道不回信也可以一直写。
english_content:
That afternoon, Grandma opened the box.
The letters were in order, one a year.
The earliest was on top.
Grandma: You read them. My eyes aren't up to it.
Li Ming picked up the first.
The first was very short.
It said she'd arrived, the school there was decent, and Grandma wasn't to worry.
The second said she'd started teaching.
The third said she'd met someone.
The fourth said she'd married.
The fifth had a photograph in it.
In the photograph was a very small child.
Grandma: I've looked at that one many times.
Li Ming read them one by one.
The letters from the middle years were much the same.
The child started school.
She changed schools.
Her father died.
She said that winter was a long one.
At the end of every letter she wrote the same sentence.
She wrote that if Grandma didn't want to reply, that was all right.
When Li Ming reached the twentieth, he paused.
Li Ming: Grandma.
Grandma: Read.
He finished the twenty-fifth.
The twenty-sixth was only three lines.
It said her health wasn't good, but not to worry.
The writing in the twenty-seventh was smaller.
The writing in the twenty-eighth was a little unsteady.
The twenty-ninth was one line.
It said, same again this year, I am well.
The thirtieth was from three years ago.
That one wasn't in her handwriting.
Her daughter had written it.
It said: my mother asked me to tell you she has been well all along.
When he finished there was no sound in the room for a long time.
At last Grandma spoke.
Grandma: She was cleverer than me.
Li Ming: How?
Grandma: She knew you can keep writing without ever getting a reply.

title: 5. 第三十一封
english_summary: Grandma writes one letter, thirty years late, to a person who cannot read it. Li Ming posts it. What she puts in it is not an apology, and she explains why.
content:
过了一个星期，奶奶让李明再来一次。
桌子上放着纸和笔。
奶奶：我要写一封信。
李明：给谁？
奶奶：给她。
李明：可是……
奶奶：我知道。
奶奶：我不是写给现在的她。
李明：那是写给谁？
奶奶：写给那三十年。
她写得很慢。
一个下午只写了一页。
李明坐在旁边等，没有说话。
写完以后，她让李明念一遍。
信里没有说对不起。
李明：您为什么不写对不起？
奶奶：因为对不起是给我自己用的。
奶奶：写了我心里舒服，她什么也得不到。
李明：那您写了什么？
奶奶：我写了这三十年我做了什么。
她写的是，那些年她还在教书，后来不教了。
她写的是，那个人走了以后，这条街上的树长高了很多。
她写的是，那个房子后来住过一家人，他们家的孩子现在也大了。
她写的是，那些信她一封都留着。
最后一行写的是，我一直都在这里。
李明念完，把信放下了。
奶奶：寄到那个女儿那里。
李明：好。
奶奶：她收不到也没有关系。
奶奶：这封信本来就不是为了收到的。
星期一早上，李明把信寄了。
从邮局回来的路上，他走过那个楼。
楼下的那把椅子还在，可是没有人坐了。
他站在那里看了一会儿。
然后他回家了。
english_content:
A week later, Grandma asked Li Ming to come again.
There was paper and a pen on the table.
Grandma: I'm going to write a letter.
Li Ming: To whom?
Grandma: To her.
Li Ming: But…
Grandma: I know.
Grandma: I'm not writing to the person she is now.
Li Ming: Then who are you writing to?
Grandma: To those thirty years.
She wrote very slowly.
In a whole afternoon she wrote one page.
Li Ming sat beside her and waited without speaking.
When she'd finished she asked him to read it back.
There was no apology in the letter.
Li Ming: Why didn't you write sorry?
Grandma: Because sorry is for my benefit.
Grandma: Writing it would make me feel better and give her nothing.
Li Ming: So what did you write?
Grandma: I wrote what I did with those thirty years.
She wrote that in those years she was still teaching, and later stopped.
She wrote that after she left, the trees on this street grew a great deal taller.
She wrote that a family lived in her old flat afterwards, and their child is grown up now too.
She wrote that she had kept every one of the letters.
Her last line was that she had been here the whole time.
Li Ming finished reading and put the letter down.
Grandma: Send it to the daughter.
Li Ming: All right.
Grandma: It doesn't matter if it doesn't reach her.
Grandma: This letter was never for the sake of arriving.
On Monday morning Li Ming posted it.
On the way back from the post office he passed that building.
The chair downstairs is still there, but nobody sits in it now.
He stood and looked at it for a while.
Then he went home.

title: 1. 一封回信
english_summary: The daughter writes back. She wants to come and see the street her mother left, and she asks for one thing that Grandma finds much harder to give than the letters.
content:
回信来得比谁想的都快。
三个星期以后，信箱里有一个厚厚的信封。
李明把它拿上楼，交给奶奶。
奶奶：你念。
信不长。
那个女儿说，她收到了信，看了很多次。
她说她妈妈生前从来没有说过为什么走。
她说她一直以为那是她妈妈自己的选择，跟别人没有关系。
她说现在她知道了，不是这样。
奶奶听到这里，让李明停了一下。
奶奶：接着念。
后面的话是一个问题。
她说她想来看看这条街。
她说她想站在她妈妈住过的那个房子外面。
她说，如果方便，她还想见一见奶奶。
李明念完了，把信放在桌子上。
奶奶没有说话。
过了很久，她站起来去了厨房。
李明听见水的声音。
她在洗一个已经很干净的杯子。
李明：奶奶。
奶奶：我听见了。
李明：您不想见她？
奶奶：我不知道。
李明：为什么？
奶奶把水关了。
奶奶：因为她会问我一件事。
李明：什么事？
奶奶：她会问，你为什么三十年不回信。
奶奶：这个问题我回答不了她。
李明：您可以说您答应过她妈妈。
奶奶：这是理由，不是答案。
她回到桌子旁边坐下。
奶奶：理由是给别人听的。
奶奶：答案是给自己的。
那天晚上，那封信在桌子上放了很久。
谁也没有把它收起来。
english_content:
The reply came sooner than anyone expected.
Three weeks later there was a thick envelope in the letterbox.
Li Ming carried it upstairs and handed it to Grandma.
Grandma: You read it.
It wasn't long.
The daughter said she'd received the letter and had read it many times.
She said her mother had never once said why she left.
She said she'd always assumed it was her mother's own choice and had nothing to do with anyone else.
She said she now knew that wasn't the case.
At that point Grandma had Li Ming stop for a moment.
Grandma: Go on.
What followed was a question.
She said she'd like to come and see the street.
She said she'd like to stand outside the flat her mother had lived in.
And she said that, if it wasn't an imposition, she'd like to meet Grandma.
Li Ming finished and put the letter on the table.
Grandma didn't say anything.
After a long while she got up and went into the kitchen.
Li Ming heard water running.
She was washing a cup that was already clean.
Li Ming: Grandma.
Grandma: I heard.
Li Ming: You don't want to see her?
Grandma: I don't know.
Li Ming: Why not?
She turned off the water.
Grandma: Because she'll ask me something.
Li Ming: What?
Grandma: She'll ask why I didn't write back for thirty years.
Grandma: And I can't answer that for her.
Li Ming: You could say you'd promised her mother.
Grandma: That's a reason, not an answer.
She came back and sat down at the table.
Grandma: Reasons are for other people.
Grandma: Answers are for yourself.
The letter stayed on the table late into the evening.
Nobody put it away.

title: 2. 一个星期的准备
english_summary: Grandma says yes, and then spends a week preparing in ways that have nothing to do with tidying. Li Ming, watching her, works out what she is actually doing.
content:
第二天早上，奶奶让李明写回信。
奶奶：写一行就行。
李明：写什么？
奶奶：写，你来吧。
李明：就这样？
奶奶：就这样。
信寄出去以后，奶奶开始准备。
第一天，她把屋子打扫了一遍。
第二天，她又打扫了一遍。
李明：这里已经很干净了。
奶奶：我知道。
第三天，她去了那个老楼。
她在楼下站了很长时间。
李明陪着她，没有说话。
奶奶：四楼，右边那个窗户。
李明：我们家。
奶奶：那时候她的花放在窗台上。
奶奶：夏天她开着窗，能听见她改作业。
李明：怎么听得见改作业？
奶奶：她一边改一边说话。
奶奶：她说，这个孩子又不认真了。
她说这句话的时候，笑了一下。
第四天，她去了理发店。
第五天，她把那个木箱子从床下面拿出来，放在了桌子上。
第六天，她什么也没有做。
她坐在椅子上看外面。
李明那天下午过去，坐在她旁边。
李明：奶奶，您在想什么？
奶奶：我在想我要说什么。
李明：您想好了吗？
奶奶：没有。
李明：那怎么办？
奶奶：那就到时候再说。
她停了一下。
奶奶：李明，你觉得我做错了吗？
李明想了很久才回答。
李明：我觉得您做的事情，是您那个时候能做的。
奶奶转过头看他。
奶奶：这句话是你自己想的？
李明：是小红说的。
奶奶笑了。
奶奶：那个孩子比你聪明。
english_content:
The next morning Grandma asked Li Ming to write the reply.
Grandma: One line is enough.
Li Ming: Saying what?
Grandma: Saying, come.
Li Ming: That's it?
Grandma: That's it.
Once the letter had gone, Grandma started getting ready.
On the first day she cleaned the flat.
On the second day she cleaned it again.
Li Ming: It's already spotless.
Grandma: I know.
On the third day she went to the old building.
She stood downstairs for a long time.
Li Ming went with her and didn't speak.
Grandma: Fourth floor, the window on the right.
Li Ming: Our flat.
Grandma: Her flowers used to be on that windowsill.
Grandma: In summer she'd leave the window open, and you could hear her marking.
Li Ming: How can you hear someone marking?
Grandma: She talked while she did it.
Grandma: She'd say, this child hasn't tried again.
She smiled slightly as she said it.
On the fourth day she went to the hairdresser.
On the fifth she took the wooden box out from under the bed and put it on the table.
On the sixth day she did nothing at all.
She sat in her chair and looked outside.
Li Ming went over that afternoon and sat beside her.
Li Ming: Grandma, what are you thinking about?
Grandma: I'm thinking about what to say.
Li Ming: Have you decided?
Grandma: No.
Li Ming: So what will you do?
Grandma: I'll work it out when she's here.
She paused.
Grandma: Li Ming, do you think I did the wrong thing?
Li Ming took a long time to answer.
Li Ming: I think what you did was what you could do at the time.
Grandma turned to look at him.
Grandma: Did you come up with that yourself?
Li Ming: Xiao Hong said it.
Grandma laughed.
Grandma: That child is cleverer than you.

title: 3. 星期六上午十点
english_summary: She arrives. She is sixty, and she has her mother's handwriting in her face. The question Grandma has been dreading does get asked — but not in the way she rehearsed, and not first.
content:
星期六上午十点，门铃响了。
李明去开的门。
门外站着一个女的，六十岁左右。
她手里拿着一个小包。
她看见李明，笑了一下。
女儿：你就是写信的那个孩子？
李明：是我。
女儿：谢谢你。
她走进屋子的时候，脚步很慢。
奶奶站起来了。
两个人站在那里看着对方，谁也没有先说话。
李明忽然发现一件事情。
她的样子跟照片上那个人不太像。
可是她站在那里的样子很像。
最后是奶奶先开口的。
奶奶：你像你妈妈。
女儿：大家都这么说。
奶奶：坐吧。
李明去倒了水，然后坐在旁边不说话。
她们先说了一些别的。
路上好走吗。
住在哪里。
这边的天气怎么样。
说了十几分钟以后，屋子里安静下来了。
然后她看着桌子上那个木箱子。
女儿：那是我妈妈的信？
奶奶：都在里面。
女儿：三十封？
奶奶：三十封。
她把手放在箱子上，可是没有打开。
女儿：我不问您为什么不回。
奶奶抬起头看她。
女儿：我路上想了很久这个问题。
女儿：后来我想明白了。
女儿：您要是回了信，我妈妈就会一直等下一封。
女儿：您不回，她就只是写。
屋子里很久没有声音。
女儿：我妈妈这三十年过得很好。
女儿：她写信的时候是高兴的。
女儿：我小时候每年都看见她写。
女儿：我以为那是她的一个习惯。
她停了一下。
女儿：现在我知道，那是她跟这条街说话。
english_content:
At ten o'clock on Saturday morning the doorbell rang.
Li Ming answered it.
Outside stood a woman of about sixty.
She was holding a small bag.
She saw Li Ming and smiled.
Daughter: You're the boy who wrote?
Li Ming: That's me.
Daughter: Thank you.
She walked into the flat slowly.
Grandma stood up.
The two of them stood looking at each other, and neither spoke first.
Li Ming noticed something.
Her face didn't look much like the woman in the photograph.
But the way she stood there did.
In the end it was Grandma who spoke.
Grandma: You look like your mother.
Daughter: Everyone says so.
Grandma: Sit down.
Li Ming poured water and sat to one side without speaking.
They talked about other things first.
Whether the journey was easy.
Where she was staying.
What the weather was like here.
After ten-odd minutes, the room went quiet.
Then she looked at the wooden box on the table.
Daughter: Are those my mother's letters?
Grandma: All of them.
Daughter: Thirty?
Grandma: Thirty.
She put her hand on the box but didn't open it.
Daughter: I'm not going to ask why you didn't write back.
Grandma looked up at her.
Daughter: I thought about that question the whole way here.
Daughter: And then I understood it.
Daughter: If you had written back, my mother would have spent her life waiting for the next one.
Daughter: Because you didn't, she simply wrote.
There was no sound in the room for a long time.
Daughter: My mother's thirty years were good ones.
Daughter: She was happy when she wrote those letters.
Daughter: I watched her write one every year when I was small.
Daughter: I thought it was just a habit of hers.
She paused.
Daughter: Now I know it was her talking to this street.

title: 4. 楼下的椅子
english_summary: They walk the street together, and it turns out the daughter knows it better than Li Ming does — from thirty years of letters describing a place she had never once seen.
content:
下午，她们出去走了走。
李明也去了。
奶奶走得慢，她就走得更慢。
她们从老楼那边开始走。
到了楼下，她抬头看了很久。
女儿：四楼，右边。
李明：您怎么知道？
女儿：我妈妈信里写过。
她们往前走。
路过面店的时候，她停下来了。
女儿：这里以前是不是有一个卖面的？
李明：现在也有。
女儿：我妈妈说那家的面很好。
奶奶：那是老王。现在是他孙女在做。
女儿：那我们能去吃吗？
姑娘正在门口收拾东西。
奶奶跟她说了几句话。
姑娘看了看那个女的，然后进去了。
她出来的时候，手里是三碗面。
她们坐在最里面那张桌子。
那个女的吃了一口，停了很久。
女儿：我妈妈说过这个味道。
女儿：她说，这个味道让人觉得自己回到家了。
她说完，眼睛红了。
可是她还是把那碗面吃完了。
吃完以后，她们又往前走。
走到那个大楼下面的时候，她问了一个问题。
女儿：这里以前是什么？
奶奶：是一片小房子。
女儿：我妈妈写过。
女儿：她说这边下午的太阳最好。
奶奶：现在没有太阳了。
她抬头看了看那个楼。
女儿：可是那些树她也写过。
女儿：她说树会长高。
她走过去，用手摸了摸一棵树。
女儿：这棵有三十年了吧。
奶奶：差不多。
女儿：那她说对了。
english_content:
In the afternoon they went out for a walk.
Li Ming went too.
Grandma walks slowly, and she walked more slowly still.
They started at the old building.
Downstairs, she looked up for a long time.
Daughter: Fourth floor, on the right.
Li Ming: How did you know?
Daughter: My mother wrote about it.
They walked on.
As they passed the noodle shop she stopped.
Daughter: Did someone used to sell noodles here?
Li Ming: Someone still does.
Daughter: My mother said the noodles here were good.
Grandma: That was Old Wang. His granddaughter makes them now.
Daughter: Could we eat here?
The young woman was clearing up in the doorway.
Grandma said a few words to her.
The young woman looked at the visitor, then went inside.
When she came out she was carrying three bowls.
They sat at the table right at the back.
The woman took one mouthful and stopped for a long time.
Daughter: My mother described this.
Daughter: She said it tastes like being home again.
As she said it her eyes reddened.
But she finished the bowl.
Afterwards they walked on.
When they reached the foot of the tall building she asked something.
Daughter: What was here before?
Grandma: A row of small houses.
Daughter: My mother wrote about that.
Daughter: She said the afternoon sun was best on this side.
Grandma: There's no sun here now.
She looked up at the building.
Daughter: But she wrote about these trees too.
Daughter: She said the trees would grow.
She went over and put her hand on one of them.
Daughter: This one must be thirty years old.
Grandma: About that.
Daughter: Then she was right.

title: 5. 一年一封
english_summary: She leaves on Sunday evening. Before she goes she makes an arrangement with Grandma, and Li Ming is given a job that will outlast both of them.
content:
星期日晚上的火车是七点的。
下午四点，她来跟奶奶说再见。
她把那个木箱子推回到奶奶那边。
女儿：这个您留着。
奶奶：这是你妈妈的字。
女儿：我家里有她别的东西。
女儿：这些信是写给您的。
奶奶没有再说什么，把手放在箱子上。
女儿：我想问您一件事。
奶奶：你说。
女儿：我可以每年写一封吗？
奶奶抬起头。
女儿：不是为了我妈妈。
女儿：是我自己想写。
奶奶看着她，很久。
奶奶：我八十六了。
女儿：我知道。
奶奶：我可能回不了几年。
女儿：那也没有关系。
奶奶：为什么？
女儿：因为我妈妈教过我，写信这件事，不用等回信。
奶奶笑了，可是眼睛是湿的。
奶奶：好。
女儿：那说好了。
然后她转过来看李明。
女儿：还有你。
李明：我？
女儿：等有一天她们两个都不在了。
女儿：我希望还有一个人知道这件事。
李明：知道什么？
女儿：知道有两个人，三十年没有见面，可是一直在说话。
李明站在那里，一下子说不出话。
最后他点了点头。
李明：我知道了。
她走的时候，奶奶送她到楼下。
那把旧椅子还在原来的地方。
她看了那把椅子一眼，然后上了车。
车开走以后，奶奶在楼下站了一会儿。
李明：您冷不冷？
奶奶：不冷。
她看着车走的那个方向。
奶奶：三十年了。
奶奶：我今天才知道，她一直知道我在这里。
english_content:
Sunday's train was at seven in the evening.
At four in the afternoon she came to say goodbye.
She pushed the wooden box back across to Grandma.
Daughter: You keep this.
Grandma: It's your mother's handwriting.
Daughter: I have other things of hers at home.
Daughter: These letters were written to you.
Grandma said nothing more and rested her hand on the box.
Daughter: I want to ask you something.
Grandma: Go on.
Daughter: May I write one a year?
Grandma looked up.
Daughter: Not for my mother's sake.
Daughter: Because I want to.
Grandma looked at her for a long time.
Grandma: I'm eighty-six.
Daughter: I know.
Grandma: I may not have many years of replies in me.
Daughter: That doesn't matter.
Grandma: Why not?
Daughter: Because my mother taught me that writing letters doesn't require an answer.
Grandma laughed, though her eyes were wet.
Grandma: All right.
Daughter: Then that's agreed.
Then she turned to Li Ming.
Daughter: And you.
Li Ming: Me?
Daughter: One day neither of them will be here.
Daughter: I'd like there to still be someone who knows about this.
Li Ming: Knows what?
Daughter: That two people went thirty years without meeting, and talked the whole time.
Li Ming stood there, momentarily unable to speak.
In the end he nodded.
Li Ming: I understand.
When she left, Grandma saw her down to the street.
The old chair is still in its place.
She glanced at the chair, then got into the car.
After it pulled away, Grandma stood downstairs for a while.
Li Ming: Are you cold?
Grandma: No.
She watched the direction the car had gone.
Grandma: Thirty years.
Grandma: And only today did I find out she always knew I was here.

title: 1. 妈妈很忙
english_summary: Mum comes home late again and eats almost nothing. Li Ming works out how long a dinner takes, decides he can do that — and then remembers he cannot cook.
content:
星期一晚上七点，妈妈回家了。
她坐在椅子上，没有说话。
李明：您吃饭了吗？
妈妈：还没有。
李明：那我们吃什么？
妈妈：我做。
她去做饭了。
李明在房间里写汉字。
七点半，他听见妈妈在打电话。
妈妈：对，明天上午。我知道了。
八点，他们吃晚饭。
米饭，一个菜。
妈妈：好吃吗？
李明：好吃。
妈妈没有吃多少。
李明：您怎么了？
妈妈：有点儿忙。
李明：明天呢？
妈妈：明天也忙。
李明：星期三呢？
妈妈：李明。
李明：什么？
妈妈：这个月都很忙。
她喝了一点儿水，看了看他。
妈妈：你去休息吧。
李明回房间了。
他没有睡觉。
他在想一件事。
一个人做饭，要多少时间？
妈妈做了四十分钟。
四十分钟，他也有。
他想做一天的晚饭。
他不会做饭。
english_content:
Monday evening, seven o'clock, Mum came home.
She sat down on the chair and said nothing.
Li Ming: Have you eaten?
Mum: Not yet.
Li Ming: So what are we eating?
Mum: I'll make something.
She went off to cook.
Li Ming was in his room writing characters.
At half past seven he heard Mum on the phone.
Mum: Yes, tomorrow morning. Understood.
At eight they had dinner.
Rice, one dish.
Mum: Is it good?
Li Ming: It's good.
Mum didn't eat much.
Li Ming: What's wrong?
Mum: Just a bit busy.
Li Ming: And tomorrow?
Mum: Tomorrow too.
Li Ming: Wednesday?
Mum: Li Ming.
Li Ming: What?
Mum: This whole month is busy.
She drank a little water and looked at him.
Mum: Go and rest.
Li Ming went back to his room.
He didn't sleep.
He was thinking about something.
How long does it take one person to cook?
Mum had taken forty minutes.
Forty minutes — he had that too.
He wanted to make dinner, one day.
He couldn't cook.

title: 2. 小红家的鸡蛋
english_summary: Li Ming asks the one classmate who can actually cook. Xiao Hong does not ask why for long — she boils water, times three minutes, and sends him home with two eggs.
content:
星期二中午，李明找小红。
李明：你会做饭吗？
小红：会一点儿。
李明：你会做什么？
小红：面条儿。
李明：面条儿好做吗？
小红：好做。
李明：那你做，我看。
小红：怎么了？
李明：我想做晚饭。
小红：你？
李明：对。
小红：你妈妈知道吗？
李明：不知道。
小红没有说话。
小红：下午来我家。
下午四点，李明到小红家。
房间不大，桌子也不大。
桌子上有鸡蛋，还有面条儿。
小红：鸡蛋要早一点儿做。
李明：早一点儿？
小红：对。面条儿三分钟，鸡蛋不是三分钟。
水开了。
小红：面条儿下水。
李明：三分钟？
小红：三分钟。你看时间。
李明看手机，一分钟，两分钟，三分钟。
小红：好了。
她做了两个鸡蛋，一个给他。
李明：真好吃。
小红：这个很好做。
李明：我明天做。
小红：明天你妈妈回家几点？
李明：七点半。
小红：那你一个人做。
李明：对。
她给他两个鸡蛋。
小红：这些你回家做。
english_content:
Tuesday midday, Li Ming went to find Xiao Hong.
Li Ming: Can you cook?
Xiao Hong: A little.
Li Ming: What can you make?
Xiao Hong: Noodles.
Li Ming: Are noodles easy to make?
Xiao Hong: Easy.
Li Ming: Then you make them and I'll watch.
Xiao Hong: What's going on?
Li Ming: I want to make dinner.
Xiao Hong: You?
Li Ming: Yes.
Xiao Hong: Does your mum know?
Li Ming: No.
Xiao Hong said nothing.
Xiao Hong: Come to my place this afternoon.
At four in the afternoon Li Ming got to Xiao Hong's.
The room was small, and so was the table.
On the table there were eggs, and noodles.
Xiao Hong: The eggs have to go on earlier.
Li Ming: Earlier?
Xiao Hong: Yes. Noodles are three minutes. Eggs aren't three minutes.
The water boiled.
Xiao Hong: Noodles in.
Li Ming: Three minutes?
Xiao Hong: Three minutes. Watch the clock.
Li Ming watched his phone: one minute, two minutes, three minutes.
Xiao Hong: Done.
She did two eggs and gave him one.
Li Ming: This is really good.
Xiao Hong: It's an easy one.
Li Ming: I'll do it tomorrow.
Xiao Hong: What time is your mum home tomorrow?
Li Ming: Half past seven.
Xiao Hong: So you'll be doing it alone.
Li Ming: Yes.
She gave him two eggs.
Xiao Hong: Make these at home.

title: 3. 我一个人做饭
english_summary: Two and a half hours, water, noodles, two eggs. He goes to look for a cup, comes back to a pot with no water in it, and lies to his mother for the first time.
content:
星期三下午五点，家里没有人。
李明看了一下时间。
妈妈七点半回家。
两个半小时。
他有水，有面条儿，还有两个鸡蛋。
他做饭了。
水有点儿热，还不开。
他看手机。
五点十分。
五点二十。
水开了。
他想小红说的一件事。
鸡蛋要早一点儿做。
他没有做鸡蛋。
面条儿在水里，三分钟。
他去房间里找一个杯子。
他找了五分钟。
面条儿在水里，八分钟。
他回来的时候，水没有了。
面条儿不好看。
他吃了一口。
不好吃。
真的不好吃。
大毛在外边。
李明：大毛，你吃吗？
大毛看了看，没有吃。
李明：你也不吃。
他一个人吃了一半。
六点半，桌子上没有东西了。
七点半，妈妈回家。
妈妈：你吃了吗？
李明：吃了。
妈妈：吃了什么？
李明：面条儿。
妈妈：谁做的？
李明：我。
妈妈：好吃吗？
李明：好吃。
这不是真的。
english_content:
Wednesday, five in the afternoon: nobody home.
Li Ming checked the time.
Mum would be back at half past seven.
Two and a half hours.
He had water, noodles, and two eggs.
He started cooking.
The water got warm; it wasn't boiling yet.
He looked at his phone.
Ten past five.
Twenty past.
The water boiled.
He remembered one thing Xiao Hong had said.
The eggs go on earlier.
He hadn't done the eggs.
The noodles went in. Three minutes.
He went to his room to find a cup.
He looked for five minutes.
The noodles were in the water for eight.
When he came back, the water was gone.
The noodles did not look good.
He ate one mouthful.
Not good.
Really not good.
Da Mao was outside.
Li Ming: Da Mao, do you want this?
Da Mao had a look and didn't eat it.
Li Ming: Even you won't eat it.
He ate half of it by himself.
By half six there was nothing left on the table.
At half seven Mum came home.
Mum: Have you eaten?
Li Ming: Yes.
Mum: What did you have?
Li Ming: Noodles.
Mum: Who made them?
Li Ming: Me.
Mum: Were they good?
Li Ming: They were good.
That was not true.

title: 4. 二十块钱
english_summary: Twenty yuan, and apples cost three each. At the shop door he runs into his teacher, and finds out he had the noodles in the water for five minutes too long.
content:
星期四下午，李明去超市。
他有二十块钱。
面条儿六块。
鸡蛋一个一块。
菜八块。
六块和八块，十四块。
还有六块。
他想买一些水果。
苹果一个三块。
两个苹果六块，钱都没有了。
店员：小朋友，你买什么？
李明：我在看。
店员：你一个人来？
李明：对。
店员：你妈妈呢？
李明：她在上班。
店员：她几点下班？
李明：七点。
店员：那你回家吃什么？
李明：我做饭。
店员没有说话。
店员：面条儿在那边。
李明：谢谢。
他买了面条儿，鸡蛋，还有菜。
十四块。
他没有买苹果。
在店外边，他看见老师。
老师：李明？
李明：老师好。
老师：你买东西？
李明：我买晚饭的东西。
老师：你会做饭？
李明：会一点儿。
老师：真好。
李明：老师，我问您一件事。
老师：你说。
李明：面条儿在水里，要几分钟？
老师：三分钟。
李明：小红也说三分钟。
老师：你做了几分钟？
李明：八分钟。
老师：那不好吃。
李明：对。
老师：你明天再做。
李明：好。
english_content:
Thursday afternoon, Li Ming went to the supermarket.
He had twenty yuan.
Noodles, six.
Eggs, one yuan each.
Vegetables, eight.
Six and eight is fourteen.
Six left.
He wanted to buy some fruit.
Apples were three each.
Two apples is six, and then the money is gone.
Shop assistant: What are you after, young man?
Li Ming: I'm just looking.
Shop assistant: Here on your own?
Li Ming: Yes.
Shop assistant: Where's your mum?
Li Ming: She's at work.
Shop assistant: What time does she finish?
Li Ming: Seven.
Shop assistant: So what do you eat when you get home?
Li Ming: I cook.
The assistant didn't say anything.
Shop assistant: Noodles are over there.
Li Ming: Thank you.
He bought noodles, eggs and vegetables.
Fourteen yuan.
He didn't buy the apples.
Outside the shop he saw his teacher.
Teacher: Li Ming?
Li Ming: Hello, teacher.
Teacher: Doing the shopping?
Li Ming: I'm buying things for dinner.
Teacher: You cook?
Li Ming: A little.
Teacher: That's good.
Li Ming: Teacher, can I ask you something?
Teacher: Go ahead.
Li Ming: How many minutes do noodles go in the water?
Teacher: Three.
Li Ming: Xiao Hong said three too.
Teacher: How long did you do?
Li Ming: Eight.
Teacher: Then it wasn't good.
Li Ming: No, it wasn't.
Teacher: Make it again tomorrow.
Li Ming: All right.

title: 5. 六点，七点，八点
english_summary: Saturday. He gets it right at half past five, and she doesn't come. At half seven he cooks the whole thing a second time, so that what she eats at eight is hot.
content:
星期六上午，妈妈上班。
她说下午六点回家。
李明五点做饭。
这一天他早一点儿做鸡蛋。
水开了，面条儿下水，三分钟。
三分钟他都在看时间。
五点半，饭好了。
两个鸡蛋，一些菜，还有面条儿。
桌子上有两个杯子。
六点，妈妈没有回来。
六点半，妈妈没有回来。
七点，他打电话。
妈妈：喂？
李明：您几点回家？
妈妈：八点。对不起。
李明：没事。
他看桌子上的饭。
饭不热了。
面条儿也不好看了。
他坐下，没有吃。
七点半，他做了新的。
水，鸡蛋，面条儿。
八点，妈妈回家。
妈妈：我真的对不起。
李明：没关系。
妈妈：你吃了吗？
李明：没有。
桌子上有两个人的饭。
妈妈坐下，没有说话。
妈妈：这是你做的？
李明：对。
妈妈：什么时候做的？
李明：七点半。
妈妈：那六点的呢？
李明：六点的不热了。
妈妈没有说话。
她吃了一口。
妈妈：好吃。
李明：真的吗？
妈妈：真的。
english_content:
Saturday morning, Mum was at work.
She said she'd be home at six.
Li Ming started cooking at five.
This time he put the eggs on early.
The water boiled, the noodles went in, three minutes.
For all three minutes he watched the clock.
Half past five: dinner was ready.
Two eggs, some vegetables, and the noodles.
There were two cups on the table.
Six o'clock: Mum wasn't back.
Half six: Mum wasn't back.
At seven he phoned.
Mum: Hello?
Li Ming: What time are you home?
Mum: Eight. I'm sorry.
Li Ming: It's fine.
He looked at the food on the table.
It wasn't hot any more.
The noodles didn't look good any more either.
He sat down and didn't eat.
At half seven he made it again from the start.
Water, eggs, noodles.
At eight Mum came home.
Mum: I really am sorry.
Li Ming: It's all right.
Mum: Have you eaten?
Li Ming: No.
On the table there was food for two.
Mum sat down and said nothing.
Mum: You made this?
Li Ming: Yes.
Mum: When did you make it?
Li Ming: Half past seven.
Mum: And the six o'clock one?
Li Ming: The six o'clock one went cold.
Mum didn't say anything.
She ate one mouthful.
Mum: It's good.
Li Ming: Really?
Mum: Really.

title: 6. 六点，星期六
english_summary: She tells him the truth about the noodles, and then what she was actually eating. Next Saturday at six, and she says it like a thing she intends to keep.
content:
星期日上午，妈妈没有上班。
她在房间里休息。
李明：妈妈。
妈妈：什么事？
李明：昨天的面条儿，真的好吃吗？
妈妈：你要我说真的？
李明：对。
妈妈：不太好吃。
李明：我知道。
妈妈：菜有点儿多。
李明：还有呢？
妈妈：水太少。
李明：还有呢？
妈妈：没有了。
李明：那您怎么说好吃？
妈妈：我吃的不是面条儿。
李明：那是什么？
妈妈：是七点半。
李明：七点半？
妈妈：六点你做好了，我没有回来。
妈妈：七点半你再做一回。
李明没有说话。
李明：那也不好吃。
妈妈：下个星期你再做。
李明：您想吃？
妈妈：想。
妈妈：星期六，六点。
李明：您六点回家吗？
妈妈：我六点回家。
李明：真的？
妈妈：真的。
她看了一下手机，再看他。
妈妈：这个月我很忙。
妈妈：星期六不忙。
李明很高兴。
李明：那我做三个菜。
妈妈：一个菜。
李明：两个。
妈妈：好。
外边，大毛在椅子上睡觉。
天很好。
李明想，明天问小红，菜怎么做。
english_content:
Sunday morning, Mum wasn't working.
She was resting in her room.
Li Ming: Mum.
Mum: What is it?
Li Ming: Yesterday's noodles — were they really good?
Mum: Do you want the true answer?
Li Ming: Yes.
Mum: Not very good.
Li Ming: I know.
Mum: A bit too much veg.
Li Ming: What else?
Mum: Not enough water.
Li Ming: What else?
Mum: That's all.
Li Ming: Then why did you say it was good?
Mum: What I was eating wasn't the noodles.
Li Ming: Then what was it?
Mum: It was half past seven.
Li Ming: Half past seven?
Mum: You had it ready at six and I wasn't there.
Mum: At half seven you made the whole thing again.
Li Ming didn't say anything.
Li Ming: It still wasn't good.
Mum: Make it again next week.
Li Ming: You want to eat it?
Mum: I do.
Mum: Saturday, six o'clock.
Li Ming: Will you be home at six?
Mum: I will be home at six.
Li Ming: Really?
Mum: Really.
She glanced at her phone, then looked back at him.
Mum: This month I'm busy.
Mum: Saturday I'm not busy.
Li Ming was very happy.
Li Ming: Then I'll make three dishes.
Mum: One dish.
Li Ming: Two.
Mum: All right.
Outside, Da Mao was asleep on the chair.
It was a fine day.
Li Ming thought: tomorrow, ask Xiao Hong how to do the vegetables.

title: 1. 椅子上没有猫
english_summary: The white cat has sat on the chair outside the shop every day for as long as Li Ming can remember. On Monday it is not there, and nobody else has noticed.
content:
星期一，下午四点，李明下课回家。
店外边有一个椅子。
天天有一个猫在那个椅子上。
猫的名字叫大毛。
大毛不是一个人的猫。
这边的人都给它一点儿吃的东西。
今天，椅子上没有猫。
李明看了看店里。
店员：你找什么？
李明：大毛。
店员：谁？
李明：外边椅子上的那个猫。
店员：它不是天天在。
李明：它天天在。
店员：那我不知道。
李明在店外边坐了十分钟。
大毛没有来。
五点，天有点儿冷。
他回家了。
星期二，椅子上也没有猫。
星期三，也没有。
李明问小明。
小明：一个猫，你找它做什么？
李明：它天天在那儿。
小明：猫都不听人的。
李明：这个猫听。
小明：听什么？
李明：我叫它，它看我。
小明：那是它想吃东西。
李明：不是。
小明：那是什么？
李明没有说话。
星期四下午，他再去那个店。
椅子上有人。
那个人有八十多岁。
她在看外边，没有看他。
李明想问她一件事。
他没有问。
english_content:
Monday, four in the afternoon, Li Ming walked home from school.
There is a chair outside the shop.
Every day there is a cat on that chair.
The cat is called Da Mao.
Da Mao is nobody's cat.
Everyone on this street gives it a little something to eat.
Today there was no cat on the chair.
Li Ming looked into the shop.
Shop assistant: Looking for something?
Li Ming: Da Mao.
Shop assistant: Who?
Li Ming: The cat on the chair outside.
Shop assistant: It isn't here every day.
Li Ming: It is here every day.
Shop assistant: Well, I wouldn't know.
Li Ming sat outside the shop for ten minutes.
Da Mao didn't come.
At five it turned a bit cold.
He went home.
Tuesday: no cat on the chair either.
Wednesday: none.
Li Ming asked Xiao Ming.
Xiao Ming: It's a cat. What do you want with it?
Li Ming: It's there every day.
Xiao Ming: Cats don't listen to anyone.
Li Ming: This one listens.
Xiao Ming: Listens to what?
Li Ming: I call it and it looks at me.
Xiao Ming: That's it wanting food.
Li Ming: It isn't.
Xiao Ming: Then what is it?
Li Ming didn't answer.
Thursday afternoon he went back to the shop.
There was someone on the chair.
She was over eighty.
She was looking out at the street, not at him.
Li Ming wanted to ask her something.
He didn't.

title: 2. 椅子上的人
english_summary: She has been on that chair the whole time, and she knows exactly where the cat is. She has known for five days. She has not told anyone, because nobody asked.
content:
星期五下午，那个人还在椅子上。
李明在店外边坐下。
奶奶：你天天来。
李明：您也天天来。
奶奶：我住在这边。
李明：我想问您一件事。
奶奶：你问。
李明：这边有一个猫。
奶奶：大毛。
李明：您认识它？
奶奶：这边的人都认识它。
李明：它在哪儿？
她没有说话。
她看了看店的那边。
奶奶：它在我家。
李明：在您家？
奶奶：对。
李明：它怎么了？
奶奶：它生病了。
李明：什么病？
奶奶：我不知道。
奶奶：它不吃东西。
李明：几天了？
奶奶：五天。
李明：五天不吃东西？
奶奶：它喝一点儿水。
李明：那要看病。
奶奶：猫看病，钱不少。
李明：多少钱？
奶奶：我不知道。
李明：您问了吗？
奶奶：没有。
李明：那我们问一下。
她看了看他。
奶奶：你叫什么名字？
李明：李明。
奶奶：李明。
她说了这两个字，没有再说话。
english_content:
Friday afternoon, she was on the chair again.
Li Ming sat down outside the shop.
Grandma: You come every day.
Li Ming: So do you.
Grandma: I live here.
Li Ming: I want to ask you something.
Grandma: Ask.
Li Ming: There's a cat around here.
Grandma: Da Mao.
Li Ming: You know it?
Grandma: Everyone here knows it.
Li Ming: Where is it?
She said nothing.
She looked past the shop.
Grandma: It's at my place.
Li Ming: At your place?
Grandma: Yes.
Li Ming: What's wrong with it?
Grandma: It's ill.
Li Ming: What kind of illness?
Grandma: I don't know.
Grandma: It won't eat.
Li Ming: For how long?
Grandma: Five days.
Li Ming: Five days without eating?
Grandma: It drinks a little water.
Li Ming: Then it needs a doctor.
Grandma: A doctor for a cat isn't cheap.
Li Ming: How much?
Grandma: I don't know.
Li Ming: Did you ask?
Grandma: No.
Li Ming: Then let's ask.
She looked at him.
Grandma: What's your name?
Li Ming: Li Ming.
Grandma: Li Ming.
She said the two syllables and said nothing more.

title: 3. 大毛不吃东西
english_summary: Her flat is one room, one table, two chairs, and a cat that has not eaten in six days. The vet costs a hundred and something. She says she has it. Li Ming does not ask twice.
content:
星期六上午，李明到奶奶家。
房间很小，有一个桌子，两个椅子。
大毛在椅子上。
它很小，很多天没有吃东西了。
李明：大毛。
猫看了他一下。
李明：它认识我。
奶奶：它认识这边的人。
李明：它吃了吗？
奶奶：没有。
桌子上有一些菜，还有一点儿牛奶。
奶奶：牛奶它也不喝。
李明：多少天了？
奶奶：六天。
李明：我问了老师。
奶奶：你老师是医生？
李明：不是。
李明：她说，猫六天不吃东西，是病。
奶奶：我知道是病。
李明：那我们去。
奶奶：去哪儿？
李明：给猫看病的那个店。
奶奶：这边没有。
李明：学校那边有一个。
奶奶：多少钱？
李明：一百多块。
她没有说话。
李明：您有吗？
奶奶：我有。
李明：那我们明天去。
奶奶：明天下雪。
李明：下雪也去。
奶奶：你上课。
李明：明天是星期日。
她看了看猫。
奶奶：好。
李明很高兴。
奶奶：李明。
李明：什么？
奶奶：谢谢你。
李明：不客气。
他回家的时候，外边正在下雪。
english_content:
Saturday morning, Li Ming went to her flat.
One small room: a table and two chairs.
Da Mao was on one of the chairs.
It looked small. It hadn't eaten in days.
Li Ming: Da Mao.
The cat glanced at him.
Li Ming: It knows me.
Grandma: It knows everyone here.
Li Ming: Has it eaten?
Grandma: No.
On the table were some vegetables and a little milk.
Grandma: It won't drink the milk either.
Li Ming: How many days now?
Grandma: Six.
Li Ming: I asked my teacher.
Grandma: Is your teacher a doctor?
Li Ming: No.
Li Ming: She said six days without food means it's ill.
Grandma: I know it's ill.
Li Ming: Then let's go.
Grandma: Go where?
Li Ming: The place that treats cats.
Grandma: There isn't one here.
Li Ming: There's one over by the school.
Grandma: How much?
Li Ming: A hundred and something.
She said nothing.
Li Ming: Do you have it?
Grandma: I have it.
Li Ming: Then we go tomorrow.
Grandma: It'll snow tomorrow.
Li Ming: We go anyway.
Grandma: You have school.
Li Ming: Tomorrow is Sunday.
She looked at the cat.
Grandma: All right.
Li Ming was pleased.
Grandma: Li Ming.
Li Ming: Yes?
Grandma: Thank you.
Li Ming: You're welcome.
On his way home it had already started to snow.

title: 4. 下雪的星期日
english_summary: A taxi through the snow, a vet who asks how old the cat is, and eighty yuan instead of a hundred and something. The twenty they did not spend buys two hot buns.
content:
星期日上午八点，外边都是雪。
天很冷。
李明到奶奶家。
她在房间里，大毛在她的椅子上。
奶奶：外边冷吗？
李明：很冷。
奶奶：那我们坐出租车。
李明：出租车多少钱？
奶奶：不多。
他们坐出租车去学校那边。
给猫看病的那个店在书店那边。
医生是一个女士。
医生：这个猫多少岁？
奶奶：我不知道。
奶奶：我认识它八年了。
医生：八年？
奶奶：八年，也可以是九年。
医生看了看大毛。
医生：它的问题不大。
李明：不大？
医生：它的口不好，吃东西的时候很不好。
李明：那怎么做？
医生给了她一些东西。
医生：上午一点儿，晚上一点儿。
奶奶：它会吃吗？
医生：会。
奶奶：多少钱？
医生：八十块。
她给了钱。
在外边，雪还在下。
奶奶：八十块。
李明：您说一百多。
奶奶：我想的是一百多。
李明：那少了二十多。
奶奶：对。
她看了看李明。
奶奶：这二十块，我们买东西吃。
他们在店里买了两个包子。
一个给李明，一个是她的。
包子很热。
李明：真好吃。
奶奶：这边的包子，四十年都是这个。
李明：四十年？
奶奶：四十年。
english_content:
Sunday, eight in the morning: snow everywhere.
It was cold.
Li Ming went to her flat.
She was inside; Da Mao was on her chair.
Grandma: Is it cold out?
Li Ming: Very.
Grandma: Then we take a taxi.
Li Ming: How much is a taxi?
Grandma: Not much.
They took a taxi over to the school side.
The place that treats cats is near the bookshop.
The doctor was a woman.
Doctor: How old is this cat?
Grandma: I don't know.
Grandma: I've known it eight years.
Doctor: Eight years?
Grandma: Eight. Could be nine.
The doctor looked Da Mao over.
Doctor: It's not serious.
Li Ming: Not serious?
Doctor: Its mouth is bad. Eating hurts.
Li Ming: So what do we do?
The doctor gave her some medicine.
Doctor: A little in the morning, a little in the evening.
Grandma: Will it take it?
Doctor: It will.
Grandma: How much?
Doctor: Eighty.
She paid.
Outside, it was still snowing.
Grandma: Eighty.
Li Ming: You said a hundred and something.
Grandma: That's what I had in mind.
Li Ming: So it's twenty-odd less.
Grandma: Yes.
She looked at Li Ming.
Grandma: We'll spend that twenty on something to eat.
They bought two buns in a shop.
One for Li Ming, one for her.
The buns were hot.
Li Ming: These are really good.
Grandma: The buns here have been the same for forty years.
Li Ming: Forty years?
Grandma: Forty years.

title: 5. 四号房间
english_summary: The cat comes back to the chair, and the woman does not. She is in the hospital for four days, and Li Ming volunteers to feed Da Mao — then Xiao Ming, who does not like cats, volunteers too.
content:
大毛吃了那些东西。
第二天，它喝了一点儿牛奶。
第三天，它吃了一点儿菜。
星期五，它回到店外边的椅子上。
李明天天去看它。
下个星期一，椅子上有猫，没有人。
李明：奶奶呢？
店员：她在医院。
李明：她怎么了？
店员：她生病了。
李明：什么病？
店员：我不知道。
李明：哪个医院？
店员：学校那边的。
下午，李明和小明去医院。
医院很大，人很多。
他们问了三个人。
她在四号房间。
奶奶：你们怎么来了？
李明：我们看您。
奶奶：我没事。
李明：您有病。
奶奶：一点儿病。
小明：我们给您买了苹果。
奶奶：谢谢。
李明：大毛在椅子上。
奶奶：它吃东西了吗？
李明：吃了。
奶奶：吃了什么？
李明：菜，还有一点儿鸡蛋。
奶奶：好。
李明：您几天回家？
奶奶：医生说，四天。
李明：那大毛呢？
奶奶：它在外边，大家都给它吃的。
李明：我给它。
奶奶：你？
李明：我天天去。
奶奶：四天？
李明：四天。
她看了看小明。
小明：他说的都是真的。
奶奶：好。
他们回家的时候，天很晚了。
小明：你天天去？
李明：对。
小明：那我也去。
李明：你不是不喜欢猫？
小明：我不喜欢猫。
李明：那你去做什么？
小明没有说话。
english_content:
Da Mao took the medicine.
The next day it drank a little milk.
The day after that it ate a little food.
On Friday it was back on the chair outside the shop.
Li Ming went to see it every day.
The following Monday there was a cat on the chair and no one beside it.
Li Ming: Where's the old lady?
Shop assistant: She's in hospital.
Li Ming: What happened?
Shop assistant: She's ill.
Li Ming: Ill with what?
Shop assistant: I don't know.
Li Ming: Which hospital?
Shop assistant: The one by the school.
That afternoon Li Ming and Xiao Ming went to the hospital.
It was big and full of people.
They asked three people.
She was in room four.
Grandma: What are you two doing here?
Li Ming: We came to see you.
Grandma: I'm fine.
Li Ming: You're ill.
Grandma: A little ill.
Xiao Ming: We brought you apples.
Grandma: Thank you.
Li Ming: Da Mao's on the chair.
Grandma: Has it been eating?
Li Ming: It has.
Grandma: What did it have?
Li Ming: Vegetables, and a bit of egg.
Grandma: Good.
Li Ming: How many days till you go home?
Grandma: The doctor says four.
Li Ming: And Da Mao?
Grandma: It's out there. Everyone feeds it.
Li Ming: I'll feed it.
Grandma: You?
Li Ming: Every day.
Grandma: Four days?
Li Ming: Four days.
She looked at Xiao Ming.
Xiao Ming: He means it.
Grandma: All right.
It was late by the time they walked home.
Xiao Ming: You're really going every day?
Li Ming: Yes.
Xiao Ming: Then I'm going too.
Li Ming: I thought you didn't like cats.
Xiao Ming: I don't like cats.
Li Ming: So why are you coming?
Xiao Ming didn't answer.

title: 6. 您叫什么名字
english_summary: She comes back to the chair. Li Ming finally asks her name, and finds out she has known his for two weeks — from a question he asked a shop assistant while she sat two metres away.
content:
星期六上午，奶奶回家了。
她到店外边，坐在那个椅子上。
大毛在椅子上睡觉。
它看见她，还在那儿睡觉。
奶奶：它这些天吃东西了吗？
李明：天天吃。
奶奶：谁给的？
李明：我。
小明：我们两个。
奶奶：你们两个。
李明：小明也天天来。
小明：我一天没有来。
李明：一天。
奶奶：一天没关系。
天很好，不冷了。
李明坐在她那边。
李明：奶奶，我问您一件事。
奶奶：你问。
李明：您叫什么名字？
她没有说话。
她看了看外边。
奶奶：你怎么想问这个？
李明：我认识您两个星期了。
李明：我不知道您的名字。
奶奶：你不知道，我知道你的。
李明：那不对。
奶奶：好。
她说了三个字。
李明没有听见。
奶奶：你没有听见？
李明：没有。
奶奶：那我再说一回。
她再说了一回。
这一天李明听见了。
他没有说什么。
奶奶：怎么了？
李明：我的名字，您怎么知道的？
奶奶：那天你问店员。
李明：那是十四天前的事。
奶奶：对。
李明：您那天在椅子上。
奶奶：我天天在椅子上。
大毛在她那边睡觉。
天上没有雪了。
李明想，明年这个时候，椅子上也有一个猫。
他想，那个时候，椅子上也有她。
奶奶：李明。
李明：什么？
奶奶：明天你来吗？
李明：我天天来。
english_content:
Saturday morning, she came home.
She went out to the shop and sat down on the chair.
Da Mao was asleep on it.
It saw her and went on sleeping.
Grandma: Has it been eating?
Li Ming: Every day.
Grandma: Who fed it?
Li Ming: Me.
Xiao Ming: Both of us.
Grandma: Both of you.
Li Ming: Xiao Ming came every day too.
Xiao Ming: I missed one day.
Li Ming: One day.
Grandma: One day doesn't matter.
It was a fine day, not cold any more.
Li Ming sat down beside her.
Li Ming: I want to ask you something.
Grandma: Ask.
Li Ming: What's your name?
She didn't answer.
She looked out at the street.
Grandma: What makes you ask that?
Li Ming: I've known you two weeks.
Li Ming: And I don't know your name.
Grandma: You don't know mine. I know yours.
Li Ming: That's not fair.
Grandma: All right.
She said three syllables.
Li Ming didn't catch them.
Grandma: You didn't hear?
Li Ming: No.
Grandma: Then I'll say it once more.
She said it again.
This time Li Ming heard it.
He didn't say anything.
Grandma: What is it?
Li Ming: How did you know my name?
Grandma: You asked the shop assistant, that day.
Li Ming: That was fourteen days ago.
Grandma: Yes.
Li Ming: You were on the chair that day.
Grandma: I am on the chair every day.
Da Mao slept on beside her.
There was no snow left in the sky.
Li Ming thought: this time next year there will be a cat on that chair.
And, he thought, she will be there too.
Grandma: Li Ming.
Li Ming: Yes?
Grandma: Will you come tomorrow?
Li Ming: I come every day.

title: 1. 第七个人
english_summary: He wakes in a small room that is moving, and outside the room there is nothing but water. The ship has six people on it. The captain looks at him for a long time and does not turn back.
content:
小七不知道现在几点。
这个房间很小，没有人。
房间在开。
他到外边。
外边都是水。
不是一点儿水，是很多水。
这是海。
小七在一个船上。
船不大。
船上有六个人。
一个人看见他了。
老九：你是谁？
小七没有说话。
老九：大风！
一个人来了。
他很大，不说话。
大风：你几岁？
小七：十二。
大风：你叫什么名字？
小七：小七。
大风：小七。
老九：这个船上有六个人。
大风：现在有七个。
老九：我们回去吗？
大风：不回。
老九：那他呢？
大风：他在船上。
老九：他在船上做什么？
大风：他工作。
小七：我做什么工作？
大风没有说话。
他看了看海。
大风：明天早上，我给你一个工作。
小七：什么工作？
大风：明天你知道。
那天晚上，小七在那个小房间里。
外边都是海。
他想，明天是什么工作。
他没有睡。
english_content:
Xiao Qi didn't know what time it was.
The room was small, and there was nobody in it.
The room was moving.
He went outside.
Outside there was water everywhere.
Not a little water. A great deal of water.
This was the sea.
Xiao Qi was on a ship.
The ship was not big.
There were six people on it.
One of them saw him.
Lao Jiu: Who are you?
Xiao Qi didn't answer.
Lao Jiu: Da Feng!
A man came.
He was a big man, and he said nothing.
Da Feng: How old are you?
Xiao Qi: Twelve.
Da Feng: What's your name?
Xiao Qi: Xiao Qi.
Da Feng: Xiao Qi.
Lao Jiu: This ship has six people on it.
Da Feng: Now it has seven.
Lao Jiu: Do we turn back?
Da Feng: No.
Lao Jiu: And him?
Da Feng: He stays on the ship.
Lao Jiu: And does what?
Da Feng: He works.
Xiao Qi: What work?
Da Feng said nothing.
He looked out at the sea.
Da Feng: Tomorrow morning I'll give you a job.
Xiao Qi: What job?
Da Feng: Tomorrow you'll know.
That night Xiao Qi lay in the small room.
Outside there was only sea.
He wondered what the job would be.
He didn't sleep.

title: 2. 一天七个
english_summary: A hundred containers of water, seven people, seven a day. The captain gives him one job and will not say why it needs doing twice. The arithmetic works for three days.
content:
早上七点，大风叫小七。
大风：你来。
船的里边有很多杯子。
小七：这些是什么？
大风：水。
大风：一百个杯子，都是水。
小七：一百个。
大风：船上七个人。
大风：一天七个。
小七：一天七个。
大风：你天天早上来看，还有多少个。
小七：这个我会。
大风：早上七点，你来说。
小七：您怎么不看？
大风：我看。
小七：那我也看？
大风：对。
小七：两个人看一件事？
大风：对。
小七不知道这是怎么一件事。
大风：明天早上七点。
小七：好。
第二天早上七点，小七到那儿。
他看了看。
九十三个。
小七：九十三。
大风：对。
第三天早上，八十六。
小七：八十六。
大风：对。
第四天早上，七十九。
小七：一百，九十三，八十六，七十九。
大风：七，七，七。
小七：都是七。
大风：都是七。
小七：那明天是七十二。
大风看了看他。
大风：明天你来说。
小七很高兴。
他不知道这个工作是什么工作。
english_content:
At seven in the morning Da Feng called for Xiao Qi.
Da Feng: Come here.
Below deck there were rows and rows of containers.
Xiao Qi: What are these?
Da Feng: Water.
Da Feng: A hundred of them, all water.
Xiao Qi: A hundred.
Da Feng: There are seven of us.
Da Feng: Seven a day.
Xiao Qi: Seven a day.
Da Feng: Every morning you come and see how many are left.
Xiao Qi: I can do that.
Da Feng: Seven o'clock. You come and tell me.
Xiao Qi: Why don't you look yourself?
Da Feng: I do look.
Xiao Qi: So I look too?
Da Feng: Yes.
Xiao Qi: Two people looking at the same thing?
Da Feng: Yes.
Xiao Qi did not know what to make of that.
Da Feng: Tomorrow. Seven.
Xiao Qi: All right.
At seven the next morning Xiao Qi was there.
He counted.
Ninety-three.
Xiao Qi: Ninety-three.
Da Feng: Correct.
The third morning: eighty-six.
Xiao Qi: Eighty-six.
Da Feng: Correct.
The fourth morning: seventy-nine.
Xiao Qi: A hundred, ninety-three, eighty-six, seventy-nine.
Da Feng: Seven, seven, seven.
Xiao Qi: All sevens.
Da Feng: All sevens.
Xiao Qi: So tomorrow it's seventy-two.
Da Feng looked at him.
Da Feng: Tomorrow you tell me.
Xiao Qi was pleased.
He didn't know what the job was really for.

title: 3. 海上都是海
english_summary: Days of nothing. The cook gives him two portions and never drinks in front of him. The oldest man on the ship has been aboard twenty years and will say only that there are things he does not say.
content:
一天，两天，三天。
海上都是海。
没有人，没有船。
早上七点，小七看水。
七十二，六十五，五十八。
都是七。
中午，阿水做饭。
阿水：吃。
小七：谢谢。
阿水：你吃两个。
小七：两个？
阿水：你十二岁。
小七：您呢？
阿水：我不想吃。
小七：您喝水吗？
阿水：喝。
小七：我没有看见您喝。
阿水看了看他，没有说话。
下午，小七问老九。
小七：我们去哪儿？
老九：你问大风。
小七：我问了。
老九：他说什么？
小七：他没有说。
老九：那我也没有。
小七：您知道吗？
老九：我知道。
小七：那您说。
老九：不。
小七：怎么不说？
老九：这个船，我在上边二十年了。
老九：有些事，我不说。
小七：那我问谁？
老九：你不问。
小七：我要知道。
老九：你十二岁。
小七：我十二岁，我在这个船上。
老九没有说话。
老九：好孩子。
他回去了。
晚上，小七看海。
海上都是海。
english_content:
One day, two days, three days.
There was nothing on the sea but sea.
No people, no other ships.
At seven each morning Xiao Qi counted the water.
Seventy-two, sixty-five, fifty-eight.
All sevens.
At midday Ah Shui cooked.
Ah Shui: Eat.
Xiao Qi: Thank you.
Ah Shui: You have two.
Xiao Qi: Two?
Ah Shui: You're twelve.
Xiao Qi: And you?
Ah Shui: I don't want any.
Xiao Qi: Do you drink water?
Ah Shui: I do.
Xiao Qi: I've never seen you drink.
Ah Shui looked at him and said nothing.
That afternoon Xiao Qi asked Lao Jiu.
Xiao Qi: Where are we going?
Lao Jiu: Ask Da Feng.
Xiao Qi: I did.
Lao Jiu: What did he say?
Xiao Qi: He didn't say.
Lao Jiu: Then neither do I.
Xiao Qi: Do you know?
Lao Jiu: I know.
Xiao Qi: Then tell me.
Lao Jiu: No.
Xiao Qi: Why not?
Lao Jiu: I have been on this ship twenty years.
Lao Jiu: There are things I do not say.
Xiao Qi: Then who do I ask?
Lao Jiu: You don't ask.
Xiao Qi: I want to know.
Lao Jiu: You're twelve.
Xiao Qi: I'm twelve, and I am on this ship.
Lao Jiu said nothing.
Lao Jiu: Good lad.
And he went back to work.
That evening Xiao Qi looked at the sea.
There was nothing on it but sea.

title: 4. 阿水不喝水
english_summary: Seven days in, Xiao Qi starts watching the cook instead of the water. Ah Shui eats little, drinks nothing anyone sees, and is the only person on the ship who asks Xiao Qi a question back.
content:
第七天，小七看水。
五十一个。
小七：五十一。
大风：对。
小七：大风。
大风：说。
小七：五十一个，七个人，七天。
大风：对。
小七：那我们回家吗？
大风：不回。
小七：七天，船上没有水。
大风：我知道。
大风：你去做饭。
中午，小七在阿水那边。
阿水：你吃。
小七：您也吃。
阿水：我吃了。
小七：我没有看见。
阿水：你看见的东西不多。
小七：我看见您不喝水。
阿水没有说话。
小七：七天了。
阿水：你几岁？
小七：十二。
阿水：你怎么来的？
小七：我来的。
阿水：这个船不是这边的。
小七：我知道。
阿水：你知道？
小七没有说话。
阿水看了看他。
阿水：好。
阿水：这个你吃。
他给了小七一个鸡蛋。
小七：您呢？
阿水：我不想吃。
晚上，小七没有睡。
他在想阿水。
七天，他没有喝一个杯子的水。
七天，一个人可以不喝水吗？
不可以。
english_content:
On the seventh day Xiao Qi counted the water.
Fifty-one.
Xiao Qi: Fifty-one.
Da Feng: Correct.
Xiao Qi: Da Feng.
Da Feng: Speak.
Xiao Qi: Fifty-one left. Seven people. Seven days.
Da Feng: Correct.
Xiao Qi: Do we go home then?
Da Feng: No.
Xiao Qi: Seven days, and the ship has no water.
Da Feng: I know.
Da Feng: Go and help with the food.
At midday Xiao Qi was with Ah Shui.
Ah Shui: Eat.
Xiao Qi: You eat too.
Ah Shui: I've eaten.
Xiao Qi: I didn't see you.
Ah Shui: You don't see very much.
Xiao Qi: I see that you don't drink water.
Ah Shui said nothing.
Xiao Qi: Seven days now.
Ah Shui: How old are you?
Xiao Qi: Twelve.
Ah Shui: How did you get here?
Xiao Qi: I just came.
Ah Shui: This ship isn't from around here.
Xiao Qi: I know.
Ah Shui: You know?
Xiao Qi said nothing.
Ah Shui looked at him.
Ah Shui: All right.
Ah Shui: Have this too.
He gave Xiao Qi an egg.
Xiao Qi: And you?
Ah Shui: I don't want it.
That night Xiao Qi didn't sleep.
He lay thinking about Ah Shui.
Seven days, and not one container of water.
Can a man go seven days without water?
He cannot.

title: 5. 我们去一个岛
english_summary: On the tenth day the captain answers a question for the first time. It is one word long, and it is not the answer to the question Xiao Qi asked.
content:
第十天，天不好。
海很大。
船上的人都在工作。
小七也工作。
下午，天好了。
大风在看海。
小七到他那边。
小七：我看了水。
大风：多少？
小七：三十个。
大风：对。
小七：四天。
大风：对。
小七：我们去哪儿？
大风没有说话。
小七：四天。
大风：我们去一个岛。
小七：一个岛。
大风：对。
小七：哪个岛？
大风没有说话。
小七：岛上有什么？
大风没有说话。
小七：岛上有人吗？
大风看了他一下。
大风：你去休息。
小七：我不休息。
大风：小七。
小七：什么？
大风：你的工作是看水。
小七：我看了。
大风：那明天再看。
小七回房间了。
老九在外边。
老九：他说了？
小七：他说一个岛。
老九：那他说了很多。
小七：一个字。
老九：一个字，二十年。
老九回去了。
english_content:
On the tenth day the weather turned.
The sea got big.
Everyone on the ship was working.
Xiao Qi worked too.
By afternoon it had cleared.
Da Feng was watching the water.
Xiao Qi went and stood by him.
Xiao Qi: I counted the water.
Da Feng: How much?
Xiao Qi: Thirty.
Da Feng: Correct.
Xiao Qi: Four days.
Da Feng: Correct.
Xiao Qi: Where are we going?
Da Feng said nothing.
Xiao Qi: Four days.
Da Feng: We are going to an island.
Xiao Qi: An island.
Da Feng: Yes.
Xiao Qi: Which island?
Da Feng said nothing.
Xiao Qi: What's on it?
Da Feng said nothing.
Xiao Qi: Are there people on it?
Da Feng glanced at him.
Da Feng: Go and rest.
Xiao Qi: I don't want to rest.
Da Feng: Xiao Qi.
Xiao Qi: What?
Da Feng: Your job is the water.
Xiao Qi: I did it.
Da Feng: Then do it again tomorrow.
Xiao Qi went back to his room.
Lao Jiu was outside.
Lao Jiu: He told you?
Xiao Qi: He said an island.
Lao Jiu: Then he told you a great deal.
Xiao Qi: He said one word.
Lao Jiu: One word. In twenty years.
And Lao Jiu went back to work.

title: 6. 少了四个
english_summary: Eleven days of sevens, and then the number is wrong. The captain does not look surprised, does not check, and does not ask who. He asks Xiao Qi a different question entirely.
content:
第十一天早上七点，小七去看水。
昨天是三十个。
三十少七是二十三。
他看了。
十九个。
他再看了一下。
十九个。
不是二十三，是十九。
少了四个。
小七到大风那边。
小七：十九。
大风：你说什么？
小七：十九个。
小七：昨天三十个，今天十九个。
小七：不是七，是十一。
大风没有说话。
他没有去看。
小七：您不去看吗？
大风：不去。
小七：那我再看一下。
大风：不。
小七：船上少了四个水。
大风：我知道。
小七：您知道？
大风：我知道。
小七：那是谁？
大风没有说话。
小七：您也知道是谁？
大风：小七。
小七：什么？
大风：我问你一件事。
小七：您问。
大风：这十一天，你天天看水。
小七：对。
大风：今天是第一天，你说少了。
小七：对。
大风：那十天前呢？
小七没有说话。
大风：那十天也少。
小七：少多少？
大风：天天四个。
小七：那一百个……
大风：一百个不是一百个。
大风：明天早上七点，你再来。
english_content:
At seven on the eleventh morning Xiao Qi went to count the water.
Yesterday it had been thirty.
Thirty less seven is twenty-three.
He counted.
Nineteen.
He counted again.
Nineteen.
Not twenty-three. Nineteen.
Four short.
Xiao Qi went to Da Feng.
Xiao Qi: Nineteen.
Da Feng: Say that again.
Xiao Qi: Nineteen.
Xiao Qi: Thirty yesterday, nineteen today.
Xiao Qi: That's not seven. That's eleven.
Da Feng said nothing.
He did not go and look.
Xiao Qi: Aren't you going to check?
Da Feng: No.
Xiao Qi: Then let me count again.
Da Feng: No.
Xiao Qi: Four containers are gone.
Da Feng: I know.
Xiao Qi: You know?
Da Feng: I know.
Xiao Qi: Then who?
Da Feng said nothing.
Xiao Qi: You know who as well?
Da Feng: Xiao Qi.
Xiao Qi: What?
Da Feng: I'll ask you something.
Xiao Qi: Ask.
Da Feng: Eleven days you have counted that water.
Xiao Qi: Yes.
Da Feng: Today is the first day you have told me it was short.
Xiao Qi: Yes.
Da Feng: And the ten days before?
Xiao Qi said nothing.
Da Feng: Those ten days were short too.
Xiao Qi: By how much?
Da Feng: Four. Every day.
Xiao Qi: Then a hundred —
Da Feng: A hundred was never a hundred.
Da Feng: Seven tomorrow. Come again.

title: 7. 我跟着他
english_summary: Xiao Qi stays awake for the answer instead of asking for it. At two in the morning the cook carries four containers to the back of the ship, and there are far more than four already there.
content:
那天晚上，小七没有睡。
他在房间里等。
十二点，外面没有人。
一点，还是没有人。
两点，他听见了。
有人从上面下来。
小七出去看。
是阿水。
他拿着四个杯子。
他往船的后面走。
小七跟着他。
阿水到了一个门。
他打开门，进去了。
小七等了一会儿。
他也进去了。
里面很小。
里面有很多杯子。
不是四个，是很多。
阿水看见他了。
阿水：你怎么来了？
小七：我跟着您。
阿水：出去。
小七：这些水是什么？
阿水：出去！
小七没有出去。
小七：一天四个。
阿水没有说话。
小七：十一天，四十四个。
阿水：你都看了。
小七：这是我的工作。
阿水：别告诉大风。
小七：他已经知道了。
阿水的手不动了。
阿水：他知道？
小七：他今天早上告诉我的。
阿水：他说了什么？
小七：他说，一百个不是一百个。
阿水坐下了。
他很长时间没有说话。
阿水：那他也知道为什么。
小七：为什么？
阿水：因为这个水不是给我们的。
小七：那是给谁的？
阿水：给一个人。
小七：哪个人？
阿水看着他。
阿水：你太小了。
小七：我十二岁。
阿水：三年前，你九岁。
小七：三年前怎么了？
阿水没有再说话。
english_content:
That night Xiao Qi did not sleep.
He waited in his room.
Midnight: nobody outside.
One o'clock: still nobody.
At two he heard it.
Someone coming down from above.
Xiao Qi went out to look.
It was Ah Shui.
He was carrying four containers.
He went towards the back of the ship.
Xiao Qi followed him.
Ah Shui reached a door.
He opened it and went in.
Xiao Qi waited a moment.
Then he went in too.
The space was small.
And it was full of containers.
Not four. Many.
Ah Shui saw him.
Ah Shui: What are you doing here?
Xiao Qi: I followed you.
Ah Shui: Get out.
Xiao Qi: What is all this water?
Ah Shui: Get out!
Xiao Qi didn't move.
Xiao Qi: Four a day.
Ah Shui said nothing.
Xiao Qi: Eleven days. Forty-four.
Ah Shui: You've been counting all of it.
Xiao Qi: That is my job.
Ah Shui: Don't tell Da Feng.
Xiao Qi: He already knows.
Ah Shui's hands went still.
Ah Shui: He knows?
Xiao Qi: He told me this morning.
Ah Shui: What did he say?
Xiao Qi: He said a hundred was never a hundred.
Ah Shui sat down.
For a long time he said nothing.
Ah Shui: Then he knows why, as well.
Xiao Qi: Why?
Ah Shui: Because this water isn't for us.
Xiao Qi: Then who is it for?
Ah Shui: For a person.
Xiao Qi: Which person?
Ah Shui looked at him.
Ah Shui: You're too young.
Xiao Qi: I'm twelve.
Ah Shui: Three years ago you were nine.
Xiao Qi: What happened three years ago?
Ah Shui said nothing more.

title: 8. 出去七个，回来六个
english_summary: Lao Jiu has been on this ship twenty years and has made this exact voyage once before. He will give Xiao Qi the numbers. He will not give him the name, and he says why.
content:
第二天，小七找老九。
老九在船的前面工作。
小七：我要问您一件事。
老九：你还问。
小七：我还问。
老九：好。你问。
小七：三年前，这个船来过这里吗？
老九没有说话。
小七：来过。
老九：你听谁说的？
小七：阿水。
老九：他跟你说了？
小七：他说了三年前。
老九：他没有说别人？
小七：没有。
老九坐下了。
老九：三年前，这个船来过。
小七：来做什么？
老九：现在做的事，那个时候也做过。
小七：去那个岛？
老九：去那个岛。
小七：那个时候船上有多少人？
老九很长时间没有说话。
老九：七个。
小七：七个。
老九：出去的时候七个。
小七：回来的时候呢？
老九：六个。
小七：六个。
老九：对。
小七：那一个人呢？
老九：还在岛上。
小七：三年了？
老九：三年了。
小七：他叫什么？
老九站起来了。
老九：我说得太多了。
小七：您告诉我他叫什么。
老九：不。
小七：为什么？
老九：因为你听了这个名字，你就不是现在的你了。
老九往前面走了。
小七站在那里，很长时间。
english_content:
The next day Xiao Qi went to Lao Jiu.
Lao Jiu was working at the bow.
Xiao Qi: I want to ask you something.
Lao Jiu: You're still asking.
Xiao Qi: I'm still asking.
Lao Jiu: Fine. Ask.
Xiao Qi: Three years ago, did this ship come here?
Lao Jiu said nothing.
Xiao Qi: It did.
Lao Jiu: Who told you?
Xiao Qi: Ah Shui.
Lao Jiu: He talked to you?
Xiao Qi: He said three years ago.
Lao Jiu: He didn't name anyone?
Xiao Qi: No.
Lao Jiu sat down.
Lao Jiu: Three years ago this ship came here.
Xiao Qi: To do what?
Lao Jiu: The same thing we are doing now.
Xiao Qi: Go to that island?
Lao Jiu: Go to that island.
Xiao Qi: How many people were on board then?
Lao Jiu was quiet for a long time.
Lao Jiu: Seven.
Xiao Qi: Seven.
Lao Jiu: Seven when we left.
Xiao Qi: And when you came back?
Lao Jiu: Six.
Xiao Qi: Six.
Lao Jiu: Yes.
Xiao Qi: And the seventh?
Lao Jiu: Still on the island.
Xiao Qi: For three years?
Lao Jiu: Three years.
Xiao Qi: What's his name?
Lao Jiu stood up.
Lao Jiu: I have said too much.
Xiao Qi: Tell me his name.
Lao Jiu: No.
Xiao Qi: Why not?
Lao Jiu: Because once you hear that name you stop being who you are now.
Lao Jiu walked away up the deck.
Xiao Qi stood where he was for a long time.

title: 9. 你为什么在这个船上
english_summary: The captain ends the water job two days from the island, and asks Xiao Qi the one question Xiao Qi has been avoiding. Then Xiao Qi asks his, and gets an answer that is worse than silence.
content:
下午，大风叫小七。
大风：从明天开始，你别看水了。
小七：为什么？
大风：这个工作完了。
小七：还有十九个。
大风：我知道。
小七：十九个，七个人，两天。
大风：两天，我们到那个岛。
小七：到了岛，我们做什么？
大风：我们等。
小七：等什么？
大风：等一个人。
小七：他叫什么名字？
大风看着他。
大风：老九跟你说了。
小七：他说了六个人，七个人。
大风：他说得不多。
小七：他说得不多，但是他说了。
大风：小七。
小七：您说。
大风：你为什么在这个船上？
小七：因为我在这个船上。
大风：你还没有说。
小七：我不知道怎么说。
大风：那你想一想。
大风：想两天。
小七：两天，您再问我？
大风：对。
小七：那我也问您一件事。
大风：你问。
小七：您为什么让我看水？
大风：因为我要一个人看着它。
小七：船上有六个人。
大风：那六个人都在这个船上很多年了。
小七：我不是。
大风：你不是。
大风：所以是你。
小七想了很长时间。
小七：您不知道他们做什么。
大风没有说是，也没有说不是。
大风：两天。
english_content:
That afternoon Da Feng sent for Xiao Qi.
Da Feng: From tomorrow, stop counting the water.
Xiao Qi: Why?
Da Feng: The job is finished.
Xiao Qi: There are nineteen left.
Da Feng: I know.
Xiao Qi: Nineteen, seven people, two days.
Da Feng: Two days and we reach the island.
Xiao Qi: And when we get there?
Da Feng: We wait.
Xiao Qi: For what?
Da Feng: For a person.
Xiao Qi: What is his name?
Da Feng looked at him.
Da Feng: Lao Jiu has talked to you.
Xiao Qi: He told me six and seven.
Da Feng: He didn't say much.
Xiao Qi: He didn't say much, but he said it.
Da Feng: Xiao Qi.
Xiao Qi: Go on.
Da Feng: Why are you on this ship?
Xiao Qi: Because I am on this ship.
Da Feng: That isn't an answer.
Xiao Qi: I don't know how to say it.
Da Feng: Then think about it.
Da Feng: Take two days.
Xiao Qi: And in two days you ask me again?
Da Feng: Yes.
Xiao Qi: Then I want to ask you something too.
Da Feng: Ask.
Xiao Qi: Why did you make me count the water?
Da Feng: Because I needed someone watching it.
Xiao Qi: There are six others.
Da Feng: All six have been on this ship for years.
Xiao Qi: I haven't.
Da Feng: You haven't.
Da Feng: That is why it was you.
Xiao Qi thought about that for a long moment.
Xiao Qi: You don't know what your own crew is doing.
Da Feng did not say yes and did not say no.
Da Feng: Two days.

title: 10. 这个水不是我的
english_summary: The cook gives Xiao Qi the true half of it: the four containers a day were never drunk by anyone. Three years of them. He has been carrying the same arithmetic Xiao Qi was given, in the opposite direction.
content:
晚上，小七到后面的那个门。
门开着。
阿水在里面。
阿水：你还来。
小七：我还来。
阿水：坐。
小七坐下了。
阿水：你看这些杯子。
小七：我看了。
阿水：这里有多少个？
小七：我不知道。
阿水：你知道。你天天看水。
小七想了一会儿。
小七：一天四个。
阿水：对。
小七：出海十二天。
阿水：这次十二天。
小七：这次？
阿水没有说话。
小七看着那些杯子。
小七：这里不是四十八个。
阿水：不是。
小七：这里很多。
阿水：对。
小七：您做了多长时间？
阿水：三年。
小七站起来了。
小七：三年？
阿水：三年。
小七：船三年没有来这里。
阿水：船没有来。
阿水：但是我天天拿四个。
小七：为什么？
阿水：因为三年前我没有拿。
小七没有说话。
阿水：那个时候，船上的水不多。
阿水：七个人的水，六个人喝。
小七：六个人喝。
阿水：对。
小七：那第七个人呢？
阿水看着他，很长时间。
阿水：所以我现在天天拿四个。
english_content:
That evening Xiao Qi went back to the door at the stern.
It was open.
Ah Shui was inside.
Ah Shui: You came back.
Xiao Qi: I came back.
Ah Shui: Sit.
Xiao Qi sat.
Ah Shui: Look at all this.
Xiao Qi: I have.
Ah Shui: How many are there?
Xiao Qi: I don't know.
Ah Shui: You do know. You count water every day.
Xiao Qi thought for a moment.
Xiao Qi: Four a day.
Ah Shui: Yes.
Xiao Qi: Twelve days at sea.
Ah Shui: Twelve days this time.
Xiao Qi: This time?
Ah Shui said nothing.
Xiao Qi looked at the containers again.
Xiao Qi: There aren't forty-eight here.
Ah Shui: No.
Xiao Qi: There are a great many.
Ah Shui: Yes.
Xiao Qi: How long have you been doing this?
Ah Shui: Three years.
Xiao Qi stood up.
Xiao Qi: Three years?
Ah Shui: Three years.
Xiao Qi: The ship hasn't come here in three years.
Ah Shui: The ship hasn't.
Ah Shui: But I have taken four every day.
Xiao Qi: Why?
Ah Shui: Because three years ago I took none.
Xiao Qi said nothing.
Ah Shui: There wasn't much water on the ship then.
Ah Shui: Seven people's water, and six people drinking it.
Xiao Qi: Six people drinking it.
Ah Shui: Yes.
Xiao Qi: And the seventh?
Ah Shui looked at him for a long time.
Ah Shui: That is why I take four, every day.

title: 11. 十九个
english_summary: The crew finds out how little water is left and wants to turn for home. Da Feng will not. The vote comes down to the newest person on the ship, who has been aboard eleven days and is twelve years old.
content:
第二天早上，船上的人都知道了。
十九个杯子。
七个人。
两天。
他们都到上面来。
阿力：我们回去。
大风：不回。
阿力：水不多了。
大风：我知道。
阿力：您知道，但是您还往前走。
大风：对。
阿力：为什么？
大风没有说话。
老九：因为岛上有一个人。
大家都不说话了。
阿力：三年了。
老九：三年了。
阿力：三年，一个人在岛上。
老九：对。
阿力：那我们去做什么？
老九没有说话。
阿水：我们去拿他。
阿力：阿水。
阿水：我们三年前没有拿他。
阿力：那个时候水不多。
阿水：现在也不多。
阿力：所以我们回去。
阿水：三年前你也这样说。
大家都不说话。
大风：小七。
小七：我？
大风：你天天看水。你说。
阿力：他十二岁！
大风：他十二岁，他看了十一天。
小七很长时间没有说话。
小七：十九个杯子，两天。
阿力：对。
小七：回去要十二天。
阿力：……对。
小七：那我们回不去。
没有人说话。
小七：我们只能往前走。
大风看着他。
大风：往前走。
english_content:
By the next morning everyone on the ship knew.
Nineteen containers.
Seven people.
Two days.
They all came up on deck.
A Li: We turn back.
Da Feng: No.
A Li: There's no water left.
Da Feng: I know.
A Li: You know, and you keep going.
Da Feng: Yes.
A Li: Why?
Da Feng said nothing.
Lao Jiu: Because there is a man on that island.
Nobody spoke.
A Li: It has been three years.
Lao Jiu: Three years.
A Li: Three years. A man alone on an island.
Lao Jiu: Yes.
A Li: Then what are we going there for?
Lao Jiu did not answer.
Ah Shui: We are going to get him.
A Li: Ah Shui.
Ah Shui: We didn't get him three years ago.
A Li: There was no water then.
Ah Shui: There is no water now.
A Li: Which is why we go back.
Ah Shui: You said that three years ago too.
Nobody spoke.
Da Feng: Xiao Qi.
Xiao Qi: Me?
Da Feng: You count the water. You say.
A Li: He's twelve!
Da Feng: He's twelve, and he has counted for eleven days.
For a long moment Xiao Qi said nothing.
Xiao Qi: Nineteen containers. Two days.
A Li: Correct.
Xiao Qi: Turning back takes twelve.
A Li: … Correct.
Xiao Qi: Then we can't go back.
Nobody said anything.
Xiao Qi: Forward is the only way there is.
Da Feng looked at him.
Da Feng: Forward.

title: 12. 岛
