english_summary: Two days of no water and no talking, and then Lao Jiu shouts one word from the bow. There is a man standing on the beach, and he is not waving.
content:
那两天，船上没有人说话。
水一天比一天少。
小七不看水了。
他天天在船的前面看海。
第一天，海上都是海。
第二天早上，也是海。
中午，老九在上面。
老九：岛！
大家都跑到前面来。
海的那边有一个岛。
岛不大。
小七看了很长时间。
小七：岛上有东西吗？
老九：有。
小七：什么？
老九没有说话。
船慢慢地往岛那边开。
一个小时，两个小时。
船离岛很近了。
下午四点，他们能看见岛上的东西了。
岛上有绿色的东西。
海边有一个小门。
门前面有一个人。
他站在那里。
他没有动。
小七：他看见我们了吗？
老九：看见了。
小七：那他为什么不动？
没有人跟他说话。
阿水到了小七旁边。
阿水：小七。
小七：什么？
阿水：大风问过你一件事。
小七：他问我为什么在这个船上。
阿水：两天到了。
小七看着岛上的那个人。
小七：我知道我为什么在这个船上。
阿水：那你说。
小七：我到了岛上说。
船往岛那边开。
岛上的那个人还站在那里。
他还是没有动。
english_content:
For two days nobody on the ship spoke.
The water got lower by the day.
Xiao Qi no longer counted it.
He stood at the bow and watched the sea.
The first day there was only sea.
The second morning, still sea.
At midday Lao Jiu was up top.
Lao Jiu: Island!
They all ran to the bow.
There it was, across the water.
It was not big.
Xiao Qi looked at it for a long time.
Xiao Qi: Is there anything on it?
Lao Jiu: Yes.
Xiao Qi: What?
Lao Jiu did not answer.
The ship moved slowly towards it.
One hour. Two.
The ship drew close.
By four in the afternoon they could make things out on it.
There was green on it.
At the water's edge there was a low doorway.
And in front of it, a man.
He was standing.
He did not move.
Xiao Qi: Has he seen us?
Lao Jiu: He's seen us.
Xiao Qi: Then why isn't he moving?
Nobody answered him.
Ah Shui came and stood beside Xiao Qi.
Ah Shui: Xiao Qi.
Xiao Qi: What?
Ah Shui: Da Feng asked you something.
Xiao Qi: He asked why I'm on this ship.
Ah Shui: The two days are up.
Xiao Qi watched the man on the shore.
Xiao Qi: I know why I'm on this ship.
Ah Shui: Then say it.
Xiao Qi: I'll say it when we land.
The ship went on towards the island.
The man on the island was still standing there.
He still had not moved.

title: 13. 上岛
english_summary: Four of them go ashore. The man has been on this island three years and does not seem surprised to see them. Then he looks past the captain at the boy, and asks one question about a name.
content:
下午五点，船到了岛边。
大风、阿水、老九和小七上了岛。
岛上很安静。
只有海的声音。
那个人还站在门前面。
他很老。
他的衣服不是衣服了。
他们走到他前面。
没有人说话。
最后，那个人说话了。
男人：你们来了。
大风：我们来了。
男人：三年。
大风：三年。
男人：我一直在这里。
大风：我知道。
那个人没有再说话。
他看了看阿水。
他看了看老九。
然后他看见了小七。
他的眼睛变了。
男人：这个孩子是谁？
大风：他自己上的船。
男人：他叫什么名字？
大风：小七。
那个人很长时间没有说话。
男人：小七。
小七没有回答。
男人：你妈妈叫什么？
小七说了一个名字。
那个人坐下了。
他不是慢慢地坐下的。
他坐在地上，手放在地上。
阿水走到他旁边。
阿水：你还好吗？
那个人没有回答。
他一直看着小七。
最后他说了两个字。
男人：小七。
小七：爸爸。
海还在那里。
没有人说话。
english_content:
At five in the afternoon the ship came in to the island.
Da Feng, Ah Shui, Lao Jiu and Xiao Qi went ashore.
The island was very quiet.
There was only the sound of the sea.
The man was still standing in front of the doorway.
He looked old.
What he was wearing was no longer really clothing.
They walked up to him.
Nobody spoke.
At last the man spoke.
The man: You came.
Da Feng: We came.
The man: Three years.
Da Feng: Three years.
The man: I have been here the whole time.
Da Feng: I know.
The man said nothing more.
He looked at Ah Shui.
He looked at Lao Jiu.
Then he saw Xiao Qi.
Something in his eyes changed.
The man: Who is this child?
Da Feng: He put himself on the ship.
The man: What is his name?
Da Feng: Xiao Qi.
For a long time the man said nothing.
The man: Xiao Qi.
Xiao Qi did not answer.
The man: What is your mother's name?
Xiao Qi said a name.
The man sat down.
Not slowly.
He sat down on the ground with his hands on the ground.
Ah Shui went to him.
Ah Shui: Are you all right?
The man did not answer.
He was looking at Xiao Qi and did not stop.
At last he said two syllables.
The man: Xiao Qi.
Xiao Qi: Father.
The sea went on behind them.
Nobody said anything at all.

title: 14. 没有人说不
english_summary: His father tells him how a man ends up alone on an island. Nobody decided it. Nobody voted. He offered, and six people did not say no, and he has had three years to work out whether those are different things.
content:
那天晚上，他们在岛上。
小七和爸爸坐在海边。
小七：三年前，怎么了？
爸爸：三年前，船上的水不多了。
爸爸：回家要十天。
爸爸：水只有五天。
爸爸：七个人，五天。
小七：六个人呢？
爸爸：六天。
小七：六天也不能到家。
爸爸：不能。可是六天比五天多。
小七：所以有一个人要下船。
爸爸：对。
小七：谁决定的？
爸爸：没有人决定。
小七：什么意思？
爸爸：我们都在上面。没有人说话。
爸爸：一分钟，两分钟，没有人说话。
爸爸：后来我说，我下去。
小七：您说的？
爸爸：我说的。
小七：那他们呢？
爸爸：他们没有说不。
小七：一个人也没有？
爸爸：一个人也没有。
小七很长时间没有说话。
小七：这是他们的错。
爸爸：这不是他们的错。
小七：他们让您下船。
爸爸：他们没有让我。他们只是没有说不。
小七：那是一样的。
爸爸没有回答。
海一直在那里。
最后爸爸说话了。
爸爸：三年，我天天想这件事。
小七：您想到什么？
爸爸：第一年，我想这不是他们的错。
爸爸：第二年，我还是这样想。
小七：第三年呢？
爸爸很长时间没有说话。
爸爸：第三年我想，你说得对。
爸爸：那是一样的。
english_content:
That night they stayed on the island.
Xiao Qi and his father sat by the water.
Xiao Qi: What happened, three years ago?
Father: Three years ago the water ran low.
Father: Ten days to get home.
Father: Five days of water.
Father: Seven people, five days.
Xiao Qi: And six people?
Father: Six days.
Xiao Qi: Six days still doesn't get you home.
Father: It doesn't. But six is more than five.
Xiao Qi: So one person had to leave the ship.
Father: Yes.
Xiao Qi: Who decided?
Father: Nobody decided.
Xiao Qi: What does that mean?
Father: We were all up on deck. Nobody said anything.
Father: One minute, two minutes. Nobody said anything.
Father: And then I said, I'll go.
Xiao Qi: You said it?
Father: I said it.
Xiao Qi: And them?
Father: They didn't say no.
Xiao Qi: Not one of them?
Father: Not one.
For a long time Xiao Qi said nothing.
Xiao Qi: This is their fault.
Father: It isn't their fault.
Xiao Qi: They put you off the ship.
Father: They didn't put me off. They just didn't say no.
Xiao Qi: That's the same thing.
His father did not answer.
The sea kept on beside them.
At last his father spoke.
Father: Three years. I have thought about this every day.
Xiao Qi: And what did you decide?
Father: The first year I decided it wasn't their fault.
Father: The second year I still thought so.
Xiao Qi: And the third?
His father was silent a long time.
Father: The third year I decided you're right.
Father: It is the same thing.

title: 15. 一千天
english_summary: Ah Shui was the one counting the water three years ago, and he counted it wrong. He worked out how wrong on the third day of the voyage home, and he has been carrying four containers a day ever since.
content:
第二天早上，阿水来找小七。
阿水：我要跟你说一件事。
小七：您说。
阿水：三年前，看水的人是我。
小七没有说话。
阿水：我看错了。
阿水：我说只有五天。
小七：其实呢？
阿水：七天。
小七：七天。
阿水：七天，七个人，可以到家。
小七站起来了。
小七：可以到家。
阿水：可以。
小七：那我爸爸不用下船。
阿水：不用。
小七：您什么时候发现的？
阿水：我们回家的第三天。
小七：第三天。
阿水：第三天。
小七：那您为什么不回来？
阿水：我跟大风说了。
小七：他说什么？
阿水：他说，我们回不去了。
小七：为什么？
阿水：因为我们只有四天的水。
小七：所以您看错了两天，我爸爸在这里三年。
阿水：对。
小七：那些水呢？
阿水：从那天开始，我天天拿四个杯子。
小七：为什么是四个？
阿水：我不知道。
阿水：第一天我拿了四个。第二天我也拿了四个。
阿水：后来我就没有想过这个问题。
小七：三年。
阿水：一千天。
小七：一千天。
阿水：我一个杯子也没有喝过。
小七看着他。
小七：您想我说没关系吗？
阿水：不想。
小七：好。
阿水：谢谢。
english_content:
The next morning Ah Shui came to find Xiao Qi.
Ah Shui: There's something I have to tell you.
Xiao Qi: Go on.
Ah Shui: Three years ago, I was the one counting the water.
Xiao Qi said nothing.
Ah Shui: I got it wrong.
Ah Shui: I said five days.
Xiao Qi: And really?
Ah Shui: Seven.
Xiao Qi: Seven.
Ah Shui: Seven days, seven people. Enough to get home.
Xiao Qi stood up.
Xiao Qi: Enough to get home.
Ah Shui: Enough.
Xiao Qi: Then my father never had to leave the ship.
Ah Shui: He never had to.
Xiao Qi: When did you find out?
Ah Shui: On the third day of the voyage home.
Xiao Qi: The third day.
Ah Shui: The third day.
Xiao Qi: Then why didn't you turn around?
Ah Shui: I told Da Feng.
Xiao Qi: What did he say?
Ah Shui: He said we couldn't get back.
Xiao Qi: Why not?
Ah Shui: Because by then we only had four days of water.
Xiao Qi: So you were two days out, and my father has been here three years.
Ah Shui: Yes.
Xiao Qi: And all that water?
Ah Shui: From that day on I took four containers a day.
Xiao Qi: Why four?
Ah Shui: I don't know.
Ah Shui: The first day I took four. The second day I took four.
Ah Shui: After that I stopped asking myself about it.
Xiao Qi: Three years.
Ah Shui: A thousand days.
Xiao Qi: A thousand days.
Ah Shui: I have not drunk one of them.
Xiao Qi looked at him.
Xiao Qi: Do you want me to say it's all right?
Ah Shui: No.
Xiao Qi: Good.
Ah Shui: Thank you.

title: 16. 我等了三年
english_summary: Xiao Qi finally answers the captain's question. He did not end up on this ship. He worked out where it would be and when, and he was nine years old when he started waiting.
content:
下午，大风叫小七到船上。
大风：两天前我问过你一件事。
小七：您问我为什么在这个船上。
大风：对。
小七：我现在可以说了。
大风：那你说。
小七：三年前，我九岁。
小七：我爸爸出海，没有回来。
大风没有说话。
小七：我妈妈问了很多人。
小七：他们都说一样的话。
大风：他们说什么？
小七：他们说，海上的事，没有人知道。
大风：……对。
小七：可是有一个人跟我妈妈说了别的。
大风：谁？
小七：我不知道他的名字。
小七：他说，那个船三年来一次。
大风：他说得对。
小七：我妈妈去年不在了。
大风：……
小七：她不在了以后，我一直等。
大风：等什么？
小七：等三年到。
大风：你怎么知道船在哪里？
小七：我不知道。
小七：我天天去海边看。
大风：天天？
小七：天天。
大风：多长时间？
小七：一年。
大风很长时间没有说话。
小七：后来我看见了这个船。
小七：我就上来了。
大风：你上来的时候，你知道船去哪儿吗？
小七：不知道。
大风：你不知道船去哪儿，你也上来了。
小七：对。
大风：为什么？
小七：因为这个船是最后一个办法。
english_content:
That afternoon Da Feng called Xiao Qi back on board.
Da Feng: Two days ago I asked you something.
Xiao Qi: You asked why I'm on this ship.
Da Feng: Yes.
Xiao Qi: I can say it now.
Da Feng: Then say it.
Xiao Qi: Three years ago I was nine.
Xiao Qi: My father went to sea and did not come back.
Da Feng said nothing.
Xiao Qi: My mother asked a great many people.
Xiao Qi: They all said the same thing.
Da Feng: What did they say?
Xiao Qi: They said the sea is the sea, and nobody knows.
Da Feng: … Yes.
Xiao Qi: But one person told my mother something else.
Da Feng: Who?
Xiao Qi: I don't know his name.
Xiao Qi: He said that ship comes back every three years.
Da Feng: He was right.
Xiao Qi: My mother died last year.
Da Feng: …
Xiao Qi: After she was gone I just waited.
Da Feng: For what?
Xiao Qi: For the three years to be up.
Da Feng: How did you know where the ship would be?
Xiao Qi: I didn't.
Xiao Qi: I went down to the water every day and looked.
Da Feng: Every day?
Xiao Qi: Every day.
Da Feng: For how long?
Xiao Qi: A year.
Da Feng was silent for a long time.
Xiao Qi: And then I saw this ship.
Xiao Qi: And I got on it.
Da Feng: When you came aboard, did you know where it was going?
Xiao Qi: No.
Da Feng: You didn't know where it was going, and you got on anyway.
Xiao Qi: Yes.
Da Feng: Why?
Xiao Qi: Because this ship was the last thing left to try.

title: 17. 第一天我就知道了
english_summary: The captain explains why a stowaway was never put off his ship, and why the job he was given was the water. It is not kindness. It is a man who three years ago also said nothing, arranging to be caught.
content:
大风看着海。
大风：小七，我也要说一件事。
小七：您说。
大风：第一天我看见你，我就知道你是谁。
小七：第一天？
大风：第一天。
小七：您怎么知道的？
大风：你的眼睛。
小七没有说话。
大风：老九问我，我们回去吗。我说不回。
小七：因为您知道我是谁。
大风：因为我知道你是谁。
小七：那您为什么让我看水？
大风：因为我要一个人看着阿水。
小七：您知道他拿水？
大风：我三年前就知道了。
小七：那您为什么不说？
大风：因为我不要他不拿。
小七想了一会儿。
小七：您要那些水。
大风：我要那些水。
小七：为了这一天。
大风：为了这一天。
小七：那您为什么要我看？
大风很长时间没有回答。
大风：三年前，我也在上面。
小七：我知道。
大风：你爸爸说他下去的时候，我也没有说不。
小七：我知道。
大风：这三年，船上的人都不说这件事。
大风：不说，这件事就慢慢地不在了。
小七：所以您要一个新的人。
大风：我要一个新的人，天天看那些水。
大风：天天看，就不会忘记。
小七：您用了我。
大风：我用了你。
小七：您也可以自己天天看。
大风：我可以。
小七：那您为什么不看？
大风：因为我三年前就发现了，我自己的话，我不相信。
english_content:
Da Feng looked at the sea.
Da Feng: Xiao Qi, I have something to say as well.
Xiao Qi: Go on.
Da Feng: The first day I saw you, I knew who you were.
Xiao Qi: The first day?
Da Feng: The first day.
Xiao Qi: How?
Da Feng: Your eyes.
Xiao Qi said nothing.
Da Feng: Lao Jiu asked me if we were turning back. I said no.
Xiao Qi: Because you knew who I was.
Da Feng: Because I knew who you were.
Xiao Qi: Then why did you make me count the water?
Da Feng: Because I needed someone watching Ah Shui.
Xiao Qi: You knew he was taking it?
Da Feng: I have known for three years.
Xiao Qi: Then why didn't you say anything?
Da Feng: Because I didn't want him to stop.
Xiao Qi thought about that.
Xiao Qi: You wanted that water.
Da Feng: I wanted that water.
Xiao Qi: For today.
Da Feng: For today.
Xiao Qi: Then why did you need me to see it?
Da Feng did not answer for a long time.
Da Feng: Three years ago I was up on that deck too.
Xiao Qi: I know.
Da Feng: When your father said he would go, I did not say no either.
Xiao Qi: I know that too.
Da Feng: For three years nobody on this ship has spoken of it.
Da Feng: And a thing you don't speak of slowly stops being there.
Xiao Qi: So you wanted someone new.
Da Feng: I wanted someone new, counting that water every day.
Da Feng: Counting it every day so it could not be forgotten.
Xiao Qi: You used me.
Da Feng: I used you.
Xiao Qi: You could have counted it yourself.
Da Feng: I could have.
Xiao Qi: Why didn't you?
Da Feng: Because three years ago I found out I don't believe myself.

title: 18. 八个人
english_summary: They leave the island with one more person than they arrived with, and Lao Jiu says the line he said on the first morning, with the numbers moved up by one.
content:
他们在岛上住了两天。
阿水天天做饭。
小七的爸爸吃得很慢。
三年，他忘记了怎么快快地吃。
第三天早上，他们上船。
阿水把那个后面的门打开了。
里面有一千天的水。
大风：这些水能回家吗？
小七看了看。
小七：能。
大风：你看一下。
小七：八个人，回家十天。
小七：一天八个，十天八十个。
大风：这里有多少？
小七：这里比八十个多。
大风：多多少？
小七：很多很多。
阿水没有说话。
他一直看着地上。
小七的爸爸走到他旁边。
爸爸：阿水。
阿水：……
爸爸：这些水是你的。
阿水：不是我的。
爸爸：那你现在喝一个。
阿水很长时间没有动。
最后他拿了一个杯子。
他喝了。
他哭了。
没有人看他。
船开了。
岛越来越小。
小七站在船的后面看那个岛。
他爸爸也站在那里。
爸爸：你在看什么？
小七：我在看这个地方。
爸爸：为什么？
小七：因为我不要忘记它。
爸爸没有说话。
他把手放在小七的头上。
老九从前面过来。
老九：这个船上有七个人。
大风：现在有八个。
老九：我们回家吗？
大风：回家。
english_content:
They stayed on the island two days.
Ah Shui cooked.
Xiao Qi's father ate very slowly.
Three years had taken from him the habit of eating quickly.
On the third morning they went aboard.
Ah Shui opened the door at the stern.
Behind it were a thousand days of water.
Da Feng: Will that get us home?
Xiao Qi looked.
Xiao Qi: It will.
Da Feng: Work it out.
Xiao Qi: Eight people. Ten days home.
Xiao Qi: Eight a day, ten days, eighty containers.
Da Feng: How many are there?
Xiao Qi: More than eighty.
Da Feng: How many more?
Xiao Qi: A great many more.
Ah Shui said nothing.
He was looking at the deck.
Xiao Qi's father walked over to him.
Father: Ah Shui.
Ah Shui: …
Father: This water is yours.
Ah Shui: It isn't mine.
Father: Then drink one of them now.
For a long time Ah Shui did not move.
At last he picked one up.
He drank.
And he cried.
Nobody looked at him.
The ship put out.
The island got smaller.
Xiao Qi stood at the stern and watched it.
His father stood there too.
Father: What are you looking at?
Xiao Qi: I'm looking at that place.
Father: Why?
Xiao Qi: Because I don't want to forget it.
His father said nothing.
He put a hand on Xiao Qi's head.
Lao Jiu came back along the deck.
Lao Jiu: This ship has seven people on it.
Da Feng: Now it has eight.
Lao Jiu: Do we go home?
Da Feng: We go home.

title: 1. 一只狗
english_summary: A brown dog sits down beside the chair outside the shop at four in the afternoon. It does not bark, does not move, and at five o'clock it gets up and leaves like it has somewhere to be.
content:
星期一，下午四点，李明下课回家。
店外边有一只狗。
它不大，也不小。
它坐在椅子旁边。
大毛在椅子上。
大毛看着那只狗。
那只狗也看着大毛。
大毛下来了，走了。
李明：大毛？
大毛没有回来。
李明进了店里。
李明：外边有一只狗。
店员：我看见了。
李明：它是谁的？
店员：不知道。
李明：它从哪儿来的？
店员：也不知道。
李明出去了。
狗还坐在那里。
它没有叫。
它也没有动。
它在看路的那边。
五点，狗站起来了。
它走了。
李明看着它走。
它走得不快。
但是它知道去哪儿。
english_content:
Monday, four in the afternoon, Li Ming walked home from school.
There was a dog outside the shop.
Not big, not small.
It was sitting beside the chair.
Da Mao was on the chair.
Da Mao was watching the dog.
The dog was watching Da Mao.
Da Mao got down and left.
Li Ming: Da Mao?
Da Mao did not come back.
Li Ming went into the shop.
Li Ming: There's a dog outside.
Shop assistant: I saw it.
Li Ming: Whose is it?
Shop assistant: No idea.
Li Ming: Where did it come from?
Shop assistant: No idea either.
Li Ming went back out.
The dog was still sitting there.
It didn't bark.
It didn't move.
It was looking up the street.
At five the dog stood up.
And it left.
Li Ming watched it go.
It wasn't hurrying.
But it knew where it was going.

title: 2. 四点到五点
english_summary: Three days running, the dog arrives at four and leaves at five. Li Ming times it. Xiao Ming does not see the problem until Li Ming points out that dogs do not own watches.
content:
星期二下午，李明在店外边等。
四点，狗来了。
李明看手表。
四点。
五点，狗走了。
星期三，四点来，五点走。
星期四，四点来，五点走。
李明跟小明说了这件事。
小明：一只狗，四点来，五点走。
李明：对。
小明：那有什么意思？
李明：三天都是四点。
小明：所以呢？
李明：狗没有手表。
小明没有说话。
李明：但是它天天四点来。
小明：那它怎么知道？
李明：我不知道。
小明：你问它。
李明：我跟着它。
小明：跟着一只狗？
李明：对。
小明：好吧。明天我也去。
李明：你不是不喜欢猫吗？
小明：狗不是猫。
english_content:
Tuesday afternoon Li Ming waited outside the shop.
At four the dog came.
Li Ming checked his watch.
Four o'clock.
At five the dog left.
Wednesday: four, then five.
Thursday: four, then five.
Li Ming told Xiao Ming about it.
Xiao Ming: A dog turns up at four and leaves at five.
Li Ming: Yes.
Xiao Ming: And?
Li Ming: Three days, all at four.
Xiao Ming: So?
Li Ming: Dogs don't have watches.
Xiao Ming had nothing to say to that.
Li Ming: And yet it comes at four every day.
Xiao Ming: So how does it know?
Li Ming: I don't know.
Xiao Ming: Ask it, then.
Li Ming: I'm going to follow it.
Xiao Ming: Follow a dog?
Li Ming: Yes.
Xiao Ming: Fine. I'll come too.
Li Ming: I thought you didn't like cats.
Xiao Ming: A dog isn't a cat.

title: 3. 它有主人
english_summary: Nobody on the street owns the dog, and it has been coming for a fortnight. The old woman on the chair has worked out more than anyone: a stray does not look like that, so somewhere it has a person.
content:
星期五，李明问了很多人。
他问店员。
店员：不是我的。
他问饭馆的人。
饭馆的人也说不是。
最后他问奶奶。
奶奶：那只狗？
李明：您认识它？
奶奶：它来了两个星期了。
李明：两个星期？
奶奶：两个星期。
李明：它是谁的？
奶奶：它有主人。
李明：您怎么知道？
奶奶：你看它。
李明看那只狗。
奶奶：它身体很好。
奶奶：没有主人的狗，身体不会这么好。
李明：那它的主人呢？
奶奶：这个我不知道。
李明：它天天四点来。
奶奶：我知道。
李明：您也看见了？
奶奶：我天天在这里。
李明：那它来做什么？
奶奶：它等。
李明：等什么？
奶奶：这个你问它。
english_content:
On Friday Li Ming asked everyone.
He asked the shop assistant.
Shop assistant: Not mine.
He asked at the noodle shop.
They said no as well.
At last he asked the old woman.
Grandma: That dog?
Li Ming: You know it?
Grandma: It's been coming a fortnight.
Li Ming: A fortnight?
Grandma: A fortnight.
Li Ming: Whose is it?
Grandma: It has a person.
Li Ming: How do you know?
Grandma: Look at it.
Li Ming looked at the dog.
Grandma: It's in good condition.
Grandma: A dog with nobody doesn't look like that.
Li Ming: So where's its person?
Grandma: That I don't know.
Li Ming: It comes at four every day.
Grandma: I know.
Li Ming: You've seen it too?
Grandma: I am here every day.
Li Ming: Then what does it come for?
Grandma: It waits.
Li Ming: For what?
Grandma: That one you'll have to ask it.

title: 4. 我们跟着它
english_summary: Twenty minutes on foot, and the dog waits at the kerb for the traffic before it crosses. It goes up six flights and sits down in front of a door that does not open.
content:
星期六下午五点，狗站起来了。
李明和小明跟着它。
狗走得不快。
它在前面，他们在后面。
它走了十分钟。
到了一条大路。
狗在路旁边站住了。
路上的车过去了。
狗过路了。
李明：它等车过去了，就走。
小明：一只狗看车？
李明：你看见了。
小明：这只狗上过学。
他们再走了十分钟。
到了很多楼那边。
狗进了一个楼的门口。
李明和小明也进去了。
里面没有人。
狗上楼了。
一楼，二楼，三楼。
它上到六楼。
它在一个门前面坐下了。
李明：这是它的家。
小明：那它进去啊。
李明看那个门。
门没有开。
狗没有叫。
它坐在门前面。
五点四十。
它还坐在那里。
english_content:
Saturday, five o'clock, the dog stood up.
Li Ming and Xiao Ming followed it.
It didn't hurry.
It went in front, they came behind.
It walked for ten minutes.
They came to a big road.
The dog stopped at the kerb.
The cars went by.
Then it crossed.
Li Ming: It waited for the cars, then went.
Xiao Ming: A dog that checks the road?
Li Ming: You saw it.
Xiao Ming: This dog has been to school.
They walked another ten minutes.
They came to a block of flats.
The dog went in at a doorway.
Li Ming and Xiao Ming went in too.
There was nobody inside.
The dog went up the stairs.
First floor, second, third.
It went all the way to the sixth.
It sat down in front of a door.
Li Ming: This is where it lives.
Xiao Ming: So let it in, then.
Li Ming looked at the door.
The door didn't open.
The dog didn't bark.
It sat in front of it.
Twenty to six.
It was still sitting there.

title: 5. 六楼的爷爷
english_summary: A woman from the fifth floor explains that the flat has an old man in it, and that he has been in hospital a fortnight. She thinks the dog goes out for a walk. She has never asked where.
content:
李明和小明也坐下了。
六点，门还是没有开。
一位女士从五楼上来。
女士：你们做什么？
李明：这只狗……
女士：六楼的狗。
李明：您认识它？
女士：这个楼的人都认识它。
李明：六楼有人吗？
女士：有一位爷爷。
李明：他在家吗？
女士：他在医院。
小明：医院？
女士：他身体不太舒服。
李明：多长时间了？
女士：两个星期。
李明看那只狗。
两个星期。
李明：那它天天一个人在家？
女士：我给它吃的。
女士：它自己出去，自己回来。
李明：它下午出去。
女士：对。三点半出去，六点回来。
李明：不是出去玩。
女士：什么意思？
李明：它四点到我们那条街。
女士：你们那条街？
李明：对。四点到五点。
女士很长时间没有说话。
女士：那是爷爷天天走的路。
english_content:
Li Ming and Xiao Ming sat down as well.
Six o'clock, and the door still hadn't opened.
A woman came up from the fifth floor.
Woman: What are you two doing?
Li Ming: This dog —
Woman: The sixth-floor dog.
Li Ming: You know it?
Woman: Everyone in this building knows it.
Li Ming: Is there anyone on the sixth floor?
Woman: An old gentleman.
Li Ming: Is he home?
Woman: He's in hospital.
Xiao Ming: Hospital?
Woman: He hasn't been well.
Li Ming: How long?
Woman: A fortnight.
Li Ming looked at the dog.
A fortnight.
Li Ming: So it's alone in there every day?
Woman: I feed it.
Woman: It lets itself out and lets itself back.
Li Ming: It goes out in the afternoon.
Woman: Yes. Half three out, six back.
Li Ming: It isn't going out to play.
Woman: What do you mean?
Li Ming: At four it's on our street.
Woman: Your street?
Li Ming: Yes. Four till five.
For a long moment the woman said nothing.
Woman: That is the walk he used to take.

title: 6. 明天四点
english_summary: On Thursday the dog does not come, which is how Li Ming knows. He climbs the six flights to check, and the door is open.
content:
星期四下午，李明在店外边等。
四点，狗没有来。
四点十分，还是没有来。
四点半，没有来。
大毛在椅子上睡觉。
李明：它没有来。
五点，李明去那个楼。
他上到六楼。
门开着。
里面有人说话。
李明站在门口。
一位爷爷坐在椅子上。
狗在他旁边。
爷爷：你是谁？
李明：我……
爷爷：进来。
李明进去了。
爷爷：你就是那个孩子。
李明：您怎么知道？
爷爷：五楼的人跟我说了。
爷爷：她说有两个孩子跟着我的狗。
李明：对不起。
爷爷：为什么对不起？
李明：我们跟着它。
爷爷：你们跟了多远？
李明：从我们那条街。
爷爷很长时间没有说话。
爷爷：它去了那条街。
李明：天天去。
爷爷：天天。
李明：四点到五点。
爷爷：四点到五点。
他的手在狗的头上。
李明：您明天出去走吗？
爷爷：出去。
李明：那我们那条街，四点。
爷爷：四点。
english_content:
Thursday afternoon, Li Ming waited outside the shop.
Four o'clock: no dog.
Ten past: still no dog.
Half four: nothing.
Da Mao was asleep on the chair.
Li Ming: It didn't come.
At five Li Ming went to the building.
He climbed to the sixth floor.
The door was open.
There were voices inside.
Li Ming stood in the doorway.
An old man was sitting in a chair.
The dog was beside him.
Old man: Who are you?
Li Ming: I —
Old man: Come in.
Li Ming went in.
Old man: So you're the boy.
Li Ming: How do you know about me?
Old man: The woman downstairs told me.
Old man: She said two boys followed my dog.
Li Ming: I'm sorry.
Old man: What for?
Li Ming: For following it.
Old man: How far did you follow it?
Li Ming: From our street.
For a long time the old man said nothing.
Old man: It went to that street.
Li Ming: Every day.
Old man: Every day.
Li Ming: Four till five.
Old man: Four till five.
His hand was on the dog's head.
Li Ming: Are you going out tomorrow?
Old man: I am.
Li Ming: Our street, then. Four o'clock.
Old man: Four o'clock.

title: 1. 楼里的声音
english_summary: Li Ming cuts through the old building to get out of the rain. It has been empty for two years. On the way through he hears somebody walking above him.
content:
那天下午下雨了。
李明没有带东西，就从老楼里走。
这个楼很老。
两年前，住在里面的人都搬走了。
楼里面很安静。
外面的雨的声音也小了。
他从一楼往里面走。
然后他听见了一个声音。
是上面来的。
他站住了。
声音没有了。
他又往前走了走。
声音又来了。
不快，也不慢。
有人在上面走。
李明心里想，这个楼没有人住。
他往上看。
楼梯上面很黑。
声音停了。
这一次没有再来。
他等了一分钟。
雨还在下。
他出去了。
到了外面，他回头看那个楼。
五楼有一个窗子。
那个窗子跟别的窗子不一样。
别的窗子里面都是黑的。
那个窗子里面有灯。
english_content:
It rained that afternoon.
Li Ming had nothing to keep the rain off, so he cut through the old building.
It is an old building.
Two years ago everyone living in it moved out.
Inside it was very quiet.
Even the rain got quieter.
He walked in from the ground floor.
And then he heard something.
From above.
He stopped.
The sound stopped too.
He went a little further.
It came again.
Not fast, not slow.
Somebody was walking up there.
Nobody lives in this building, Li Ming thought.
He looked up.
The stairwell above him was dark.
The sound stopped.
This time it did not come back.
He waited a minute.
The rain went on.
He went out.
Outside, he turned and looked back at it.
There was a window on the fifth floor.
It was not like the others.
The rest were dark.
That one had a light on.

title: 2. 楼梯是干净的
english_summary: He goes back the next day to look at it properly, and finds the thing that does not fit. The building is full of dust. The stairs are not.
content:
第二天下午，李明又去了那个楼。
这一次没有下雨。
他不需要从楼里走。
他还是进去了。
一楼没有人。
门口的邮箱都开着。
里面什么都没有。
他往上走。
走到二楼的时候，他发现了一件事。
楼梯很干净。
他站住了，看了看。
门是脏的。
窗子是脏的。
两年没有人住的楼，都是这样。
可是楼梯不脏。
一点儿也不脏。
他往上走到三楼。
三楼的楼梯也是干净的。
四楼也是。
他停在四楼，往上看。
上面是五楼。
他听见了那个声音。
这一次他知道那是什么声音了。
有人在打扫楼梯。
李明没有上去。
他下楼，出去了。
他一边走一边想一个问题。
一个没有人的楼，谁天天打扫楼梯？
english_content:
The next afternoon Li Ming went back.
It was not raining this time.
He had no need to go through the building.
He went in anyway.
The ground floor was empty.
The mailboxes by the door were all hanging open.
There was nothing in any of them.
He started up the stairs.
On the second floor he noticed something.
The stairs were clean.
He stopped and looked properly.
The doors were filthy.
The windows were filthy.
Two years empty — of course they were.
But the stairs were not.
Not in the least.
He went up to the third floor.
The third-floor stairs were clean too.
And the fourth.
He stopped on the fourth and looked up.
The fifth floor was above him.
And he heard the sound.
This time he knew what it was.
Somebody was sweeping the stairs.
Li Ming did not go up.
He went back down and out.
And walking home he turned one question over.
Who sweeps the stairs of a building nobody lives in?

title: 3. 奶奶住了六十年
english_summary: The old woman on the chair lived in that building for sixty years. She knows exactly who is still in it, and she has not thought about him once since the day she moved out.
content:
李明去问奶奶。
她在店外边的椅子上。
李明：您以前住在那个老楼里，是吗？
奶奶：六十年。
李明：六十年。
奶奶：怎么了？
李明：楼里面有人。
奶奶没有回答。
李明：五楼有灯。
李明：楼梯天天有人打扫。
奶奶的手动了一下。
奶奶：老陈。
李明：谁？
奶奶：那个楼的管理员。
李明：他还在？
奶奶：我不知道。
李明：您两年没有见过他？
奶奶：两年。
李明：他多大了？
奶奶：比我小十几岁。
李明：那也很老了。
奶奶：他在那个楼工作了四十年。
李明：四十年。
奶奶：楼里的灯坏了，是他换。
奶奶：楼梯脏了，是他打扫。
李明：现在楼里没有人了。
奶奶很长时间没有说话。
奶奶：我搬走的那天，他帮我拿东西。
奶奶：我没有跟他说再见。
李明：为什么？
奶奶：因为我以为他也要搬。
english_content:
Li Ming went and asked the old woman.
She was on her chair outside the shop.
Li Ming: You used to live in the old building, didn't you?
Grandma: Sixty years.
Li Ming: Sixty years.
Grandma: Why?
Li Ming: There's somebody in it.
She did not answer.
Li Ming: There's a light on the fifth floor.
Li Ming: And somebody sweeps the stairs every day.
Her hand moved.
Grandma: Lao Chen.
Li Ming: Who?
Grandma: The building's caretaker.
Li Ming: He's still there?
Grandma: I don't know.
Li Ming: You haven't seen him in two years?
Grandma: Two years.
Li Ming: How old is he?
Grandma: Ten-odd years younger than me.
Li Ming: That's still old.
Grandma: He worked in that building forty years.
Li Ming: Forty years.
Grandma: When a light went, he changed it.
Grandma: When the stairs got dirty, he swept them.
Li Ming: But there's nobody in it now.
For a long time she said nothing.
Grandma: The day I moved out, he carried my things down.
Grandma: I never said goodbye to him.
Li Ming: Why not?
Grandma: Because I thought he was leaving too.

title: 4. 五楼
english_summary: They climb the five floors together. The man with the broom is not surprised to see them, does not ask what they want, and asks them something else instead.
content:
星期六上午，李明跟小红一起去。
小红：你怕吗？
李明：不怕。
小红：那你走前面。
李明走前面。
一楼，二楼，三楼，四楼。
楼梯都是干净的。
到五楼的时候，他们看见了他。
一位老人，在打扫楼梯。
他很瘦，穿得很干净。
他看见他们，没有停。
老陈：小心，这边还没有扫。
李明和小红站住了。
老陈扫完了那边的楼梯。
然后他才看他们。
老陈：你们家以前住几楼？
李明：我们没有住过这个楼。
老陈：没有住过。
李明：对不起。
老陈：为什么对不起？
小红：您一个人在这里？
老陈：我在这里工作。
小红：楼里没有人住了。
老陈：我知道。
小红：那您为什么还打扫？
老陈第一次停下来了。
老陈：他们要回来。
english_content:
Saturday morning, Li Ming went with Xiao Hong.
Xiao Hong: Are you scared?
Li Ming: No.
Xiao Hong: Then you go first.
Li Ming went first.
One, two, three, four.
The stairs were clean the whole way.
On the fifth floor they saw him.
An old man, sweeping.
He was thin, and neatly dressed.
He saw them and did not stop.
Lao Chen: Mind that side, I haven't done it yet.
The two of them stopped where they were.
He finished that stretch of stair.
Only then did he look at them.
Lao Chen: Which floor was your family on?
Li Ming: We never lived here.
Lao Chen: Never lived here.
Li Ming: I'm sorry.
Lao Chen: What for?
Xiao Hong: Are you here on your own?
Lao Chen: I work here.
Xiao Hong: Nobody lives here any more.
Lao Chen: I know that.
Xiao Hong: Then why do you still sweep?
For the first time he stopped.
Lao Chen: They're coming back.

title: 5. 七百多天
english_summary: He was told the residents would be back once the repairs were finished. He has kept the building ready for them ever since. Nobody has come to tell him anything since.
content:
李明：谁要回来？
老陈：住在这里的人。
小红：他们两年前搬走了。
老陈：他们是先搬走。
老陈：楼要修，人先搬走。
老陈：修好了，他们就回来。
李明：谁跟您说的？
老陈：楼里的人都是这样说的。
小红：那修了吗？
老陈没有回答。
他看了看那个脏的窗子。
李明：没有修。
老陈：还没有。
小红：两年了。
老陈：七百多天。
李明心里一下子难过了。
他知道那个人算过。
小红：这两年，有人来找过您吗？
老陈：没有。
小红：一个人也没有？
老陈：一个人也没有。
李明：那您天天做什么？
老陈：早上扫一楼到五楼。
老陈：下午看看灯，看看水。
老陈：晚上我在五楼。
李明：您住在五楼？
老陈：我住在五楼的小房间。
老陈：那个房间以前是放东西的。
小红：您为什么不搬走？
老陈看了她很长时间。
老陈：他们回来的时候，楼要是干净的。
english_content:
Li Ming: Who's coming back?
Lao Chen: The people who live here.
Xiao Hong: They moved out two years ago.
Lao Chen: They moved out first, yes.
Lao Chen: The building was to be repaired, so people moved out first.
Lao Chen: When it was done they would come back.
Li Ming: Who told you that?
Lao Chen: That is what everyone in the building said.
Xiao Hong: And was it repaired?
He did not answer.
He looked at one of the dirty windows.
Li Ming: It wasn't.
Lao Chen: Not yet.
Xiao Hong: It's been two years.
Lao Chen: Seven hundred-odd days.
Something turned over in Li Ming's chest.
The man had counted them.
Xiao Hong: In two years, has anyone come to see you?
Lao Chen: No.
Xiao Hong: Not one person?
Lao Chen: Not one.
Li Ming: Then what do you do all day?
Lao Chen: In the morning I sweep from the ground floor to the fifth.
Lao Chen: In the afternoon I look at the lights and the water.
Lao Chen: In the evening I'm up on the fifth.
Li Ming: You live on the fifth floor?
Lao Chen: I live in the little room on the fifth floor.
Lao Chen: It used to be where things were kept.
Xiao Hong: Why don't you move out?
He looked at her for a long time.
Lao Chen: When they come back, the building has to be clean.

title: 6. 一个星期一次
english_summary: Li Ming tells the old woman, and she does not say anything for a long time. Then she gets up out of the chair, and what she asks him for is not help.
content:
李明回去跟奶奶说了。
他说了七百多天。
他说完了，奶奶很长时间没有说话。
最后她站起来了。
李明：您去哪儿？
奶奶：五楼。
李明：您要上五楼？
奶奶：我在那个楼上下了六十年。
他们一起去了。
她走得很慢。
每一层她都要休息一下。
到五楼的时候，老陈正在打扫。
他看见她，手停了。
老陈：您……
奶奶：老陈。
老陈：您回来了。
奶奶没有说话。
她走到一个门前面。
那是她住了六十年的门。
她看了很久。
奶奶：我不回来住了。
老陈：……我知道。
奶奶：你也知道别人都不回来了。
老陈没有回答。
奶奶：老陈。
老陈：您说。
奶奶：我一个星期来一次。
老陈：来做什么？
奶奶：看看我的窗子。
奶奶：一个星期一次，一年五十多次。
老陈：……好。
奶奶：那五楼要是干净的。
老陈很长时间没有说话。
然后他拿起了他的东西。
老陈：五楼一直是干净的。
他们下楼的时候，李明回头看了一下。
老陈在打扫五楼的楼梯。
他打扫得跟以前一样。
可是这一次，他是给一个人扫的。
english_content:
Li Ming went back and told the old woman.
He told her about the seven hundred-odd days.
When he had finished she was quiet for a long time.
At last she stood up.
Li Ming: Where are you going?
Grandma: The fifth floor.
Li Ming: You're going to climb five floors?
Grandma: I went up and down that building for sixty years.
They went together.
She was slow.
She rested on every landing.
When they got to the fifth floor Lao Chen was sweeping.
He saw her, and his hands stopped.
Lao Chen: You —
Grandma: Lao Chen.
Lao Chen: You came back.
She did not answer that.
She walked to one of the doors.
It was the door she had lived behind for sixty years.
She looked at it a long while.
Grandma: I'm not coming back to live here.
Lao Chen: … I know.
Grandma: And you know none of the others are either.
He did not answer.
Grandma: Lao Chen.
Lao Chen: Yes.
Grandma: I will come once a week.
Lao Chen: To do what?
Grandma: To look at my window.
Grandma: Once a week. Fifty-odd times a year.
Lao Chen: … All right.
Grandma: So the fifth floor will have to be clean.
For a long time Lao Chen said nothing.
Then he picked up his broom.
Lao Chen: The fifth floor has always been clean.
On the way down Li Ming looked back once.
Lao Chen was sweeping the fifth-floor stairs.
He was sweeping them exactly as before.
Except that this time he was sweeping them for somebody.

title: 1. 老王的眼镜
english_summary: The noodle shop wants a second-hand table and its owner cannot see well enough to write the notice himself. Li Ming writes it for him. He writes one character the wrong way round.
content:
星期一，下午李明去饭馆吃面条儿。
老王在门那边看一个东西。
他拿得很远。
李明：您的眼睛怎么了？
老王：我的眼镜坏了。
李明：什么时候？
老王：星期六。
李明：那您怎么做饭？
老王：做饭不用眼睛。
老王：三十年了。
李明笑了。
老王：小李，你帮我一个忙。
李明：您说。
老王：我要一张桌子。
李明：新的？
老王：旧的也行。这边的人有旧桌子。
老王：你帮我写几个字，放在门那边。
李明：写什么？
老王：买桌子。
李明：就三个字？
老王：三个字可以了。
李明写了三个字。
他写得很快。
他没有再看。
老王也没有看。
老王：谢谢你。
李明：不客气。
李明放好那几个字，回家了。
那三个字写的不是买，是卖。
english_content:
Monday afternoon, Li Ming went to the noodle shop for a bowl of noodles.
Lao Wang was by the door, squinting at something.
He was holding it a long way from his face.
Li Ming: What's wrong with your eyes?
Lao Wang: My glasses broke.
Li Ming: When?
Lao Wang: Saturday.
Li Ming: Then how are you cooking?
Lao Wang: Cooking doesn't need eyes.
Lao Wang: Thirty years of it.
Li Ming laughed.
Lao Wang: Xiao Li, do something for me.
Li Ming: Go on.
Lao Wang: I need a table.
Li Ming: A new one?
Lao Wang: Second-hand is fine. People round here have old tables.
Lao Wang: Write a few characters for me and put it up by the door.
Li Ming: Saying what?
Lao Wang: Buying a table.
Li Ming: Just those three characters?
Lao Wang: Three will do.
Li Ming wrote three characters.
He wrote them quickly.
He did not read them back.
Lao Wang did not read them either.
Lao Wang: Thank you.
Li Ming: Any time.
Li Ming put the paper up by the door and went home.
The three characters he had written did not say BUY. They said SELL.

title: 2. 第一个客人
english_summary: A man comes in and asks how much for the table. Lao Wang, who cannot read his own notice, decides the customer wants to give him one, and the conversation goes downhill from there.
content:
星期二上午，一个人进了饭馆。
他没有坐下。
客人：多少钱？
老王：面条儿八块。
客人：我不吃面条儿。
老王：那您要什么？
客人：桌子。
老王：桌子？
客人：门那边写着。
老王：对，我要桌子。
客人：我也要桌子。
老王：那您跟我一样。
那个人不说话了。
客人：您卖不卖？
老王：我买。
客人：您买？
老王：我买。
客人：那门那边为什么写卖？
老王：不可能。
客人：您自己去看。
老王走到门那边。
他把那几个字拿到眼睛前面。
他看了很长时间。
老王：我的眼镜坏了。
客人：那您卖还是不卖？
老王：我……不卖。
那个人往外走。
他一边走一边说话。
客人：这个店要没有了，人还这么好。
老王没有听清楚。
english_content:
Tuesday morning a man came into the shop.
He did not sit down.
Customer: How much?
Lao Wang: Noodles are eight.
Customer: I don't want noodles.
Lao Wang: What do you want, then?
Customer: The table.
Lao Wang: The table?
Customer: It says so by the door.
Lao Wang: That's right — I want a table.
Customer: So do I.
Lao Wang: Then we're in the same boat.
The man went quiet.
Customer: Are you selling or not?
Lao Wang: I'm buying.
Customer: You're buying?
Lao Wang: I'm buying.
Customer: Then why does it say SELLING by the door?
Lao Wang: It doesn't.
Customer: Go and look.
Lao Wang walked over to the door.
He held the paper up close to his face.
He looked at it a long time.
Lao Wang: My glasses are broken.
Customer: So are you selling or aren't you?
Lao Wang: I'm — not selling.
The man headed out.
He was talking as he went.
Customer: Place is shutting down and he's still this nice about it.
Lao Wang did not quite catch it.

title: 3. 这条街都知道了
english_summary: By the afternoon the news has gone the whole length of the street and come back changed. Xiao Ming has heard it from three people. None of them has been inside the shop.
content:
星期二下午，李明在学校门口。
小明跑过来。
小明：你知道了吗？
李明：知道什么？
小明：老王的店要卖了。
李明：不可能。
小明：门那边写着。
李明：谁跟你说的？
小明：我妈妈。
李明：她看见了？
小明：超市的人跟她说的。
李明：超市的人看见了？
小明：书店的人跟超市的人说的。
李明：那书店的人呢？
小明：不知道。
李明心里有点儿奇怪。
小明：他三十年了。
李明：我知道。
小明：我爸爸说，这条街要变了。
李明：变什么？
小明：老店都没有了。
李明没有说话。
他一边走一边想。
老王星期一还问他要桌子。
一个要卖店的人，不会买桌子。
他走到饭馆门口。
他看那几个字。
他看了一会儿。
然后他知道了。
那个字是他写的。
english_content:
Tuesday afternoon, Li Ming was outside school.
Xiao Ming came running over.
Xiao Ming: Have you heard?
Li Ming: Heard what?
Xiao Ming: Lao Wang's place is being sold.
Li Ming: No it isn't.
Xiao Ming: It says so by the door.
Li Ming: Who told you?
Xiao Ming: My mum.
Li Ming: She saw it?
Xiao Ming: The woman in the supermarket told her.
Li Ming: And she saw it?
Xiao Ming: The bookshop told the supermarket.
Li Ming: And who told the bookshop?
Xiao Ming: No idea.
Something about it bothered Li Ming.
Xiao Ming: Thirty years, that shop.
Li Ming: I know.
Xiao Ming: My dad says the street's changing.
Li Ming: Changing how?
Xiao Ming: The old shops are all going.
Li Ming said nothing.
He thought about it the whole way home.
On Monday Lao Wang had been after a table.
A man selling up does not buy furniture.
He got to the shop door.
He looked at the notice.
He looked at it for a moment.
And then he knew.
It was his own handwriting.

title: 4. 我写错了
english_summary: He goes in to own up, and cannot. The shop is fuller than he has ever seen it, and every person in it has come for a reason he is responsible for.
content:
李明进了饭馆。
里面的人比平时多。
每张桌子都有人。
老王在里面做面条儿。
他做得很快，没有时间说话。
李明站在中间。
女士：老王，真的要走了？
老王：什么？
女士：我在这里吃了二十年。
老王：您天天来。
女士：以后去哪儿吃？
老王：您明天也来。
女士：明天还有吗？
老王：……有。
他没有听懂，可是他没有时间问。
李明走到里面。
李明：老王。
老王：小李！你来得正好，帮我一下。
李明：我要跟您说一件事。
老王：等一下，先帮我。
李明帮了他两个小时。
两个小时里，进来了四十多个人。
有的人李明从来没有见过。
有的人跟老王说了很久。
老王一直在做面条儿。
六点半，人少了。
老王坐下来。
老王：今天真奇怪。
李明：老王，我……
老王：三十年了，我没有这样忙过。
李明没有说下去。
english_content:
Li Ming went into the shop.
There were more people in it than usual.
Every table was full.
Lao Wang was in the back making noodles.
He was working fast. No time to talk.
Li Ming stood in the middle of it.
A woman: Lao Wang, is it true you're going?
Lao Wang: What?
Woman: I've eaten here twenty years.
Lao Wang: You come every day.
Woman: Where am I supposed to go now?
Lao Wang: Come tomorrow as well.
Woman: Will you still be here tomorrow?
Lao Wang: … Yes.
He had not understood, and there was no time to ask.
Li Ming worked his way to the back.
Li Ming: Lao Wang.
Lao Wang: Xiao Li! Perfect timing — give me a hand.
Li Ming: There's something I have to tell you.
Lao Wang: In a minute. Help first.
Li Ming helped him for two hours.
In those two hours more than forty people came in.
Some of them Li Ming had never seen before.
Some of them talked to Lao Wang for a long time.
Lao Wang just kept making noodles.
By half six it thinned out.
Lao Wang sat down.
Lao Wang: Strange sort of day.
Li Ming: Lao Wang, I —
Lao Wang: Thirty years, and I've never been that busy.
Li Ming did not go on.

title: 5. 最后一天
english_summary: By Thursday people are turning up who moved away years ago. One of them drives an hour for a bowl of noodles and says something Lao Wang has waited thirty years to hear.
content:
星期三，人更多。
星期四，人最多。
外面还有人在等。
李明天天来帮忙。
他没有说那件事。
星期四下午，来了一位先生。
他不是这条街的人。
他穿得很好，开车来的。
先生：老王。
老王看了他很长时间。
老王：小周？
先生：您还认识我。
老王：你搬走多少年了？
先生：十四年。
老王：十四年。
先生：我今天开了一个小时的车。
老王：为什么？
先生：我听说这是最后几天。
老王没有回答。
先生：我小时候天天在这里吃。
先生：我一直想跟您说一件事。
老王：你说。
先生：我十岁的时候，我家里很难。
先生：我妈妈没有钱。
先生：可是我天天有面条儿吃。
老王：那是很久以前的事了。
先生：您那个时候没有跟我妈妈要钱。
老王：面条儿不贵。
先生：一天不贵。
先生：三年不是不贵。
老王没有说话。
李明站在旁边，一个字也说不出来。
先生走的时候，跟老王说了再见。
先生：谢谢您。
老王坐下来，很长时间没有动。
english_content:
On Wednesday there were more.
On Thursday there were most of all.
People were queueing outside.
Li Ming came and helped every day.
He did not say the thing.
On Thursday afternoon a man came in.
He was not from the street.
He was well dressed. He had driven.
Customer: Lao Wang.
Lao Wang looked at him a long moment.
Lao Wang: Xiao Zhou?
Customer: You still know me.
Lao Wang: How many years since you moved?
Customer: Fourteen.
Lao Wang: Fourteen years.
Customer: I drove an hour to get here today.
Lao Wang: What for?
Customer: I heard these were the last days.
Lao Wang did not answer.
Customer: I ate here every day when I was small.
Customer: There's something I always meant to say to you.
Lao Wang: Say it.
Customer: When I was ten things were hard at home.
Customer: My mother had no money.
Customer: And I ate noodles every day.
Lao Wang: That was a long time ago.
Customer: You never asked her for it.
Lao Wang: Noodles aren't expensive.
Customer: For one day they aren't.
Customer: For three years they are.
Lao Wang said nothing.
Li Ming stood beside them and could not get a word out.
On his way out the man said goodbye to him.
Customer: Thank you.
Lao Wang sat down and did not move for a long time.

title: 6. 那个字
english_summary: Li Ming finally tells him. Lao Wang holds the paper up to his face, works out what it says, and then makes a request Li Ming does not expect.
content:
星期五早上，李明来得很早。
店里没有人。
李明：老王，我要跟您说一件事。
老王：你说了四天了。
李明：这一次我真的要说。
老王：好。
李明把门那边的那几个字拿过来。
李明：您看这个字。
老王拿到眼睛前面。
他看了很长时间。
老王：卖。
李明：对。
老王：我说的是买。
李明：我知道。
老王：你写错了。
李明：我写错了。
老王：星期一写的？
李明：星期一。
老王：所以这四天……
李明：都是因为这个字。
老王没有说话。
李明：对不起。
李明：我明天写一个新的。
老王还是没有说话。
他把那几个字放在桌子上。
他看着它。
老王：小周十四年没有来过。
李明：我知道。
老王：那位女士，二十年。
老王：她昨天才跟我说她的名字。
李明没有回答。
老王：一个字。
李明：一个字。
老王终于笑了。
老王：小李。
李明：您说。
老王：你把那个字写大一点儿。
李明：写大？
老王：写大。
老王：我这三十年，太安静了。
english_content:
Friday morning Li Ming came early.
The shop was empty.
Li Ming: Lao Wang, I have to tell you something.
Lao Wang: You've been telling me for four days.
Li Ming: This time I'm actually going to say it.
Lao Wang: All right.
Li Ming fetched the notice from beside the door.
Li Ming: Look at this character.
Lao Wang held it up to his face.
He looked at it a long while.
Lao Wang: Sell.
Li Ming: Yes.
Lao Wang: I said buy.
Li Ming: I know.
Lao Wang: You wrote it wrong.
Li Ming: I wrote it wrong.
Lao Wang: Monday?
Li Ming: Monday.
Lao Wang: So these four days —
Li Ming: All because of that character.
Lao Wang said nothing.
Li Ming: I'm sorry.
Li Ming: I'll write a new one tomorrow.
Still Lao Wang said nothing.
He put the notice down on the table.
He looked at it.
Lao Wang: Xiao Zhou hasn't been here in fourteen years.
Li Ming: I know.
Lao Wang: That woman — twenty years she's eaten here.
Lao Wang: Yesterday was the first time she told me her name.
Li Ming did not answer.
Lao Wang: One character.
Li Ming: One character.
At last Lao Wang laughed.
Lao Wang: Xiao Li.
Li Ming: Yes?
Lao Wang: Write that character a bit bigger.
Li Ming: Bigger?
Lao Wang: Bigger.
Lao Wang: Thirty years I've had. Far too quiet.

title: 1. 对面开了一家店
english_summary: Something opens across the road with air conditioning, photographs of the food, and noodles at six yuan. Lao Wang goes over to look at it once and comes back without saying anything.
content:
三月，对面的空房子开始装修。
装修了三个星期。
四月一号，那家店开门了。
里面很亮，很干净，有空调。
墙上有很多照片，都是他们的菜。
照片下面写着价格。
面条儿六块。
老王的面条儿八块。
开门那天，对面的人排队排到了外面。
老王站在自己店的门口看。
他看了很久。
李明：您要不要过去看看？
老王：不用。
可是下午三点，李明看见他过去了。
他在里面待了二十分钟。
回来的时候，他什么也没有说。
李明：怎么样？
老王：很干净。
李明：面条儿呢？
老王没有回答。
他去洗桌子了。
那天晚上，老王的店里有四个客人。
平时是二十个。
李明：今天是第一天，大家都想去看看。
老王：对。
李明：明天就好了。
老王：对。
他一边说一边看对面。
对面的灯到十一点才关。
english_content:
In March the empty unit across the road went under refurbishment.
It took three weeks.
On the first of April it opened.
Inside it was bright and clean and air-conditioned.
The walls were covered in photographs of the food.
Under each photograph was the price.
Noodles: six yuan.
Lao Wang charged eight.
On opening day the queue reached out onto the pavement.
Lao Wang stood in his own doorway and watched it.
He watched for a long time.
Li Ming: Do you want to go over and have a look?
Lao Wang: No need.
But at three in the afternoon Li Ming saw him cross the road.
He was inside for twenty minutes.
When he came back he said nothing at all.
Li Ming: Well?
Lao Wang: Very clean.
Li Ming: And the noodles?
Lao Wang did not answer.
He went off to wipe the tables.
That evening there were four customers in his shop.
There were usually twenty.
Li Ming: It's the first day. Everyone wants a look.
Lao Wang: Yes.
Li Ming: It'll be fine tomorrow.
Lao Wang: Yes.
He said it while looking across the road.
The lights over there did not go off until eleven.

title: 2. 一个月
english_summary: A month later the numbers have not come back. Lao Wang drops his price to six, which costs him more than the two yuan, and it does not bring anyone in.
content:
一个月以后，情况没有变好。
中午的时候，老王的店里有六七个客人。
对面还是要排队。
五月的一天晚上，老王算了很久的账。
李明在旁边写作业。
李明：您在算什么？
老王：这个月的收入。
李明：少多少？
老王：一半。
李明没有说话。
老王：房租不会少一半。
第二天，老王在门口写了新的价格。
面条儿六块。
跟对面一样。
李明：您这样还赚钱吗？
老王：赚一点儿。
李明：一点儿是多少？
老王：你去写作业。
那个星期，客人多了两三个。
下个星期，又少了。
李明：为什么？价格一样了。
老王：因为价格从来不是问题。
李明：那什么是问题？
老王：他们那边有空调。
老王：他们那边有照片。
老王：他们那边座位多。
李明：那您也可以有。
老王第一次没有说不用。
english_content:
A month later nothing had improved.
At lunchtime he had six or seven customers.
Across the road they were still queueing.
One evening in May Lao Wang sat over his books a long time.
Li Ming was doing homework beside him.
Li Ming: What are you working out?
Lao Wang: This month's takings.
Li Ming: Down by how much?
Lao Wang: Half.
Li Ming said nothing.
Lao Wang: The rent isn't going down by half.
The next day he wrote a new price by the door.
Noodles: six yuan.
The same as across the road.
Li Ming: Do you still make anything at six?
Lao Wang: A little.
Li Ming: How little?
Lao Wang: Go and do your homework.
That week he got two or three more customers.
The week after, they were gone again.
Li Ming: Why? The price is the same now.
Lao Wang: Because the price was never the problem.
Li Ming: Then what is?
Lao Wang: They've got air conditioning.
Lao Wang: They've got photographs.
Lao Wang: They've got more seats.
Li Ming: You could have those too.
For the first time Lao Wang did not say there was no need.

title: 3. 老王的新菜单
english_summary: He borrows money, puts photographs on the wall, and adds eleven dishes he has never made before. The shop stops looking like his shop, and the food gets worse.
content:
六月，老王借了钱。
他买了空调。
他在墙上放了很多照片。
他还做了一个新菜单。
以前他只有四种面条儿。
现在他有十五种。
李明：这些您都会做吗？
老王：可以学。
前三天还行。
第四天，一位客人叫了一个新菜。
他吃了两口就不吃了。
老王：不好吃吗？
客人：不难吃。
老王：那怎么了？
客人：这个我在对面吃过。
客人：他们做得比您好。
老王没有说话。
客人：您以前的面条儿呢？
老王：还有。在菜单最后面。
客人：那您为什么放在最后面？
老王回答不了。
那天晚上，李明发现了一件事。
老王的店现在跟对面很像。
一样的照片，一样的空调，一样的菜。
可是对面那家是新的，这家是旧的。
两家一样的店，客人会去新的那家。
english_content:
In June Lao Wang borrowed money.
He bought an air conditioner.
He put photographs up on the wall.
And he made a new menu.
He used to have four kinds of noodles.
Now he had fifteen.
Li Ming: Can you make all of these?
Lao Wang: They can be learned.
The first three days were all right.
On the fourth day a customer ordered one of the new dishes.
He ate two mouthfuls and stopped.
Lao Wang: Is it not good?
Customer: It's not bad.
Lao Wang: Then what?
Customer: I've had this across the road.
Customer: They do it better.
Lao Wang said nothing.
Customer: What about your old noodles?
Lao Wang: Still there. Back of the menu.
Customer: Then why did you put them at the back?
Lao Wang had no answer.
That evening Li Ming noticed something.
The shop now looked a lot like the one over the road.
The same photographs, the same air conditioning, the same dishes.
Except the one over the road was new, and this one was old.
Given two identical shops, people go to the newer one.

title: 4. 七月的账
english_summary: July is worse than June. Lao Wang says out loud, for the first time, that he has thought about giving it up — and Li Ming realises he has never once heard him complain.
content:
七月的收入比六月还少。
借的钱要还。
房租要交。
空调一开，电费又高。
七月底的一天晚上，店里没有客人。
老王一个人坐着。
李明：您还好吗？
老王：我在想一件事。
李明：什么事？
老王：如果我放弃，我今年还能剩下一点儿钱。
老王：如果我再做一年，可能一分也不剩。
李明第一次听见他说放弃。
李明：您做了三十年。
老王：三十年不是理由。
李明：那什么是理由？
老王没有回答。
他站起来去洗那些干净的碗。
李明看着他。
他忽然想到，这几个月老王一次也没有说过对面的坏话。
一次也没有。
李明：老王。
老王：嗯。
李明：对面的面条儿，到底好不好吃？
老王想了很久。
老王：好吃。
李明：真的？
老王：他们的汤是真的用了时间的。
老王：我尝得出来。
李明：那您……
老王：所以我不说他们的坏话。
english_content:
July's takings were lower than June's.
The loan had to be repaid.
The rent had to be paid.
And running the air conditioning put the electricity up.
One evening at the end of July there was nobody in the shop.
Lao Wang sat there alone.
Li Ming: Are you all right?
Lao Wang: I've been thinking about something.
Li Ming: What?
Lao Wang: If I give it up now I'd still have a little left this year.
Lao Wang: If I keep going another year, there might be nothing.
It was the first time Li Ming had heard him say the word.
Li Ming: You've done thirty years.
Lao Wang: Thirty years is not a reason.
Li Ming: Then what is?
Lao Wang did not answer.
He got up and washed bowls that were already clean.
Li Ming watched him.
It struck him that in all these months Lao Wang had never once said a bad word about the place across the road.
Not once.
Li Ming: Lao Wang.
Lao Wang: Mm.
Li Ming: Those noodles across the road — are they actually any good?
Lao Wang thought about it a long time.
Lao Wang: They're good.
Li Ming: Really?
Lao Wang: Their broth has real time in it.
Lao Wang: I can taste it.
Li Ming: Then you —
Lao Wang: That's why I don't run them down.

title: 5. 奶奶的意见
english_summary: The old woman has eaten in that shop for sixty years and has not been in since May. She tells him why in four sentences, and none of them is about the price.
content:
八月的一天，奶奶来了。
她从五月以后没有来过。
老王：您好久没来了。
奶奶：对。
老王：您去对面了？
奶奶：没有。我在家吃。
老王没有说话。
这比她去对面更让他难过。
奶奶坐下来，看了看墙上的照片。
奶奶：这些是什么？
老王：菜的照片。
奶奶：我知道是照片。我问这些是什么菜。
老王：新的。
奶奶：你会做吗？
老王：会一点儿。
奶奶：会一点儿。
她把菜单从头看到尾。
奶奶：你的面条儿在第几页？
老王：最后一页。
奶奶：为什么？
老王：因为大家都想吃新的。
奶奶：我不是大家。
奶奶：我在这里吃了六十年。
奶奶：我五月来的时候，看不懂这是谁的店。
老王：……
奶奶：对面那家做得好，你学不过来的。
奶奶：他们有钱，有人，有时间。
奶奶：你有的东西他们一样也没有。
老王：我有什么？
奶奶：六十年里，我妈妈也在这里吃过。
奶奶把菜单放下。
奶奶：给我一碗面条儿。你以前那种。
english_content:
One day in August the old woman came in.
She had not been in since May.
Lao Wang: It's been a while.
Grandma: It has.
Lao Wang: Have you been going over the road?
Grandma: No. I've been eating at home.
Lao Wang said nothing.
That hurt more than if she had gone across the road.
She sat down and looked at the photographs on the wall.
Grandma: What are these?
Lao Wang: Pictures of the food.
Grandma: I know they're pictures. I'm asking what the food is.
Lao Wang: New dishes.
Grandma: Can you make them?
Lao Wang: More or less.
Grandma: More or less.
She read the menu from top to bottom.
Grandma: Which page are your noodles on?
Lao Wang: The last one.
Grandma: Why?
Lao Wang: Because people want the new things.
Grandma: I am not people.
Grandma: I have eaten here sixty years.
Grandma: When I came in May I could not tell whose shop I was in.
Lao Wang: …
Grandma: They do their thing well. You will not out-learn them.
Grandma: They have money and staff and time.
Grandma: What you have, they haven't got any of.
Lao Wang: What have I got?
Grandma: In those sixty years, my mother ate here too.
She put the menu down.
Grandma: Give me a bowl of noodles. The way you used to.

title: 6. 十一月
english_summary: He takes the photographs down and the menu back to four things. The shop does not win. It gets smaller, steadier, and unmistakably his, and he says he can live with second.
content:
九月，老王把墙上的照片都拿下来了。
新菜单也没有了。
他做回了四种面条儿。
空调他留下了。
李明：为什么空调留下？
老王：因为空调是好东西。
老王：照片不是。
价格他也改回去了。
面条儿八块。
李明：您涨回去，客人会更少。
老王：六块的面条儿我做不出六块的味道。
老王：那样对不起吃的人。
十一月，李明又跟他算了一次账。
李明：比七月好一点儿。
老王：好一点儿。
李明：比去年呢？
老王：去年的一半。
李明：那……
老王：那是我今年的收入。
李明：您不难过吗？
老王想了一会儿。
老王：难过。
老王：可是我现在知道一件事。
李明：什么事？
老王：我这条街上不是最好的店。
老王：以前我不知道，因为没有第二家。
李明：那您现在……
老王：现在我知道我是第二。
老王：第二也是要有人做的。
那天晚上，店里有十四个客人。
不多。
可是这十四个人，都是来吃他的面条儿的。
对面还在排队。
老王没有再看对面。
english_content:
In September Lao Wang took the photographs off the wall.
The new menu went too.
He went back to four kinds of noodles.
He kept the air conditioning.
Li Ming: Why keep that?
Lao Wang: Because air conditioning is a good thing.
Lao Wang: Photographs aren't.
He put the price back as well.
Noodles: eight yuan.
Li Ming: Putting it up will lose you more people.
Lao Wang: At six yuan I cannot make it taste like anything.
Lao Wang: And that is unfair to whoever eats it.
In November Li Ming went through the books with him again.
Li Ming: A bit better than July.
Lao Wang: A bit better.
Li Ming: And compared to last year?
Lao Wang: Half of last year.
Li Ming: So —
Lao Wang: So that is what I earn this year.
Li Ming: Doesn't that upset you?
Lao Wang thought about it.
Lao Wang: It does.
Lao Wang: But I know something now.
Li Ming: What?
Lao Wang: I am not the best shop on this street.
Lao Wang: I didn't know that before, because there wasn't a second one.
Li Ming: And now?
Lao Wang: Now I know I'm second.
Lao Wang: Somebody has to be second.
That evening there were fourteen people in the shop.
Not many.
But all fourteen of them had come for his noodles.
Across the road they were still queueing.
Lao Wang did not look over there again.

title: 1. 老王的版本
english_summary: Li Ming asks a question nobody on the street has ever asked out loud. The first answer comes with a date, a season and a reason, and is delivered without a moment of hesitation.
content:
大毛在这条街上，比李明还久。
没有人问过它是从哪儿来的。
十一月的一天，李明问了。
他先问老王。
李明：大毛是从哪儿来的？
老王一点儿也没有想。
老王：下大雨那天自己走进来的。
李明：哪一年？
老王：十二年前。
李明：您怎么这么确定？
老王：因为那个星期我换了门口的招牌。
老王：我记得很清楚。
李明：它进来做什么？
老王：躲雨。它坐在里面不走。
老王：我给了它一点儿肉。
老王：第二天它又来了。
老王：从那天起它就没有走过。
李明：所以是您第一个给它东西吃的。
老王：对。
他说这个的时候，语气跟平时不一样。
李明那个时候没有注意。
后来他才明白，那是骄傲。
english_content:
Da Mao had been on this street longer than Li Ming had.
Nobody had ever asked where he came from.
One day in November, Li Ming asked.
He asked Lao Wang first.
Li Ming: Where did Da Mao come from?
Lao Wang did not hesitate at all.
Lao Wang: He walked in himself, the day of the big rain.
Li Ming: Which year?
Lao Wang: Twelve years ago.
Li Ming: How are you so sure?
Lao Wang: Because that was the week I changed the sign over the door.
Lao Wang: I remember it perfectly.
Li Ming: What did he come in for?
Lao Wang: To get out of the rain. He sat down inside and would not move.
Lao Wang: I gave him a bit of meat.
Lao Wang: The next day he came back.
Lao Wang: And from that day he never left.
Li Ming: So you were the first person to feed him.
Lao Wang: Yes.
There was something in the way he said it that was not his usual tone.
Li Ming did not notice it at the time.
Only later did he understand that it was pride.

title: 2. 店员的版本
english_summary: The second answer is equally certain, equally detailed, and rules the first one out entirely. It also comes from someone who has only worked on this street for three years.
content:
第二个人是店里的店员。
李明：您知道大毛是从哪儿来的吗？
店员：知道啊。三楼那家人不要它了。
李明：哪家人？
店员：老楼三楼，姓周的。
店员：他们搬走的时候没有带它。
李明：您看见了？
店员：我看见它在楼下叫了三天。
李明：三天？
店员：三天。我给它拿了牛奶。
李明：您是第一个给它东西吃的？
店员：应该是。那个时候没有别人给它东西吃。
李明：这是哪一年的事？
店员：我来这条街第二年。
李明：您来了几年了？
店员：三年。
李明站在那里，没有说话。
老王说十二年前。
她说两年前。
两个人都很确定。
两个人的细节都很具体。
两个人的版本不可能同时是真的。
english_content:
The second person was the shop assistant.
Li Ming: Do you know where Da Mao came from?
Shop assistant: Of course. The family on the third floor didn't want him.
Li Ming: Which family?
Shop assistant: The old building, third floor. The Zhous.
Shop assistant: When they moved they left him behind.
Li Ming: You saw this?
Shop assistant: I saw him crying downstairs for three days.
Li Ming: Three days?
Shop assistant: Three days. I took him milk.
Li Ming: You were the first person to feed him?
Shop assistant: I should think so. Nobody else was bothering with him.
Li Ming: What year was this?
Shop assistant: My second year on this street.
Li Ming: How long have you been here?
Shop assistant: Three years.
Li Ming stood there and said nothing.
Lao Wang had said twelve years ago.
She was saying two.
Both of them were completely certain.
Both of their accounts were full of specifics.
Both versions could not possibly be true at once.

title: 3. 小明爸爸的版本
english_summary: The third version puts the cat in the school playground and the teller among the children who fed him. The arithmetic on that does not work, and Li Ming decides not to say so.
content:
第三个人是小明的爸爸。
他在这条街上住了四十多年。
李明：叔叔，大毛是从哪儿来的？
他笑了。
叔叔：那是学校的猫。
李明：学校的？
叔叔：它是在学校后面生的。
叔叔：我们几个孩子轮流喂它。
李明：您也喂过？
叔叔：我喂得最多。
叔叔：别的孩子过两天就忘了。
李明：那是什么时候？
叔叔：我十来岁的时候。
李明在心里算了一下。
小明的爸爸今年四十五。
那就是三十五年前。
一只猫活不到三十五岁。
李明没有说出来。
他看着这位叔叔说那几个孩子的样子。
他说得那么高兴。
李明想，也许他记的不是这只猫。
也许他记的是他自己十岁的那个下午。
english_content:
The third person was Xiao Ming's father.
He had lived on this street for over forty years.
Li Ming: Where did Da Mao come from?
He laughed.
Uncle: That was the school cat.
Li Ming: The school's?
Uncle: He was born round the back of the school.
Uncle: A few of us kids took turns feeding him.
Li Ming: You fed him too?
Uncle: I fed him the most.
Uncle: The other kids forgot about him after a couple of days.
Li Ming: When was this?
Uncle: When I was ten or so.
Li Ming did the arithmetic in his head.
Xiao Ming's father was forty-five.
That made it thirty-five years ago.
No cat lives to thirty-five.
Li Ming did not say so.
He watched the man talking about those children.
He was so pleased telling it.
Perhaps, Li Ming thought, the cat he is remembering is a different cat.
Perhaps what he is remembering is one afternoon when he was ten.

title: 4. 老陈的版本
english_summary: The caretaker gives the most exact answer of anyone — a month, a floor, a spot under the stairs. He is also the only person on the street nobody had thought to ask.
content:
第四个人是老陈。
李明在老楼的五楼找到他。
李明：老陈，我问您一件事。
老陈：你问。
李明：那只猫，您知道它是从哪儿来的吗？
老陈没有马上回答。
他把手里的东西放下。
老陈：四楼楼梯下面。
李明：什么意思？
老陈：它是在那里生的。四月。
李明：您怎么知道？
老陈：因为那几天是我打扫四楼。
老陈：一共三只，两只没有活下来。
李明：那它妈妈呢？
老陈：后来就不见了。
李明：所以是您养大的。
老陈：我没有养它。我只是没有赶它走。
这是四个版本里，唯一一个说自己不是第一个的人。
李明：这是哪一年？
老陈：十二年前。
李明：十二年前？
老陈：四月。
老王说的也是十二年前。
可是老王说的是下大雨那天。
李明忽然想问一个问题。
李明：老陈，十二年前四月，下过大雨吗？
老陈想了想。
老陈：那年四月，一场雨也没有下过。
english_content:
The fourth person was Lao Chen.
Li Ming found him on the fifth floor of the old building.
Li Ming: Lao Chen, I want to ask you something.
Lao Chen: Ask.
Li Ming: The cat — do you know where he came from?
Lao Chen did not answer straight away.
He put down what he was holding.
Lao Chen: Under the fourth-floor stairs.
Li Ming: Meaning?
Lao Chen: That is where he was born. April.
Li Ming: How do you know?
Lao Chen: Because I was the one sweeping the fourth floor that week.
Lao Chen: Three of them. Two didn't make it.
Li Ming: And the mother?
Lao Chen: She was gone after that.
Li Ming: So you raised him.
Lao Chen: I didn't raise him. I just didn't chase him off.
Of the four versions, this was the only one where the teller did not claim to be the first.
Li Ming: Which year was this?
Lao Chen: Twelve years ago.
Li Ming: Twelve years ago?
Lao Chen: April.
Lao Wang had said twelve years too.
But Lao Wang had said the day of the big rain.
A question occurred to Li Ming.
Li Ming: Lao Chen — twelve years ago, in April, was there a heavy rain?
Lao Chen thought about it.
Lao Chen: That April it did not rain once.

title: 5. 四个版本
english_summary: Li Ming writes the four accounts out side by side. Every detail contradicts every other detail — except one, which all four have in common, and which none of them noticed themselves saying.
content:
那天晚上，李明把四个版本写在一起。
老王：十二年前，下雨天，走进饭馆。
店员：两年前，三楼的人不要它了。
叔叔：三十五年前，学校后面生的。
老陈：十二年前四月，四楼楼梯下面生的。
时间从两年到三十五年。
地点有四个。
四个版本，没有两个是一致的。
李明看了很久。
然后他发现了一件事。
四个版本里，有三个人说的完全一样。
「是我第一个给它东西吃的。」
老王说了。
店员说了。
小明的爸爸说了。
只有老陈没有说。
李明坐在桌子前面，心里很奇怪。
他们不是在骗他。
骗人的人不会记得那么多细节。
他们都真的相信自己说的话。
那么问题就不是谁在说假话。
问题是，为什么每个人的记忆里，都是自己先给了那只猫东西吃？
english_content:
That evening Li Ming wrote the four versions out together.
Lao Wang: twelve years ago, a rainy day, walked into the shop.
Shop assistant: two years ago, abandoned by the family upstairs.
Uncle: thirty-five years ago, born behind the school.
Lao Chen: twelve years ago in April, born under the fourth-floor stairs.
The dates ran from two years to thirty-five.
There were four different places.
No two of the four agreed on anything.
Li Ming looked at them a long time.
And then he saw it.
Three of the four said the exact same thing.
"I was the first one to feed him."
Lao Wang said it.
The shop assistant said it.
Xiao Ming's father said it.
Only Lao Chen did not.
Li Ming sat at the table with an odd feeling.
They were not lying to him.
People who lie do not remember that many details.
Every one of them genuinely believed what he had said.
So the question was not who was lying.
The question was: why is it that in everyone's memory, they are the one who fed the cat first?

title: 6. 奶奶不记得
english_summary: The last person he asks is the one who has been here longest, and she is the only one with no version at all. What she tells him instead is why she has never corrected any of the others.
content:
最后李明去问奶奶。
她在店外边的椅子上，大毛在她旁边睡觉。
李明：奶奶，大毛是从哪儿来的？
奶奶：我不记得了。
李明：您不记得？
奶奶：不记得。
李明：您在这条街上住得最久。
奶奶：所以我最不记得。
李明把四个版本跟她说了。
她一句话也没有说，听完了。
李明：这四个版本，都不一样。
奶奶：我知道。
李明：您知道？
奶奶：这些我听了十几年了。
李明：那您为什么不说他们记错了？
奶奶很长时间没有回答。
奶奶：你注意到没有，他们说的都是同一件事。
李明：他们说的完全不一样。
奶奶：不。
奶奶：他们说的都是「我是第一个对它好的人」。
李明没有说话。
奶奶：一个人记东西，记的不是事实。
奶奶：记的是他愿意做的那个自己。
奶奶：那只猫十几年没有主人。
奶奶：可是这条街上有四个人，一想起它就觉得自己是个好人。
奶奶：你要我去改哪一个？
李明看着睡着的大毛。
李明：那真的是从哪儿来的？
奶奶：这个只有它自己知道。
奶奶：它不说。
大毛动了一下，换了个地方睡。
它没有听我们说话。
它十几年来一直没有听。
english_content:
The last person Li Ming asked was the old woman.
She was on her chair outside the shop, Da Mao asleep beside her.
Li Ming: Where did Da Mao come from?
Grandma: I don't remember.
Li Ming: You don't remember?
Grandma: No.
Li Ming: You've been here longer than anyone.
Grandma: Which is why I remember it least.
Li Ming told her the four versions.
She listened to all of it without a word.
Li Ming: None of them match.
Grandma: I know.
Li Ming: You know?
Grandma: I have been listening to them for over ten years.
Li Ming: Then why don't you tell them they've got it wrong?
For a long time she did not answer.
Grandma: Did you notice that they are all telling the same story?
Li Ming: They're completely different.
Grandma: No.
Grandma: They are all saying, I was the first one who was kind to him.
Li Ming said nothing.
Grandma: What a person keeps is not the fact.
Grandma: What he keeps is the version of himself he would like to be.
Grandma: That cat has had no owner for over ten years.
Grandma: And there are four people on this street who think better of themselves every time they look at him.
Grandma: Which of those would you have me correct?
Li Ming looked at the sleeping cat.
Li Ming: So where did he actually come from?
Grandma: Only he knows that.
Grandma: And he isn't saying.
Da Mao shifted and settled somewhere else.
He had not been listening to any of it.
He had not been listening for over ten years.

title: 1. 八个人，我第八
english_summary: Eight kids race to school every morning. Xiao Ming has come first every day for two years; Da Li comes eighth. Today Da Li says something out loud, and the gap turns out to be ten minutes.
content:
早上七点，八个孩子在外边。
他们都要去学校。
家到学校，要二十分钟。
他们不要二十分钟。
他们跑。
七点二十，小明到学校。
七点二十二，第二个人到。
七点二十三，第三个。
七点二十五，李明到。
七点半，大力到。
八个孩子，大力第八。
天天都是。
两年了。
小明天天第一。
大力天天第八。
今天大力坐下的时候，他说了。
大力：明天我第一。
没有人说话。
李明：你说什么？
大力：明天我第一个到。
李明：你今天第八。
大力：我知道。
李明：你昨天也第八。
大力：我知道。
小明看他。
小明：你？
大力：我。
小明看了他一下。
小明：我七点二十到。
小明：你七点半到。
小明：十分钟。
大力：十分钟。
小明：明天见。
他上课去了。
李明：大力。
大力：什么？
李明：十分钟很多。
大力：我知道。
english_content:
Seven in the morning: eight kids outside.
All of them are going to school.
Home to school takes twenty minutes.
They do not take twenty minutes.
They run it.
Seven twenty: Xiao Ming reaches the school.
Seven twenty-two: the second one.
Seven twenty-three: the third.
Seven twenty-five: Li Ming.
Half past seven: Da Li.
Eight kids. Da Li is eighth.
Every day is like this.
For two years.
Xiao Ming, first every day.
Da Li, eighth every day.
Today, as Da Li sat down, he said it.
Da Li: Tomorrow I'll be first.
Nobody said anything.
Li Ming: Say that again?
Da Li: Tomorrow I get there first.
Li Ming: You came eighth today.
Da Li: I know.
Li Ming: And yesterday.
Da Li: I know.
Xiao Ming looked over at him.
Xiao Ming: You?
Da Li: Me.
Xiao Ming looked at him a moment.
Xiao Ming: I get there at seven twenty.
Xiao Ming: You get there at half past.
Xiao Ming: Ten minutes.
Da Li: Ten minutes.
Xiao Ming: See you tomorrow.
And he went off to class.
Li Ming: Da Li.
Da Li: What?
Li Ming: Ten minutes is a lot.
Da Li: I know.

title: 2. 六点
english_summary: He is eighth again the next morning. So he stops running at seven and starts running at six, alone, and finds out what he actually is when nobody is watching.
content:
第二天早上七点半，大力到学校。
他还是第八。
小明没有说什么。
他不说，大力不高兴。
那天晚上，大力想了很多。
七点跑，他第八。
那他六点跑。
第三天，大力六点起床。
外边没有人。
他一个人跑。
他看时间。
六点一分，他在家外边。
六点二十九，他到学校。
二十八分钟。
他坐下，很多时候没有说话。
二十八分钟。
小明是二十分钟。
不是十分钟。
是八分钟，也是二十八分钟。
他不知道怎么想这件事。
第四天早上六点，他也去了。
二十七分钟。
第五天，二十七分钟。
第六天，二十七分钟。
第七天，二十六分钟。
他很高兴。
一个星期，两分钟。
二十六是他的。
二十是小明的。
六分钟。
一个星期两分钟，三个星期六分钟。
三个星期。
他不知道，这件事不是这样的。
english_content:
At half past seven next morning, Da Li reached the school.
Still eighth.
Xiao Ming said nothing.
Him saying nothing made it worse.
That night Da Li did a lot of thinking.
Running at seven, he is eighth.
So he would run at six.
On the third day Da Li got up at six.
There was nobody outside.
He ran on his own.
He watched the clock.
One minute past six, outside his house.
Six twenty-nine, at the school.
Twenty-eight minutes.
He sat down and did not say anything for a while.
Twenty-eight minutes.
Xiao Ming is twenty.
It is not ten minutes.
It is eight minutes, and it is also twenty-eight.
He did not know what to do with that.
Six o'clock on the fourth morning, he went again.
Twenty-seven.
Fifth day: twenty-seven.
Sixth day: twenty-seven.
Seventh day: twenty-six.
He was pleased.
One week, two minutes.
Twenty-six is his.
Twenty is Xiao Ming's.
Six minutes.
Two minutes a week; six minutes is three weeks.
Three weeks.
He did not know yet that it does not work like that.

title: 3. 二十四
english_summary: Three weeks later he is not at twenty. He is at twenty-four and has been for nine days. Then he finds out somebody has been watching every one of those mornings.
content:
三个星期到了。
大力不是二十分钟。
他是二十四分钟。
第二个星期，二十四。
第三个星期，二十四。
九天，都是二十四。
一分钟也没有少。
他六点起床。
他天天跑。
二十四。
那天下午，李明来找他。
李明：你早上做什么？
大力：跑。
李明：一个人？
大力：一个人。
李明：多少天了？
大力：三个星期。
李明：怎么样？
大力没有说话。
李明：二十四？
大力看他。
大力：你怎么知道？
李明：早上我也看见你了。
李明：我看见九天了。
大力：那你怎么不说？
李明：我想知道你能跑多少天。
大力：那你现在怎么说了？
李明：九天。
李明：九天没有人问你什么。
李明：我明天六点也来。
大力：你跑不快。
李明：我知道。
李明：我不跑。
大力：那你来做什么？
李明：我看时间。
大力没有说话。
大力：好。
english_content:
Three weeks came.
Da Li was not at twenty minutes.
He was at twenty-four.
Second week: twenty-four.
Third week: twenty-four.
Nine days, all twenty-four.
Not one minute less.
He got up at six.
He ran every day.
Twenty-four.
That afternoon Li Ming came to find him.
Li Ming: What do you do in the mornings?
Da Li: Run.
Li Ming: On your own?
Da Li: On my own.
Li Ming: How many days now?
Da Li: Three weeks.
Li Ming: And?
Da Li didn't answer.
Li Ming: Twenty-four?
Da Li stared at him.
Da Li: How do you know that?
Li Ming: I've seen you out there in the mornings.
Li Ming: Nine days of it.
Da Li: Then why didn't you say?
Li Ming: I wanted to know how many days you'd keep going.
Da Li: So why say it now?
Li Ming: Nine days.
Li Ming: Nine days and nobody said a word to you.
Li Ming: I'm coming at six tomorrow.
Da Li: You're not fast.
Li Ming: I know.
Li Ming: I'm not running.
Da Li: Then what are you coming for?
Li Ming: I'll take your time.
Da Li said nothing.
Da Li: All right.

title: 4. 小明的二十分钟
english_summary: With somebody calling the minutes out loud, the numbers start moving again. Then Li Ming gives him the one number nobody has ever thought to look at.
content:
李明天天六点来。
他看时间，他说时间。
二十四，二十四，二十三。
二十三，二十三，二十二。
大力：现在怎么可以了？
李明：你一个人跑，你不知道你跑多快。
李明：现在你知道。
一个星期，二十一。
大力：二十一。
李明：还有一分钟。
大力：一分钟。
那天下午，李明在学校外边找大力。
李明：我知道一件事，你不知道。
大力：什么事？
李明：小明的时间。
大力：他二十分钟。
李明：他天天二十分钟。
大力：我知道。
李明：两年，天天二十分钟。
李明：一天也不是二十一。
李明：一天也不是十九。
大力不说话了。
大力：两年，一分钟也没有少？
李明：一分钟也没有。
大力：一个人跑两年，时间不会都一样……
大力没有说下去。
李明：你想到了。
大力：他不是跑二十分钟。
李明：他不是。
大力：他是跑第一。
李明：他到第一，不跑了。
大力在那里，没有说话。
两年了，没有人到他前边。
两年了，没有人知道他多快。
大力：他也不知道。
李明：他也不知道。
english_content:
Li Ming came at six every day.
He took the time and he said it out loud.
Twenty-four, twenty-four, twenty-three.
Twenty-three, twenty-three, twenty-two.
Da Li: Why is it working now?
Li Ming: Running alone, you don't know how fast you are.
Li Ming: Now you do.
One week later: twenty-one.
Da Li: Twenty-one.
Li Ming: One minute to go.
Da Li: One minute.
That afternoon Li Ming came to the school gate to find him.
Li Ming: I know something you don't.
Da Li: What?
Li Ming: Xiao Ming's times.
Da Li: He's twenty minutes.
Li Ming: He's twenty minutes every day.
Da Li: I know.
Li Ming: Two years. Twenty minutes every single day.
Li Ming: Not one day at twenty-one.
Li Ming: Not one day at nineteen.
Da Li went quiet.
Da Li: Two years and not one minute less?
Li Ming: Not one.
Da Li: You can't run two years and get the same time every —
He didn't finish.
Li Ming: You've got it.
Da Li: He isn't running a twenty.
Li Ming: No.
Da Li: He's running first place.
Li Ming: He gets to first, and then he stops.
Da Li stood there and said nothing.
Two years, and nobody had got in front of him.
Two years, and nobody knew how fast he was.
Da Li: He doesn't know either.
Li Ming: He doesn't know either.

title: 5. 你会跑多快
english_summary: Da Li asks the rival the question nobody has asked in two years. The answer is not a boast — it is the first honest thing Xiao Ming has said about running.
content:
第二天中午，大力找小明。
小明：什么事？
大力：我问你一件事。
小明：你问。
大力：你跑二十分钟。
小明：对。
大力：两年都是二十分钟。
小明没有说话。
大力：你会跑多快？
小明看他。
小明：你问这个做什么？
大力：我要知道。
小明：我也不知道。
大力：您不知道？
小明：两年了，我不知道。
大力：怎么会？
小明：我第一个到，这个事好了。
大力：那你天天跑做什么？
小明没有说话。
小明：我不知道。
大力：我知道。
小明：你说。
大力：你也想知道你会跑多快。
小明看他，没有说不是。
大力：明天早上七点。
小明：明天七点我也跑。我天天跑。
大力：明天你不跑第一。
大力：明天你跑最……
大力：明天你会跑多快，你跑多快。
小明：那你呢？
大力：我也是。
小明：你现在多少分钟？
大力：二十一。
小明没有说话。
小明：二十一。
大力：二十一。
小明：好。
小明：明天早上七点。
english_content:
The next midday Da Li went to find Xiao Ming.
Xiao Ming: What?
Da Li: I want to ask you something.
Xiao Ming: Ask.
Da Li: You run twenty minutes.
Xiao Ming: Yes.
Da Li: Twenty minutes for two years.
Xiao Ming said nothing.
Da Li: How fast can you actually run?
Xiao Ming looked at him.
Xiao Ming: Why are you asking?
Da Li: I want to know.
Xiao Ming: I don't know either.
Da Li: You don't know?
Xiao Ming: Two years, and I don't know.
Da Li: How can you not?
Xiao Ming: I get there first. That's the whole thing done.
Da Li: Then what are you running for, every day?
Xiao Ming had nothing to say.
Xiao Ming: I don't know.
Da Li: I do.
Xiao Ming: Go on.
Da Li: You want to know how fast you are too.
Xiao Ming looked at him and did not say no.
Da Li: Tomorrow morning, seven.
Xiao Ming: I run at seven tomorrow. I run every day.
Da Li: Tomorrow you're not running for first.
Da Li: Tomorrow you run as —
Da Li: Tomorrow you run as fast as you can run.
Xiao Ming: And you?
Da Li: Same.
Xiao Ming: What are you on now?
Da Li: Twenty-one.
Xiao Ming didn't answer.
Xiao Ming: Twenty-one.
Da Li: Twenty-one.
Xiao Ming: All right.
Xiao Ming: Seven tomorrow.

title: 6. 明天早上七点
english_summary: Eight kids at the corner, and for the first time in two years both of the ones at the front mean to find out. The chapter ends on the word before the race does.
content:
那天晚上，大力没有睡。
他看外边。
他想那些时间。
二十八。
二十六。
二十四，二十四，二十四。
二十三。
二十一。
一分钟。
一分钟不多。
小明不是二十。
小明是多少，没有人知道。
早上六点半，大力到外边。
外边有人。
是李明。
李明：我今天不看时间。
大力：怎么不看？
李明：今天不要时间。
李明：今天看谁第一个到。
七点，八个孩子在外边。
他们都知道今天不是天天的那个早上。
没有人说话。
小明在前边。
大力也在前边。
两年了，这是第一天。
小明：大力。
大力：什么？
小明：谢谢。
大力：什么？
小明没有说。
李明：七点了。
八个孩子都看学校那边。
家到学校，要二十分钟。
他们不要二十分钟。
李明：跑。
english_content:
That night Da Li did not sleep.
He looked out at the dark.
He went over the times.
Twenty-eight.
Twenty-six.
Twenty-four. Twenty-four. Twenty-four.
Twenty-three.
Twenty-one.
One minute.
One minute is not much.
But Xiao Ming is not a twenty.
What Xiao Ming is, nobody knows.
At half past six Da Li came outside.
Somebody was there.
It was Li Ming.
Li Ming: I'm not taking times today.
Da Li: Why not?
Li Ming: Today doesn't need a time.
Li Ming: Today it's who gets there first.
At seven, eight kids were outside.
All of them knew this was not one of the ordinary mornings.
Nobody spoke.
Xiao Ming was at the front.
Da Li was at the front too.
In two years, this was the first day of it.
Xiao Ming: Da Li.
Da Li: What?
Xiao Ming: Thank you.
Da Li: For what?
Xiao Ming didn't say.
Li Ming: It's seven.
Eight kids looked towards the school.
Home to school takes twenty minutes.
They were not going to take twenty minutes.
Li Ming: Go.

title: 7. 十九和十八
english_summary: The race everyone has been waiting for. Halfway, Da Li is in front for the first time in two years — and finds out what Xiao Ming has been holding back.
content:
七点，李明说了一个字。
八个孩子开始跑。
大力跑得很快。
第一分钟，他在第三。
第三分钟，他在第二。
第五分钟，他在小明前面。
两年了，这是第一次。
他没有回头。
他听见后面的人。
他跑得再快一点儿。
第十分钟，后面还有人。
第十二分钟，还有。
第十五分钟，大力的身体开始疼。
他还是跑。
学校已经在前面了。
小明过去了。
不快，也不慢。
他就是过去了。
小明到学校的时候，大力还在后面。
大力到的时候，他坐在地上。
他很累。
李明跑过来。
李明：大力。
大力：我没有第一。
李明：你听我说。
大力：我没有第一。
李明：十九分钟。
大力不说话了。
大力：什么？
李明：你十九分钟。
李明：你不是二十一了。
大力：那小明呢？
李明看着他。
李明：十八。
大力：十八。
李明：两年了，他第一次不是二十。
小明在那边，也坐在地上。
他也很累。
两年了，没有人看见他这样。
english_content:
At seven, Li Ming said one word.
Eight kids started running.
Da Li went out fast.
First minute: he was third.
Third minute: second.
By the fifth minute he was in front of Xiao Ming.
In two years it was the first time.
He didn't look back.
He could hear the one behind him.
He went faster.
Tenth minute, and the sound was still there.
Twelfth minute: still there.
By the fifteenth minute Da Li's body had started to hurt.
He kept running.
The school was already ahead of them.
And then Xiao Ming went past.
Not fast. Not slow.
He simply went past.
When Xiao Ming reached the school, Da Li was still behind him.
When Da Li got there he sat down on the ground.
He was finished.
Li Ming came running over.
Li Ming: Da Li.
Da Li: I wasn't first.
Li Ming: Listen to me.
Da Li: I wasn't first.
Li Ming: Nineteen minutes.
Da Li stopped.
Da Li: What?
Li Ming: You did nineteen.
Li Ming: You're not a twenty-one any more.
Da Li: And him?
Li Ming looked at him.
Li Ming: Eighteen.
Da Li: Eighteen.
Li Ming: Two years, and it's the first time he hasn't been a twenty.
Xiao Ming was over on the other side, also sitting on the ground.
He was finished too.
In two years nobody had seen him like that.

title: 8. 疼
english_summary: He wakes up the next morning unable to put weight on one leg, and does the stupidest possible thing about it, which is to run anyway.
content:
第二天早上六点，大力起床。
他的身体很疼。
他还是出去了。
李明已经在外面。
李明：你今天不要跑。
大力：我跑。
李明：昨天你十九分钟。
大力：所以今天我十八。
李明：不是这样的。
大力没有听。
他跑了三分钟。
第三分钟，他站住了。
他坐在地上，什么都说不出来。
李明跑过来。
李明：哪里疼？
大力没有说话。
李明：你自己走得回去吗？
大力：可以。
他站起来，走了走，再坐下了。
李明：我帮你。
大力：我不要。
李明：大力。
大力：我不要！
他们两个人都没有说话。
最后大力说了一句。
大力：对不起。
李明：没关系。
李明帮他回家。
他们走了四十分钟。
四十分钟。
大力昨天跑十九分钟。
今天他走四十分钟。
他一路上都没有说话。
english_content:
Six o'clock the next morning, Da Li got up.
His body hurt.
He went out anyway.
Li Ming was already outside.
Li Ming: You don't have to run today.
Da Li: I'm running.
Li Ming: You did nineteen yesterday.
Da Li: So today I do eighteen.
Li Ming: That isn't how it works.
Da Li didn't listen.
He ran for three minutes.
In the third minute he stopped dead.
He sat down on the ground and couldn't get a word out.
Li Ming came running.
Li Ming: Where does it hurt?
Da Li didn't answer.
Li Ming: Can you get yourself home?
Da Li: Yes.
He stood up, took two steps and sat down again.
Li Ming: I'll help you.
Da Li: I don't need it.
Li Ming: Da Li.
Da Li: I don't need it!
Neither of them said anything.
At last Da Li spoke.
Da Li: I'm sorry.
Li Ming: It's all right.
Li Ming got him home.
It took them forty minutes to walk it.
Forty minutes.
Yesterday Da Li had run it in nineteen.
Today he walked it in forty.
He didn't say a word the whole way.

title: 9. 两个星期
english_summary: The doctor says two weeks. Two weeks is fourteen mornings of standing at the corner watching everybody else go, including the one person who has started training.
content:
医生说两个星期不能跑。
大力：两个星期？
医生：两个星期。
大力：我可以跑一点儿吗？
医生：不可以。
大力：一天跑十分钟呢？
医生：小朋友。
医生：你现在跑，以后就不能跑了。
大力没有再问。
第一天早上七点，他在外边。
他不跑，他看。
七个孩子跑了。
他一个人在那里。
第二天，他也去了。
第三天也去了。
李明：你不要天天来。
大力：我来。
第四天，大力看见了一件事。
小明六点就在外边了。
大力：他做什么？
李明：跑。
大力：六点？
李明：六点。
大力：多少天了？
李明：从那天开始。
大力站在那里，很长时间没有说话。
两年了，小明六点没有起来过。
现在他天天六点起来。
因为有人跑到他前面了。
大力：李明。
李明：什么？
大力：我两个星期不能跑。
李明：我知道。
大力：他两个星期都在跑。
李明没有说话。
因为大力说得对。
english_content:
The doctor said two weeks, no running.
Da Li: Two weeks?
Doctor: Two weeks.
Da Li: Can I run a bit?
Doctor: No.
Da Li: Ten minutes a day?
Doctor: Young man.
Doctor: Run now and later you won't be running at all.
Da Li didn't ask again.
Seven o'clock the first morning, he was outside.
He didn't run. He watched.
Seven kids ran.
He stood there on his own.
The second day he went again.
And the third.
Li Ming: You don't have to come every day.
Da Li: I'm coming.
On the fourth day Da Li saw something.
Xiao Ming was outside at six.
Da Li: What's he doing?
Li Ming: Running.
Da Li: At six?
Li Ming: Six.
Da Li: For how long?
Li Ming: Since that day.
Da Li stood there a long time without speaking.
For two years Xiao Ming had never got up at six.
Now he was up at six every morning.
Because somebody had got in front of him.
Da Li: Li Ming.
Li Ming: Mm.
Da Li: I can't run for two weeks.
Li Ming: I know.
Da Li: He's going to run for all fourteen of those days.
Li Ming didn't answer.
Because Da Li was right.

title: 10. 二十三
english_summary: Fourteen days off, and the first run back is worse than his very first morning. The number he has spent months moving has moved back on its own.
content:
两个星期到了。
第一天早上六点，大力出去。
李明也来了。
李明：慢一点儿。
大力：我知道。
他跑了。
跑了三分钟，他就累了。
跑了五分钟，他的身体很累。
跑了十分钟，他想走。
他没有走。
他到学校的时候，李明没有说时间。
大力：多少？
李明：你今天第一天。
大力：多少？
李明：二十三。
大力坐在地上。
二十三。
三个月前，他二十三。
三个月，都没有了。
他没有说话。
李明也没有说话。
他们坐了很长时间。
最后李明说了。
李明：这个二十三不是三个月前的二十三。
大力：都是二十三。
李明：不是。
李明：三个月前，二十三是你最快的。
李明：现在你二十三，但是你跑过十九。
李明：你的身体知道十九。
大力：我的身体不知道。
李明：那你昨天为什么六点起床？
大力没有说话。
李明：明天六点，我还来。
english_content:
Two weeks passed.
Six o'clock on the first day, Da Li went out.
Li Ming came too.
Li Ming: Take it easy.
Da Li: I know.
He ran.
Three minutes in, he was tired.
Five minutes in, his body was heavy.
Ten minutes in, he wanted to walk.
He didn't walk.
When he reached the school, Li Ming didn't say the time.
Da Li: How much?
Li Ming: It's your first day back.
Da Li: How much?
Li Ming: Twenty-three.
Da Li sat down on the ground.
Twenty-three.
Three months ago he was twenty-three.
Three months, gone.
He said nothing at all.
Li Ming didn't either.
They sat for a long time.
At last Li Ming said it.
Li Ming: This twenty-three isn't the twenty-three from three months ago.
Da Li: It's the same number either way.
Li Ming: It isn't.
Li Ming: Three months ago, twenty-three was as fast as you could go.
Li Ming: Now you're at twenty-three, but you have run a nineteen.
Li Ming: Your body knows what nineteen feels like.
Da Li: My body doesn't know anything.
Li Ming: Then why did you get up at six this morning?
Da Li didn't answer.
Li Ming: Six tomorrow. I'll be here.

title: 11. 老师的一句话
english_summary: A teacher who has said nothing for months finally says one sentence about how he runs. It is not encouragement, and it costs Da Li three days of getting slower before it works.
content:
大力天天跑。
二十三，二十二，二十二，二十一。
一个月，二十。
但是到了二十，就不动了。
二十，二十，二十。
一天下午，老师叫他。
老师：你早上跑步。
大力：对。
老师：我看见很多次了。
大力：老师，我现在二十分钟。
老师：我知道。
大力：我不能再快了。
老师：你能。
大力：怎么能？
老师：你第一分钟跑得太快。
大力：第一分钟快，不好吗？
老师：你第一分钟在第一。
老师：你最后五分钟很累。
老师：那五分钟，你就慢了。
大力：那我第一分钟慢一点儿？
老师：对。
大力：那我第一分钟就在后面了。
老师：对。
大力：我不想在后面。
老师笑了。
老师：所以你二十分钟。
他走了。
第二天，大力第一分钟跑得慢。
那天他二十一分钟。
第三天，也是二十一。
第四天，二十。
第五天，十九。
李明看着手表，没有说话。
大力：多少？
李明：你自己看。
大力看了。
十九。
他一个人跑出来的十九。
english_content:
Da Li ran every day.
Twenty-three, twenty-two, twenty-two, twenty-one.
A month later: twenty.
And after twenty it stopped moving.
Twenty. Twenty. Twenty.
One afternoon a teacher called him over.
Teacher: You run in the mornings.
Da Li: Yes.
Teacher: I've seen you a good many times.
Da Li: I'm at twenty minutes now.
Teacher: I know.
Da Li: I can't get any faster.
Teacher: You can.
Da Li: How?
Teacher: Your first minute is too fast.
Da Li: Isn't a fast start good?
Teacher: In the first minute you're in front.
Teacher: In your last five minutes you're dying.
Teacher: And in those five minutes you lose it.
Da Li: So I go slower at the start?
Teacher: Yes.
Da Li: Then I'll be at the back in the first minute.
Teacher: Yes.
Da Li: I don't want to be at the back.
The teacher laughed.
Teacher: Which is why you're a twenty.
And he walked off.
The next day Da Li went slow in the first minute.
That day he ran twenty-one.
The third day: twenty-one again.
The fourth: twenty.
The fifth: nineteen.
Li Ming looked at his watch and said nothing.
Da Li: How much?
Li Ming: Look for yourself.
Da Li looked.
Nineteen.
A nineteen, run alone, with nobody in front of him.

title: 12. 十八和十八
english_summary: They race again. Nobody wins, which is the first genuinely interesting result either of them has ever had — and Xiao Ming has been waiting to tell him about something bigger.
content:
星期六早上七点。
八个孩子在外边。
小明看大力。
小明：你回来了。
大力：我回来了。
小明：我这两个月天天六点跑。
大力：我知道。
小明：我现在不是十八。
大力：我也不是十九。
他们两个人都笑了。
李明：七点了。
李明：跑。
第一分钟，大力在第五。
小明回头看了一下。
第五分钟，大力在第三。
第十分钟，第二。
第十三分钟，他在小明后面一点儿。
第十五分钟，他还在小明后面一点儿。
小明跑得再快一点儿。
大力也跑得再快一点儿。
学校在前面了。
最后，两个人在一起。
他们到学校的时候，李明的手表是十八。
大力：谁第一？
李明：……
大力：谁第一？
李明：我不知道。
小明：他不知道。
小明：我也不知道。
两个人都坐在地上，都很累。
小明：大力。
大力：什么？
小明：学校一年有一天。
大力：什么天？
小明：很多学校都来。
大力：来做什么？
小明看着他。
小明：来跑。
小明：一个学校只有两个人能去。
大力：什么时候？
小明：五个星期。
english_content:
Seven o'clock on Saturday morning.
Eight kids outside.
Xiao Ming looked at Da Li.
Xiao Ming: You're back.
Da Li: I'm back.
