Xiao Ming: I've run at six every morning for two months.
Da Li: I know.
Xiao Ming: I'm not an eighteen any more.
Da Li: And I'm not a nineteen.
They both laughed.
Li Ming: It's seven.
Li Ming: Go.
First minute: Da Li was fifth.
Xiao Ming glanced back.
Fifth minute: third.
Tenth minute: second.
Thirteenth minute: just behind Xiao Ming.
Fifteenth minute: still just behind him.
Xiao Ming went faster.
Da Li went faster too.
The school came up ahead.
At the end, the two of them level.
When they reached the school, Li Ming's watch said eighteen.
Da Li: Who was first?
Li Ming: …
Da Li: Who was first?
Li Ming: I don't know.
Xiao Ming: He doesn't know.
Xiao Ming: I don't know either.
Both of them sat down on the ground, both finished.
Xiao Ming: Da Li.
Da Li: What?
Xiao Ming: There's one day a year at this school.
Da Li: What day?
Xiao Ming: A lot of schools come to it.
Da Li: To do what?
Xiao Ming looked at him.
Xiao Ming: To run.
Xiao Ming: Each school gets two places.
Da Li: When?
Xiao Ming: Five weeks.

title: 13. 一个学校两个人
english_summary: One day a year, eleven schools send two runners each. Their school has four people who want to go, and a week to work out which two.
content:
学校的比赛，一年一次。
十一个学校，一个学校两个人。
他们学校有四个人想去。
小明，大力，还有两个比他们大两岁的学生。
老师：下个星期六，你们四个人跑一次。
老师：前两个去比赛。
大力：就一次？
老师：就一次。
大力：那天要是我跑得不好呢？
老师：那你就不去。
大力：这不公平。
老师看着他。
老师：比赛就是这样。
老师：比赛那天，你跑得不好，你就输。
老师：这件事没有办法。
大力没有再说什么。
那天下午，大力找小明。
大力：那两个人跑多少？
小明：一个十七，一个十七半。
大力：十七。
小明：他们比我们大两岁。
大力：我们十八。
小明：我们十八。
两个人都没有说下去。
因为下面的话很清楚。
四个人，两个位子。
十七，十七半，十八，十八。
他们两个人，只有一个能去。
也可能一个也不能去。
大力：小明。
小明：我知道你要说什么。
大力：那你说。
小明：下个星期六，我不会让你。
大力：我也不会。
小明：好。
english_content:
The school race happens once a year.
Eleven schools, two runners each.
Their school had four people who wanted to go.
Xiao Ming, Da Li, and two students two years older than them.
Teacher: Next Saturday the four of you run it once.
Teacher: The first two go to the race.
Da Li: Just once?
Teacher: Just once.
Da Li: And if I have a bad day?
Teacher: Then you don't go.
Da Li: That isn't fair.
The teacher looked at him.
Teacher: That is what a race is.
Teacher: On the day, if you run badly, you lose.
Teacher: There is nothing to be done about that.
Da Li didn't say anything more.
That afternoon Da Li found Xiao Ming.
Da Li: What do those two run?
Xiao Ming: One is a seventeen. One is seventeen and a half.
Da Li: Seventeen.
Xiao Ming: They're two years older than us.
Da Li: We're eighteens.
Xiao Ming: We're eighteens.
Neither of them said the next part.
Because the next part was obvious.
Four people, two places.
Seventeen, seventeen and a half, eighteen, eighteen.
Between the two of them, only one was going.
And possibly neither.
Da Li: Xiao Ming.
Xiao Ming: I know what you're going to say.
Da Li: Then say it.
Xiao Ming: On Saturday I'm not going to go easy on you.
Da Li: Nor am I.
Xiao Ming: Good.

title: 14. 六天
english_summary: Six days to find a minute neither of them has. Li Ming does the thing that turns out to matter more than any of the running: he starts writing everything down.
content:
六天。
大力要少一分钟。
六天少一分钟，很难。
第一天，他跑了三次。
第三次的时候，他的身体又开始疼了。
李明：你别再这样。
大力：只有六天。
李明：六天。所以你更不能疼。
大力：那我怎么办？
李明没有马上回答。
第二天，李明带来一个本子。
大力：这是什么？
李明：你这三个月的时间，都在这里。
大力：你都写下来了？
李明：都写下来了。
他们一起看那些数字。
李明：你看这里。
李明：你早上六点跑，十八分半。
李明：你下午跑，十九分。
大力：这不一样吗？
李明：半分钟。
李明：还有，你一个人跑，十八分半。
李明：你后面有人的时候，十八分。
大力：也是半分钟。
李明：两个半分钟，就是一分钟。
大力看着他。
大力：所以比赛那天……
李明：比赛是早上。
李明：比赛的时候，你后面一直有人。
大力很长时间没有说话。
大力：你三个月都在写这个。
李明：对。
大力：为什么？
李明：因为你跑的时候看不见自己。
李明：总要有一个人看着。
english_content:
Six days.
Da Li needed a minute.
A minute in six days is hard.
On the first day he ran it three times.
On the third one, his body started hurting again.
Li Ming: Don't do that again.
Da Li: There are six days.
Li Ming: Six days. Which is exactly why you can't get hurt.
Da Li: Then what do I do?
Li Ming didn't answer straight away.
The next day Li Ming brought a notebook.
Da Li: What's that?
Li Ming: Every time you've run in three months. All of it's in here.
Da Li: You wrote all of it down?
Li Ming: All of it.
They went through the numbers together.
Li Ming: Look here.
Li Ming: When you run at six in the morning: eighteen and a half.
Li Ming: When you run in the afternoon: nineteen.
Da Li: Is that different?
Li Ming: Half a minute.
Li Ming: And: running alone, eighteen and a half.
Li Ming: With somebody behind you, eighteen.
Da Li: Another half minute.
Li Ming: Two half minutes make one minute.
Da Li stared at him.
Da Li: So on the day —
Li Ming: The race is in the morning.
Li Ming: And in a race there is always somebody behind you.
For a long moment Da Li said nothing.
Da Li: You've been writing this for three months.
Li Ming: Yes.
Da Li: Why?
Li Ming: Because when you're running you can't see yourself.
Li Ming: Somebody has to be watching.

title: 15. 星期六
english_summary: The four of them run for two places. One of the older boys does something in the last two minutes that Da Li will think about for a long time afterwards.
content:
星期六早上七点，四个人。
老师看时间。
老师：跑。
第一分钟，大力在最后。
他知道自己要在最后。
第五分钟，他在第三。
第十分钟，他在第二。
前面是小明。
后面是那两个大学生。
第十四分钟，后面的人开始快了。
一个人过去了。
大力现在是第三。
第十六分钟，还有一个人在他后面。
两个位子。
第三个人不去比赛。
大力的身体已经很累了。
他想到李明说的话。
后面有人的时候，你跑得快。
他没有回头。
他跑。
最后两分钟，他过去了那个大学生。
他到的时候，是第二。
小明第一，十七分半。
大力第二，十七分半。
两个人一样。
大力坐在地上，很久起不来。
那个大学生走过来。
他比大力大两岁，他跑了三年。
今年他不能去比赛了。
大力：对不起。
那个学生看着他。
学生：你为什么说对不起？
大力：我……
学生：我跑了三年，十七分半。
学生：你跑了三个月，十七分半。
学生：说对不起的应该是我。
他给了大力一只手，把他拉起来。
学生：去跑。
english_content:
Seven o'clock Saturday morning. Four of them.
The teacher had the watch.
Teacher: Go.
First minute: Da Li was last.
He knew he was meant to be last.
Fifth minute: third.
Tenth minute: second.
In front of him was Xiao Ming.
Behind him were the two older boys.
At fourteen minutes the ones behind started to move.
One of them went past.
Da Li was third now.
At sixteen minutes there was still one behind him.
Two places.
Third place does not go to the race.
Da Li's body was already gone.
He thought of what Li Ming had said.
With somebody behind you, you run faster.
He didn't look back.
He ran.
In the last two minutes he went past the older boy.
He came in second.
Xiao Ming first, seventeen and a half.
Da Li second, seventeen and a half.
The same time.
Da Li sat on the ground and couldn't get up.
The older boy came over.
He was two years older and had been running three years.
This year he wasn't going to the race.
Da Li: I'm sorry.
The older boy looked at him.
Older boy: What are you apologising for?
Da Li: I —
Older boy: Three years I've run. Seventeen and a half.
Older boy: You've run three months. Seventeen and a half.
Older boy: I'm the one who should be apologising.
He put out a hand and pulled Da Li up.
Older boy: Go and run it.

title: 16. 十六分
english_summary: At the meet they watch the runner from the eleventh school warm up, and Li Ming quietly stops writing numbers down.
content:
比赛在两个星期以后。
十一个学校，二十二个人。
大力和小明第一次看见别的学校的学生。
有的学生看起来跟他们一样。
有一个不一样。
他一个人在那边跑。
他跑得很轻。
大力看了他很久。
大力：他是谁？
小明：不知道。
李明去问了别的学校的学生。
他回来的时候，他没有马上说话。
大力：多少？
李明：十六分。
大力：十六。
小明：我们十七分半。
李明：对。
大力：一分半。
三个人都没有说话。
一分半，是三个月。
他们只有今天。
小明：那我们今天来做什么？
大力没有回答。
他一直看着那个学生跑。
他看得很认真。
过了很久，大力说了一句。
大力：他第一分钟跑得很慢。
李明：什么？
大力：比我还慢。
大力：他不是跑得快。
大力：他是最后不慢。
李明看着他。
李明：你现在才发现这个？
大力：我现在才发现。
李明：那你今天想做什么？
大力：我想知道我最后能不能不慢。
english_content:
The race was two weeks later.
Eleven schools, twenty-two runners.
It was the first time Da Li and Xiao Ming had seen runners from other schools.
Some of them looked much like themselves.
One did not.
He was over on his own, running.
He ran lightly.
Da Li watched him for a long time.
Da Li: Who is that?
Xiao Ming: No idea.
Li Ming went and asked someone from another school.
When he came back he didn't speak straight away.
Da Li: How much?
Li Ming: Sixteen minutes.
Da Li: Sixteen.
Xiao Ming: We're seventeen and a half.
Li Ming: Yes.
Da Li: A minute and a half.
None of them said anything.
A minute and a half is three months.
They had today.
Xiao Ming: So what are we here for?
Da Li didn't answer.
He kept watching the other runner.
He watched him closely.
After a long while Da Li said something.
Da Li: His first minute is very slow.
Li Ming: What?
Da Li: Slower than mine.
Da Li: He isn't running fast.
Da Li: He's just not slowing down at the end.
Li Ming looked at him.
Li Ming: You're only working this out now?
Da Li: I'm only working it out now.
Li Ming: So what do you want to do today?
Da Li: I want to find out whether I can be the one who doesn't slow down.

title: 17. 前十四分钟
english_summary: The race. He runs somebody else's plan for fourteen minutes and hates every second of it, and at fourteen minutes he is exactly where nobody expected him to be.
content:
十点，二十二个人在一起。
大力在最后面。
他自己去后面的。
小明：你做什么？
大力：前十四分钟我不快。
小明：十四分钟以后呢？
大力：十四分钟以后我就快。
小明：要是十四分钟以后你已经太后面了呢？
大力：那我就输。
小明看了他很久。
小明：好。
比赛开始了。
第一分钟，大力第二十。
第三分钟，第十九。
他很不高兴。
他的身体想跑快。
他没有让它跑快。
第七分钟，第十七。
前面的人已经很远了。
第十分钟，第十五。
他还是不快。
第十二分钟，他看见前面的人开始慢了。
一个，两个，三个。
他们不是慢了一点儿。
他们是很慢。
第十四分钟到了。
大力开始跑。
第十五分钟，第十一。
第十六分钟，第九。
第十七分钟，第六。
他的身体很疼。
他一直跑。
第十八分钟，他看见了小明。
小明在第四。
小明也很累，可是小明还在跑。
最前面的，是那个十六分的学生。
他一个人在前面，很远。
他最后一分钟也不慢。
english_content:
Ten o'clock. Twenty-two of them on the line.
Da Li was at the very back.
He had put himself there.
Xiao Ming: What are you doing?
Da Li: I'm not going fast for fourteen minutes.
Xiao Ming: And after fourteen minutes?
Da Li: After fourteen minutes I go.
Xiao Ming: And if by then you're too far back?
Da Li: Then I lose.
Xiao Ming looked at him for a long moment.
Xiao Ming: All right.
The race started.
First minute: Da Li was twentieth.
Third minute: nineteenth.
He hated it.
His body wanted to go.
He didn't let it.
Seventh minute: seventeenth.
The leaders were a long way up the road.
Tenth minute: fifteenth.
He still didn't go.
At twelve minutes he saw the people in front of him start to slow.
One, two, three of them.
And not by a little.
They fell apart.
Fourteen minutes came.
Da Li went.
Fifteenth minute: eleventh.
Sixteenth minute: ninth.
Seventeenth minute: sixth.
His body was screaming.
He kept going.
At eighteen minutes he saw Xiao Ming.
Xiao Ming was fourth.
Xiao Ming was finished too, and Xiao Ming was still running.
Right at the front was the boy who ran sixteen.
On his own, a long way clear.
His last minute was as fast as the rest.

title: 18. 十六分五十
english_summary: He does not win. He beats one number that matters more than the race, and the last thing that happens is somebody putting out a hand — the same way the older boy did.
content:
那个十六分的学生第一。
他一个人到的，前面后面都没有人。
第二个人，十六分四十。
第三个人，十六分四十五。
第四个人，十六分五十。
第四个人是大力。
小明第五，十六分五十二。
大力到的时候，他没有看时间。
他坐在地上，什么都听不见。
过了很久，李明跑过来。
李明：大力。
大力：我第四。
李明：十六分五十。
大力：我没有第一。
李明：大力。十六分五十。
大力：……
李明：三个月前你是二十三。
李明：今天你十六分五十。
大力很长时间没有说话。
然后他哭了。
他自己也不知道为什么。
他没有赢，可是他哭了。
小明坐在他旁边，没有说什么。
过了一会儿，小明说话了。
小明：你比我快两秒。
大力：两秒不是很多。
小明：两年了。
小明：两年，你今天第一次比我快。
大力看着他。
小明：明年这一天，还有一次比赛。
大力：明年。
小明：那个十六分的学生，明年也来。
大力：我知道。
小明：明年他可能十五分半。
大力：我知道。
小明：那你还跑吗？
大力想了一下。
他站起来了。
他给了小明一只手。
大力：明天早上六点。
小明拉住他的手，站了起来。
小明：六点。
english_content:
The boy who ran sixteen came first.
He came in alone, nobody near him.
Second: sixteen forty.
Third: sixteen forty-five.
Fourth: sixteen fifty.
The fourth was Da Li.
Xiao Ming fifth, sixteen fifty-two.
When Da Li finished he didn't look at the time.
He sat down on the ground and couldn't hear anything.
After a long time Li Ming came running over.
Li Ming: Da Li.
Da Li: I came fourth.
Li Ming: Sixteen fifty.
Da Li: I wasn't first.
Li Ming: Da Li. Sixteen fifty.
Da Li: …
Li Ming: Three months ago you were a twenty-three.
Li Ming: Today you ran sixteen fifty.
Da Li said nothing for a long time.
And then he cried.
He didn't know why himself.
He hadn't won, and he cried.
Xiao Ming sat down beside him and said nothing.
After a while Xiao Ming spoke.
Xiao Ming: You were two seconds faster than me.
Da Li: Two seconds isn't much.
Xiao Ming: It's two years.
Xiao Ming: Two years, and today is the first time you've been faster than me.
Da Li looked at him.
Xiao Ming: This day next year, there's another race.
Da Li: Next year.
Xiao Ming: The boy who ran sixteen will be here too.
Da Li: I know.
Xiao Ming: Next year he might be a fifteen and a half.
Da Li: I know that too.
Xiao Ming: So are you still running?
Da Li thought about it.
He got to his feet.
He put out a hand to Xiao Ming.
Da Li: Six o'clock tomorrow morning.
Xiao Ming took it and pulled himself up.
Xiao Ming: Six.
